items.name: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [4]
items.description: Cookbook found in a gazebo-like structure high above in the heavily-crumbled section in the northwest. To get up here, you will first need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section. You will need to traverse the massive floating chunks of debris, heading further west. Once you get to the second large chunk, look in the northwest section of it for a series of makeshift stone bridges that will lead you to the gazebo where the cookbook can be looted off a corpse.

items.name: Arbalest
items.description:
Using a Stonesword Key to access, additionally obtaining the Godskin prayerbook and Godslayer Seal:
From the Rampart Tower bonfire, take the shortcut lift down to where the Grafted miniboss is fought inside the storeroom (or reach this point manually). Exit into the courtyard with the flamethrowers and barricades. Take an immediate left and hug the wall until you enter a cellar containing rats. You will hit a fog wall that requires one Stonesword Key to open. Continue past this fog wall until you reach an outdoors area again. Pull an immediate right and hug the wall until you reach a ladder. Continue past this point and almost all the way across the bridge, then jump to the rocky outcropping to your right (it's a tight jump). Continue and jump back into a walled-in area with a ballista. The Arbalest is on a corpse in that area.

items.name: Ash of War: Holy Ground
items.description:
Ash of War obtained inside the Auriza Hero's Grave by destroying three specific Chariots. Doing this involves a few steps:
  1. From this first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp.
  2. In the room below, head west and up the steps and then turn right in the next corridor. Follow the path and you will end up in a large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. These are the Chariots you need to destroy.
  3. Head down the hall all the way to the bottom where there is a large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you will find several wooden beams you can drop down onto.
  4. Navigate your way down onto the lowest beam you can drop down to and then head south towards an archway with a ladder in the back. Climb up the ladder to reach another Chariot Hall with a single Chariot.
  5. Wait for the Chariot to head downwards and then run up the ramp and enter the chamber on the right where you will find a flamethrower pillar. Hit the pillar to raise it which will activate the circular golden seal in the middle of the large double Chariot Hall, teleporting the Chariot from the third hall and causing it to collide with the double Chariots.
  6. From here, you will need to return to the large hall to witness the collision event and collect your items. The easiest way to do this is by killing yourself or using the Memory of Grace tool (if you don't care about your runes) to return to the Site of Grace. Alternatively, from the flamethrower pillar room, return to the third Chariot Hall, go all the way down the ramp and turn left into a corridor. Take another left to find a lift which will take you up to a chamber where the flamethrower pillar was raised. Wait for breaks between flame spews and head through the corridor in the north. There is an alcove on the right halfway through the corridor which you can use to safely wait for another break before heading towards the end. At the end of this corridor, you can turn left to return to the large Chariot Hall. After the Chariots crash into each other, you will receive the Ash of War along with the Tree Sentinel Armor Set.

Blaidd's First Location: When visiting Mistwood, the player can occasionally hear a wolf howl. At this point, they can ask Merchant Kale about the howling. The merchant will teach the player the Finger Snap gesture.
Blaidd can be seen resting on the tallest point in the Mistwood Ruins, and will jump down after the player uses the gesture while standing below him. Blaidd will tell the player he is searching for a man who goes by the name Darriwil.

items.name: Blaidd (2nd Location)
items.description:
Blaidd's Second Encounter. Darriwil can be fought at the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, where Blaidd will become available as a summon. Speak to Blaidd again after the fight.
Talking to Blaidd once will yield a Somber Smithing stone [2]. Talk to him a second time and he will mention a blacksmith along the Road to the Manor in Liurnia, and instruct the player to say that "Blaidd sent them". Doing this will unlock the Carian Filigreed Crest in the blacksmith's shop.
If the Evergaol fight was completed before meeting Blaidd, he will still be available to speak to here after the player talks to him in the Mistwood Ruins.

items.description: Location 1. Roaming around this location, you will hear someone call out. Look for a small group of trees and attack the small yellow tree to dispel the illusion and reveal Boc. Awards Mushroom x10 after speaking to him twice.

items.name: Boc the Seamster (Fourth Location)
items.description: NPC. He can be found kneeling by the East Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace (southwest most point of the Bellum Road). You have to rest at this Site of Grace for him to appear.

items.name: Boc the Seamster (Second Location)
items.description: Boc the Seamster Location 2. After meeting him for the first time, Boc will move into the Coastal Cave. You will find him writhing on the ground next to the Site of Grace.

items.name: Boc the Seamster (Sixth Location)
items.description: Boc appears in the East Capital Rampart site of grace. You have to rest at this Site of Grace for him to appear. He offers his sewing services as well as makes some conversation regarding the Erdtree.

items.name: Boc the Seamster (Third Location)
items.description: Boc the Seamster Location 3. After meeting him for the second time, Boc will move to Liurnia of the Lakes. Find him kneeling by the Lake-Facing Site of Grace, a cliff above to the entrance to Stillwater Cave.

items.name: Boilprawn Shack
items.description: A shack in Liurnia of the Lakes where players can meet Blackguard Big Boggart

items.name: Bols, Carian Knight
items.description: Optional Boss. Imprisoned within the Cuckoo's Evergaol. Drops the Greatblade Phalanx spell upon defeat.

items.name: Bolt of Gransax
items.description: Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital after beating Godfrey, First Elden Lord; walk outside of the west door, take the elevator down, and walk up the spear.

items.name: Boltdrake Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Found on a corpse sitting against a tall brazier.

items.name: Boltdrake Talisman +1
items.description: An upgraded version of the Boltdrake Talisman. Found in a storage shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon.

items.name: Boltdrake Talisman +2
items.description:
Talisman. Found on a corpse hanging off an opening in a tall tower south of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Reaching this area is a bit complex:
  1. You will first need to head southeast to the large plaza guarded by a stationary Farum Azula Dragon which is constantly raining red lightning all around the area.
  2. From here, drop down a series of cliffs to the east to reach the opening at the bottom of a large building.
  3. Follow the linear path here to a balcony with a ladder leading up to a terrace.
  4. Directly in front of the ladder is a lift building. Take the lift up to a series of slopes leading to a hallway underneath the same bridge you crossed to get to the southeast plaza.
  5. Fight your way through the hallway to reach a ladder at the end.
  6. Climb up the ladder to reach the opening where the corpse holding the talisman can be found.

items.name: Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing
items.description: Bell Bearing. Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter that invades the War Master's Shack at night.

items.name: Borealis the Freezing Fog
items.description: Optional Boss. Drops a Dragon Heart upon defeat.

items.name: Bower of Bounty
items.description: Site of grace in the middle of the forest.

items.name: Brass Shield
items.description: Found southeast of the map in Limgrave. Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Defeat it to obtain a Brass Shield.

items.name: Briar Greatshield
items.description: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle.

items.name: Briars of Punishment
items.description: Sorcery. Found at the leftmost dead tree next to three Lesser Fire Monks just before the long stone bridge with the Golem Archer at the end in the Mountaintops of the Giants region

items.name: Briars of Sin
items.description: Liurnia of the Lakes: Dropped by a mob directly north-west from the Artists Shack. Jump across the rocks and they'll be by a group of fire slugs.

items.name: Brick Hammer
items.description: Can be found on the 3rd floor. It is  in a corpse dangling from a window.You have to access from the 4th floor, using the wooden platforms outside.

items.name: Bridge of Sacrifice
items.description: A large stone bridge connecting Limgrave to the Weeping Peninsula. Lots of enemy soldiers and ballistae around.

items.name: Bridge of Sacrifice
items.description: Site of Grace found on the Weeping Peninsula end of the Bridge of Sacrifice.

items.name: Brother Corhyn (First Location)
items.description: Found at the side of the road after he leaves Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Brother Corhyn (Fourth Location)
items.description: NPC, found at the south of Stargazer's Ruins

items.name: Brother Corhyn (Third Location)
items.description: NPC, found contemplating a riddle alongside Goldmask

items.name: Budding Cave Moss - 4x Perfumer Ruins
items.description: Material. Found on a corpse surrounded by Miranda Flowers in Perfumer's Ruins.

items.name: Bull-Goat Set
items.description: Armor Set. Dropped by Great Horned Tragoth after successfully invading his world.

items.name: Bull-Goat's Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Found on a corpse inside Dragonbarrow Cave.

items.name: Butchering Knife
items.description: Greataxe. Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater.

items.name: Caelem Ruins
items.description: Site of Grace found by the main road near some ruins.

items.name: Caelem Ruins
items.description: Ruins found on the western portion of Caelid, where the Caelid Highway cuts through.

items.name: Caelid Catacombs
items.description: Found due East from the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Caelid Colosseum
items.description: Found in Northern Caelid, North of the Deep Siofra River Well Site of Grace, near The Great-Jar's location.

items.name: Caelid Highway South
items.description: Site of Grace found by the Caelid Highway bend towards the south.

items.name: Caelid Waypoint Ruins
items.description: A set of ruins found in the southwest of Caelid, along the highway.

items.name: Callu Baptismal Church
items.description: Church ruins found just south of Ailing Village. Inhabited by a lot of rats and one giant rat monster.

items.name: Calm Down Gesture
items.description: Gesture. Obtained fromreturning to Patches in Murkwater Cave after his initial attack. Spare him to obtain the gesture.

items.name: Candletree Wooden Shield
items.description: In the Sage's Cave, in a chest behind an illusory wall.

items.name: Cane Sword
items.description: West Capital Ramparts Site of Grace, Go south out of the room with the site of grace and down the flight of stairs to the floor underneath, make a complete U-turn in the room with the stairs to find a corpse with the sword

items.name: Cannon of Haima
items.description: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower.

items.name: Capital Rampart
items.description: Site of grace on the eastern side of the Capital.

items.name: Caria Manor
items.description: A major dungeon comprised of a very large estate, overlooking the lakes from the north. Its eternal warden, Royal Knight Loretta fervently guards the manor.

items.name: Carian Glintblade Staff
items.description: Staff. Found on the top floor of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia.

items.name: Carian Glintstone Staff
items.description: Found at the Carian Study Hall.

items.name: Carian Inverted Statue
items.description: Quest Item. Given by Ranni after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade.

items.name: Carian Knight Set
items.description: The Carian Knight Set can be picked up next to a large tombstone, past the graveyard section of Raya Lucaria Academy. When you reach the gate entrance leading to the large rotating lift, make a hard right and look below the ledge, jump down and follow the narrow path where you'll see a group of Glintstone Zombies worshipping a tombstone.

items.name: Carian Knight's Shield
items.description: Dropped by Moongrum Carian Knight.

items.name: Carian Knight's Sword
items.description: Straight Sword. Found in a chest at the back of a large stagecoach being pulled by 2 Trolls.

items.name: Carian Piercer
items.description: Sorcery. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab behind the gardens near the east.

items.name: Carian Study Hall
items.description: A large library-like location full of spectres and magic users that leads to the Divine Tower of Liurnia. Using the Carian Inverted Statue unlocks an alternative version of the map.

items.name: Castellan's Hall
items.description: Site of Grace that shows up after defeating the Boss in The Shaded Castle

items.name: Castle Morne
items.description: Optional Dungeon. A large castle on the southern tip of the Weeping Peninsula. The Leonine Misbegotten boss can be found here.

items.name: Castle Morne Lift
items.description: Site of Grace found at the entrance of Castle Morne, before ascending the lift.

items.name: Castle Morne Rampart
items.description: Site of Grace found near a campfire.

items.name: Castle Sol
items.description: A minor dungeon found in northeast Mountaintops of the Giants. Stronghole of Commander Niall.

items.name: Castle Sol Main Gate
items.description: Site of Grace found by the castle's western entrance.

items.name: Castle Sol Rooftop
items.description: Site of Grace found in Commander Niall's arena after defeating him.

items.name: Cathedral of Dragon Communion
items.description: Special Dragon Communion altar can be used to trade Dragon Hearts for Draconic Incantations.

items.name: Cathedral of Manus Celes
items.description: Located at South West Liurnia of The Lakes. Accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline.

items.name: Cathedral of Manus Celes
items.description: Site of Grace found in the center of the Cathedral of Manus Celes

items.name: Cathedral of the Forsaken
items.description: Subterranean site of grace. In the room where you fight Mohg, The Omen

items.name: Cave of Knowledge
items.description: Site of grace located inside the Cave of Knowledge

items.name: Cave of the Forlorn
items.description: Located south of the Minor Erdtree in Consecrated Snowfield

items.name: Celebrant's Skull
items.description: Warhammer. Found on a corpse at the cliff directly north from Windmill village site of grace

items.name: Celestial Dew - 1x (Leyndell Throne Room)
items.description: Key Item. Used to find absolution at the Church of Vows in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Celestial Dew - 1x Raya Lucaria South Gate
items.description: Used to seek absolution at the Church of Vows. Found on a corpse leaning against the inner side of the locked gate.

items.name: Cemetery Shade
items.description: Found inside Tombsward Catacombs. Drops Lhutel the Headless

items.name: Cemetery Shade (Black Knife Catacombs)
Cemetery Shade (Caelid Catacombs)
items.description: Boss found inside the Caelid Catacombs. Drops the Kindred of Rot Ashes upon defeat.

items.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion
items.description: Talisman dropped by Bloodhound Knight, the miniboss of Lakeside Crystal Cave

items.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +1
items.description: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse hanging by a wooden ledge above the southern walls of the castle. This area is accessed by climbing a ladder behind the church in the southeast and following the walls west. Beware the very powerful dual sword knight guarding the area. He can teleport behind you and perform very long combos.

items.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +2
items.description: Upgraded Talisman. Found in an underground room in the northwest section of the Lunar Estate Ruins. The entrance is sealed by both an Imp Statue that requires 1 Stonesword Key, as well as an illusory floor that can be dispelled with an attack.

items.name: Cerulean Crystal Tear A
items.description: Dropped by Erdtree Avatar.

items.name: Cerulean Crystal Tear B
items.description: Physick Flask material. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar guarding this tree.

items.name: Cerulean Hidden Tear
items.description: Flask of Wondrous Physick Upgrade. Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit.

items.name: Cerulean Seed Talisman
items.description: Found at Carian Study Hall. look for it at the rafters, next to a body.

items.name: Cerulean Tear Scarab
items.description: Helmet. Found on a corpse on the roof of a building. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

items.name: Chair-Crypt of Sellia
items.description: Site of Grace found in the chamber of the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest boss duo. Accessible after defeating them.

items.name: Champion's Song Painting
items.description: Champion's Song painting found in a small wooden structure on the side of the eastern walls.

items.name: Chapel of Anticipation
items.description: The starting building players are placed in after the game introduction.

items.name: Chapel of Anticipation Waygate
items.description: A Teleporter Waygate at The Four Belfries that transports you to the Chapel of Anticipation. The same location you begin the game in. Requires an Imbued Sword Key.

items.name: Chelona's Rise
items.description: A tower found in the very corner of the upper plateau in Liurnia's southwest. This tower is initially sealed, with an imp statue at the entrance holding a glowing book, instructing you to "seek three great wise beasts". See the tower's page for details.

items.name: Chelona's Rise Turtle Marker 1
items.description: Giant Ghostly Turtle #1. One of three required to break the seal to Chelona's Rise. Found hanging off the side of the cliffs west of the tower.

items.name: Chelona's Rise Turtle Marker 2
items.description: Giant Ghostly Turtle #2. One of three required to break the seal to Chelona's Rise. Found sitting on a lower cliff south of Lunar Estate Ruins. Head to the edge of the plateau and look down. You can hit the turtle with a ranged attack from here.

items.name: Chelona's Rise Turtle Marker 3
items.description: Giant Ghostly Turtle #3. One of three required to break the seal to Chelona's Rise. Found flying high above in the air southeast of Ringleader's Evergaol. You can use a bow to hit it or use the Spiritspring nearby to jump with Torrent and hit it while in the air.

items.name: Chief Guardian Arghanthy
items.description: NPC Mini-Boss, attacks with quick Fire spells. Drops One-Eyed Shield when defeated.

items.name: Chrysalids' Memento
items.description: Key Quest Item. Found on top of the pile of corpses surrounded by Rotten Strays in a small room. This room is adjacent to the Grafted Scion's hall.

items.name: Church of Dragon Communion
items.description: The ruins of a church where dragon rituals were performed. The most prominent sight here is the corpse of a large white dragon laying amongst the ruins. There is also an altar where you can obtain powerful Incantations in exchange for Dragon Heart offerings.

items.name: Church of Dragon Communion
items.description: Site of Grace just outside of the Church of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Church of Elleh
items.description: Ruins of an Old Church. There is a Merchant and a Smithing Table in the area.

items.name: Church of Elleh
items.description: Site of Grace found within the ruins of the Church of Elleh.

items.name: Church of Inhibition
items.description: The remnants of an old church in the north of Liurnia, just before the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Church of Irith
items.description: A church found behind the walls of Stormveil Castle. Easily accessible by riding west along the walls.

items.name: Church of Pilgrimage
items.description: Church ruins found atop cliffs in the northern section of Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Church of Pilgrimage
items.description: Site of Grace found at the Church of Pilgrimage.

items.name: Church of Repose
items.description: Church found high in the mountains. There is a site of grace and a Sacred Tear inside.

items.name: Church of Repose (Site of Grace)
items.description: Site of grace found inside the Church of Repose.

items.name: Church of the Cuckoo
items.description: Site of Grace at the hall to the right of the altar.

items.name: Church of the Eclipse
items.description: Site of Grace found in the Church in the southeast corner of the castle. The church is accessed by heading up the wooden platform in the courtyard and following the path in the middle levels.

items.name: Church of the Plague
items.description: Abandoned church overcome by the decay of rot that pollutes Caelid.

items.name: Church of the Plague
items.description: Site of grace found within the Church of the Plague

items.name: Church of Vows
items.description: Church of Vows is a forgotten church guarded by Miriel, Pastor of Vows.

items.name: Church of Vows
items.description: Church of Vows Site of Grace. Located at Church of Vows prior to the main entrance.

items.name: Cinquedea
items.description: Dagger. Found outside the bestial sanctum, after a long series of platforms starting on the west side to drop down onto the external structure's base.

items.name: Clarifying Boluses
items.description: Found on the upper platform where there are some enemies.

items.name: Claw Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Found on a corpse atop a tower accessible by ladder. The tower has several none-hostile Eagles at the top.

items.name: Claymore
items.description: Greatsword. From the main courtyard entrance, hug the right wall past the burning corpses and harpies to reach the entrance to the building in the north. The sword is found in a chest to the left as you enter.

items.name: Cleanrot Knight - Stillwater Cave
items.description: Optional Boss found at the end of the Stillwater Cave. Drops the Winged Sword Insignia upon defeat.

items.name: Cleanrot Knight Duo (Abandoned Cave)
items.description: Duo Boss Fight at the end of the Abandoned Cave. Drops the Gold Scarab talisman upon defeat.

items.name: Cleanrot Knight Finlay Ashes
items.description: Located in a chest protected by a knight in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. From the Prayer Room site of grace, head straight down a few sets of stairs until you reach a small landing where two crossbow guards are stationed above. Jump over the railing on the landing onto the angled brace, then jump onto the platform with the gazebo. The ashes are in a chest in a room next to the gazebo.

items.name: Cliffbottom Catacombs
items.description: Catacombs found at the bottom of the cliffs in the eastern side of the Liurnia of the Lakes region, now infested by Imps and Ogres

items.name: Cliffbottom Catacombs
items.description: Site of grace at the entrance of the Cliffbottom Catacombs.

items.name: Cloth Garb
items.description: Can be found at the chest at the end of the dungeon in Murkwater Cave

items.name: Cloth Trousers
items.description: Can be found at the chest at the end of the dungeon in Murkwater Cave

items.name: Coastal Cave
items.description: A dark and humid cavern home to the Demi-Human Chief boss. Must be completed to access the Church of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Coastal Cave
items.description: Site of Grace found inside Coastal Cave, near the beginning.

items.name: Coded Sword
items.description: Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Look for an abandoned horse stable, then climb onto its roof and enter the building. Keep going until you find a broken round table. Look for the double door. Inside that room you will find the coded sword.

items.name: Coil Shield
items.description: Located on a body in Volcano Cave, northeast of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite in Mt. Gelmir. You will need to drop down a hole and then double back.

items.name: Collapsing Stars
items.description: Gravity Sorcery. Looted from a chest inside the War-Dead Catacombs. In the main chamber with 4 staircases, drop into the lower level from the left side to find the chest amongst the ghostly knights fighting each other.

items.name: Comet
items.description: Found behind an Illusory Wall before the Debate Hall Site of Grace.

items.name: Comet Azur
items.description: Sorcery. Acquired from Primeval Sorcerer Azur.

items.name: Commander Niall
items.description: Great Enemy. Found in the northeast of the castle, accessible by using the eastern exit of the church and going through the building there.

items.name: Commander O'Neil
items.description: Great Enemy. Drops Commander's Standard and Unalloyed Gold Needle

items.name: Commander's Standard
items.description: Halberd. Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.

items.name: Commoner's Headband
items.description: Head Armor. On the head of one of the big statues facing the large lava lake.

items.name: Commoner's Simple Garb
items.description: Chest Armor. Found on a corpse on the balcony accessible from the Gateside Chamber Site of Grace.

items.name: Concealing Veil
items.description: Talisman dropped by the Black Knife Assassin boss within Sage's Cave

items.name: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
items.description: Hidden by the snowstorm, Catacombs with valuable Grave Glovewort materials 8, 9 and Great Grave Glovewort.

items.name: Consort's Set
items.description: Armor Set. Dropped by Tanith's Knight. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, speak with Tanith then go back to Rykard's body. If you attack her here in his boss area, her knight will invade.

items.name: Conspectus Scroll
items.description: Looted off a body inside a room. From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy, go to the hallway, turn left. You'll see the corpse in front a an illusory wall.

items.name: Converted Fringe Tower
items.description: Tower found on the Fringe, a puzzle seals the rest of the Tower.

items.name: Converted Tower
items.description: An abandoned tower, with a few secrets to loot.

items.name: Converted Tower (Site of Grace)
items.description: Site of grace by the Converted Tower.

items.name: Corpse-Stench Shack
items.description: A small shack in northern Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Crab Eggs
items.description: Found on a body located on the edge. Beware of the small skeleton army you have to face before.

items.name: Crab Eggs
items.description: Find by looting a dead body at the edge of the lake, near Ash of War: Unsheathe location.

items.name: Crab Eggs - Caelid South
items.description: Found on a body underneath a broken cart next to a burnt out campfire and a small red tent.

items.name: Cracked Crystal - 1x Morne Tunnel
items.description: One can be looted off a Miner enemy on the left side of the small shack in Morne Tunnel.

items.name: Cracked Pot - 2x Auriza Side Tomb
items.description: Held by a corpse next to a column, above the water level.

items.name: Cracked Pot - 2x Stormveil Castle
items.description: Found behind the Living Jar enemies between the Secluded Cell and Liftside Chamber (after 2nd shortcut) Sites of Grace.

items.name: Cracked Pot - 3x Jarburg
items.description:
Crafting Pot. Three can be found in the village of Jarburg:
  1. The first is on a corpse in front of the blocked door of a hut north of where you drop down into the village.
  2. The second is in a hut northeast of the first.
  3. The last Cracked Pot is found on a large headstone in the south along the main road in the village.

items.name: Cracked Pot - Caria Manor
items.description: Crafting Pot. Found on the cliffs overlooking the gardens below.

items.name: Cracked Pot - Groveside Cave
items.description: Crafting Pot. Can be found inside Groveside Cave. By the bonfire, there is a body that you can loot to find x1 Cracked Pot.

items.name: Cracked Pot - Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description: Crafting Pot. Found inside a room in the northern area, where you fight the Leyndell Royal Guard.

items.name: Cracked Pot - Minor Erdtree (Caelid)
items.description: Crafting Pot. One found at the end of a tree branch extending from the northwest cliffs behind the tree.

items.name: Cracked Pot - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Can be found at the Raya Lucaria Academy near the Debate Hall door.

items.name: Craftsman's Shack
items.description: A series of wooden huts found directly south of the volcano.

items.name: Craftsman's Shack
items.description: Site of Grace found inside the Craftsman's Shack.

items.name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
items.description: Warhammer. Found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave on a corpse at the end of the large hall locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. This is directly above the room with the flamethrower pillar.

items.name: Crepus's Vial
items.description: Talisman. Dropped by Rileigh the Idle after successfully invading his world.

items.name: Crimson Amber Medallion +1
items.description: Talisman. Found at the top of a room locked behind an imp statue in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

items.name: Crimson Amber Medallion +2
items.description: By falling down the sewers gate, on the beam below, just before fully entering the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

items.name: Crimson Bubbletear
items.description: Physick Flask material. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar guarding this tree.

items.name: Crimson Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal mixed to enhance the effects of the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Located in front of the statue in Third Church of Marika.

items.name: Crimson Crystal Tear
items.description: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Found on an altar at the base of the Minor Erdtree in Capital Outskirts. Guarded by enemies.

items.name: Crimson Hood
items.description: Roderika's questline must be completed and spirit tuning must be unlocked for this item to appear on top of the pile of corpses surrounded by the Rotten Strays where the Chrysalids' Memento was acquired.

items.name: Crimson Seed Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Found in a room inside the Sainted Hero's Grave, locked behind an Imp Statue seal. The room is right in front of the Site of Grace near the entrance and requires a Stonesword Key to unlock.

items.name: Crimson Tear Scarab
items.description: Can be found after jumping off the balcony and making it to the building with the broken window/ half the floor missing, the item is to their left (hop the railing) and a silver scarab to their right (can be killed from the mini bridge).

items.name: Crimsonburst Crystal Tear
items.description: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar boss upon defeat.

items.name: Crimsonspill Crystal Tear
items.description: Flask Upgrade. Dropped by Wormface upon defeat.

items.name: Crimsonwhorl Bubbletear
items.description: On a cliff ledge south of Giants' Gravepost (above the grace point, the ledge is accessed by going north-east from the Foot of the Forge grace point, Just follow the edge of the cliff until you see the path going above Giant's Gravepost).

items.name: Cross-Naginata
items.description: Spear. Found on a corpse inside the Gael Tunnel, in the cavern filled with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus.

items.name: Crossed Legs Gesture
items.description: Gesture. Obtained by interacting with a corpse on a large piece of debris, South of Stormhill Shack.

items.name: Crucible Axe Set
items.description: Armor Set comprised of the Crucible Axe Helm, Crucible Axe Armor, Crucible Gauntlets and the Crucible Greaves. Dropped by Crucible Knight Ordovis upon defeat inside the Auriza Hero's Grave.

items.name: Crucible Feather Talisman
items.description:
Talisman found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave. Reaching it is quite complex:
  1. From the first Chariot Hall, drop down through the opening on either side just before the second ramp.
  2. In the room below, head west and up the steps, then turn right into the next corridor that leads to a large hall with two Chariots running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. Head all the way down towards the pit behind the pillars.
  3. Looking down, you will see several wooden beams that you can drop onto. Navigate your way to the lowest beam and then head south towards the archway with a ladder at the back. Climb the ladder to reach a third Chariot Hall with a single Chariot.
  4. Head all the way down this hall, using the alcove on the left about halfway through to avoid the Chariot (unless you've previously destroyed it). At the bottom, turn left into a corridor and head straight to find a small room guarded by an Omen. The talisman can be found on a corpse behind the Omen, sitting by a statue.

items.name: Crucible Knight
items.description: Found within Stormhill Evergaol, this is a solo fight without Spirit Ashes or player summons. Drops the Incantation Aspects of the Crucible: Tail

items.name: Crucible Knight & Crucible Knight Ordovis
items.description: Duo Boss fight against Crucible Knight Ordovis and a standard Crucible Knight. Awards the entire Crucible Axe Set as well as Ordovis's Greatsword upon defeat.

items.name: Crucible Knight / Misbegotten Warrior
items.description: Dual Bossfight against Crucible Knight and Misbegotten Warrior.

items.name: Crucible Knot Talisman
items.description: Dropped by Omenkiller, located in the Village of the Albinaurics

items.name: Crucible Scale Talisman
items.description: Leyndell Catacombs, Altus Plateau. Found in the mini-dungeon directly behind the fire pillar trap is a room with an Omen enemy guarding the item on an altar.

items.name: Crumbling Beast Grave Depths
items.description: This Site of Grace is right next to the Farum Azula Dragon that you encounter in the bridge, the dragon can be easily skipped to reach this site of grace.

items.name: Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Reached by talking to Melina by the Site of Grace at the Forge of the Giants in Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Crumbling Farum Azula Waygate
items.description: A Teleporter Waygate that transports you to the Crumbling Farum Azula. Requires an Imbued Sword Key.

items.name: Crystal Bud
items.description: Within Ravine-Veiled Village, near Site of Grace.

items.name: Crystal Bud - 1x Academy Gate Town
items.description: Crafting Material. Looted from a corpse in a corner of the destroyed church in the middle section of Academy Gate Town.

items.name: Crystal Bud - 2x - Liurnia Lake Shore
items.description: Found within the proximities of the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace.

items.name: Crystal Bud - 5x Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: You can find x5 at the second floor, on a corpse on the ledge.

items.name: Crystal Burst
items.description: Drops from the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss in the Demi-Human Forest Ruins

items.name: Crystal Dart - 10x Sellia Hideaway
items.description: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway at the bottom of the second room with huge crystal formations

items.name: Crystal Dart - 5x Liurnia Highway North
items.description: Consumable Throwable. Five can be looted off a corpse where a spirit giant spawns and fights regular soldiers.

items.name: Crystal Dart - 5x Raya Lucaria Academy Rooftops
items.description: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the rooftop area of Raya Lucaria Academy, when a Sorcerer and three Avionette Soldiers attack.

items.name: Crystal Dart - 5x Schoolhouse Classroom
items.description: Consumable Throwable Item. Found on a corpse just outside the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace, by some digging aristocrats.

items.name: Crystal Dart - 8x Altus Tunnel
items.description: Offensive Throwable. 8 can be looted off a corpse in the Altus Tunnel. In the first cavern after the Site of Grace, head into the second room on the right to find the corpse sitting by some wreckage.

items.name: Crystal Dart - 8x Caria Manor Upper Cliffs
items.description: Offensive Consumable. Found on a gravestone in the western portion of the upper manor. This area is only accessible by dropping down from a ledge near the entrance to the boss room.

items.name: Crystal Dart - Converted Fringe Tower
items.description: Consumable Throwable. Converted Fringe Tower.

items.name: Crystal Dart - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Looted off a corpse on the broken beam connected to the stars of the Iron ball trap.

items.name: Crystal Dart 4x
items.description: Found on a body being devoured by Rotten Strays in the Consecrated Snowfield

items.name: Crystal Knife
items.description: Dagger. Found in a chest inside the storage room in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel protected by Marionettes.

items.name: Crystal Release
items.description: Sorcery Spell. Dropped by the Crystalians duo bosses inside the Academy Crystal Cave upon their defeat.

items.name: Crystal Spear
items.description: Can be found inside Sellia Hideaway. It can be found in a chest to the right of the entrance of the second room with huge crystal formations. The hidden wall is on the left side of a corpse

items.name: Crystal Staff
items.description: Crystal Staff can be found in Academy Crystal Cave. It's in a room guarded by a sorcerer behind a fog wall, located right before the boss gate. The path to the chest containing the staff is through an illusory rock wall on the left side of the tunnel, just before the stone archway.

items.name: Crystal Sword
items.description: CStraight Sword. Can be found at Village of the Albinaurics. Past the well and the wooden bridge, on a body near the edge.

items.name: Crystal Torrent
items.description: Dropped by Crystalians Trio boss in Sellia Hideaway

items.name: Crystalian (Ring Blade)
items.description: Optional Boss. Found at the bottom-most level of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel. Drops Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (1).

items.name: Crystalian Ashes
items.description: Located in a chest protected by three masked magic users in a room that is located down a pathway up the purple crystals next to the Trio Putrid Crystallin's (bosses) boss door in��Sellia Hideaway.

items.name: Crystalians
items.description: Duo Field Bosses. Found at the end of the Academy Crystal Cave. Drops the Crystal Release sorcery spell upon defeat.

items.name: Crystalians (Altus Tunnel)
items.description: Duo Field Bosses found inside the Altus Tunnel. The Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (2) is obtained upon their defeat.

items.name: Crystalians (Trio - Sellia Hideaway)
items.description: Miniboss Trio fight against Putrid Crystalian's. Crystalian (Spear), Crystalian (Ringblade) & Crystalian (Staff). Damage received from all attacks builds Scarlet Rot. Drop Crystal Torrent

items.name: Crystalline Woods
items.description: Site of Grace found by the Crystalline Woods.

items.name: Cuckoo Glintstone (C)
items.description: Pillage from the body near the golden tree.

items.name: Cuckoo Glintstone (E)
items.description: Crafting Material. Found on the body of the soldier shot to death by the surrounding Marionette Soldiers.

items.name: Cuckoo Glintstone - 10x Eastern Liurnia of the Lakes
items.description: COnsumable Item. Can be found inside a chest in an enemy camp.

items.name: Cuckoo Glintstone - 4x Purified Ruins
items.description: Consumable Item. Four can be found on a dead body, against a wall within Purified Ruins. Beware of the group of Soldiers.

items.name: Cuckoo Glintstone - 5x Converted Tower
items.description: Consumable Item. Five can be found on a desk, inside the Converted Tower.

items.name: Cuckoo Glintstone - Academy Crystal Cave
items.description: Inside the Academy Crystal Cave. On the room full of Sages, turn to the right. It is against the wall.

items.name: Cuckoo's Evergaol
items.description: Evergaol located on the western landmass of Liurnia. Bols, Carian Knight is imprisoned within.

items.name: Cursemark of Death
items.description: Key Item. Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia.

items.name: Curved Sword Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Found in Stormveil Castle, a chest inside a dark room in the Wine Cellar with the Banished Knight.

items.name: D, Hunter of the Dead
items.description: D can be found mourning a person dead at his feet. Here, he will warn you against going any further east towards Summonwater Village.

items.name: D, Hunter of the Dead Summonwater Village
items.description: D may be encountered at the southern entrance of Summonwater Village

items.name: Dagger
items.description: Looted from a Foot Soldier upon defeat.

items.name: Dagger Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Found in a room locked by an imp statue in the Volcano Manor dungeon. The room is opposite the balcony where you find the Volcano Manor Waygate. Once inside, drop down two cages, then look for a red candle behind you that shows an obscure pathway to the talisman.

items.name: Dancer's Castanets
items.description: Key Item. Given by Patches in Shaded Castle, before the boss room, after killing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy and talking to him in Volcano Manor.

items.name: Dappled Cured Meat - Miquella's Haligtree
items.description: Consumable. Found in Miquella's Haligtree, looted from a corpse after two patrolling Oracle Envoy enemies.

items.name: Dappled White Cured Meat - Wyndham Ruins
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse sitting on the ground in Wyndham Ruins, on an enclosed space.

items.name: Dark Moon Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword. Found below the Cathedral of Manus Celes after progressing Ranni's questline.

items.name: Dark Moon Ring
items.description: Quest Item. Found in a locked chest next to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library Site of Grace. Unlocked using the Discarded Palace Key.

items.name: Death Rite Bird (Caelid Southeast)
items.description: Only spawns at night. Southeast from the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank site of grace, before Sellia Gateway. It drops the Death's Poker Greatsword

items.name: Death Rite Bird (Central Mountaintops of the Giants)
items.description: Optional Boss. A large Skeletal Bird found north of Stargazer's Ruins. Drops the Death Ritual Spear upon defeat.

items.name: Death Rite Bird (Consecrated Snowfield)
items.description: Found at the head of the frozen river, just southeast of the Apostate Derelict at night

items.name: Death Rite Bird (Raya Lucaria Academy East)
items.description: Death Rite Bird Miniboss that spawns only at night, south from the Gate Town North site of grace. Drops Ancient Death Rancor.

items.name: Death Ritual Spear
items.description: Spear. Dropped by the Death Rite Bird boss upon defeat.

items.name: Death's Poker
items.description: Greatsword. Dropped by miniboss Death Rite Bird that appears only at night.

items.name: Deathbed Dress
items.description: Found on the bed in the building with the Lower Capital Church grace alonside the Lionel's Set

items.name: Deathbird (Leyndell Capital Outskirts)
items.description: East of the Hermit Merchant's Shack. It drops the Twinbird Kite Shield upon defeat.

items.name: Deathbird (Liurnia of the Lakes South)
items.description: Only spawns at night. North east of the Scenic Isle site of grace in Liurnia under the ruin wall. It drops the Red-Feathered Branchsword

items.name: Deathbird (Stormhill)
items.description: Appears only at night. East of Warmaster's Shack just over the cliff. It drops the Blue-Feathered Branchsword

items.name: Deathbird (Weeping Peninsula)
items.description: Spawns only at night, drops the Sacrificial Axe

items.name: Deathroot - Black Knife Catacombs
items.description: Can be found inside a chest behind the Cemetery Shade in the Black Knife Catacombs.

items.name: Deathroot - Deathtouched Catacombs
items.description: Inside Deathtouched Catacombs. Found on a chest behind the Black Knife Assassin.

items.name: Deathroot - East Liurnia of the Lakes
items.description: Deathroot dropped by Tibia Mariner located at Liurnia of the Lakes

items.name: Deathroot - Gelmir's Hero Grave
items.description: Found inside a chest, located in the same room where you fight the Red Wolf of the Champion.

items.name: Deathroot - Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
items.description: Key Item. Can be found inside a chest after defeating the Ulcerated Tree Spirit Boss inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs.

items.name: Deathroot - Hidden Path to the Haligtree
items.description: Key Item. Found in a chest at the back of the boss room after defeating the Stray Mimic Tear.

items.name: Deathroot - Mountaintops of the Giants
items.description: Obtained when defeating the Tibia Mariner on a ledge between Castle Sol Main Gate and Snow Valley Ruins Overlook.

items.name: Deathroot - Summonwater Village
items.description: Key Item. Obtained upon defeating the Tibia Mariner.

items.name: Deathroot - Wyndham Ruins
items.description: Dropped by the Tibia Mariner Boss.

items.name: Deathtouched Catacombs
items.description: Located west of Saintsbridge, a door with a grieving spirit beside it.

items.name: Deathtouched Catacombs
items.description: Site of grace just inside Deathtouched Catacombs.

items.name: Debate Parlor
items.description: Site of Grace found on the third floor of the Schoolhouse Classroom building. Available to use after defeating the boss Red Wolf of Radagon.

items.name: Decaying Ekzykes
items.description: Optional Boss. Found guarding the Caelid Highway South.

items.name: Dectus Medallion (Left)
items.description: Key Quest Item. Found in a chest that can be reached by climbing the ladder in the tallest tower of Fort Haight.

items.name: Dectus Medallion (Right)
items.description: Key Quest Item. Found in a chest atop the eastern tower in Fort Faroth, accessible via ladder past all the bats on the bottom level.

items.name: Deep Ainsel Well
items.description: A small structure that houses a lift that takes players back underground to Astel, Naturalborn of the Void's boss room.

items.name: Deep Siofra Well
items.description: A small structure that houses a lift that takes players underground to the northern section of the Siofra River.

items.name: Deep Siofra Well
items.description: Site of Grace found outside of the Deep Siofra Well.

items.name: Demi-Human Ashes
items.description: Found within Impaler's Catacombs. Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog

items.name: Demi-Human Chief
items.description: Optional Boss. A duo of Demi-Human bosses found deep within the Coastal Cave. Required to defeat in order to access the Church of Dragon Communion location. Drops the Tailoring Tools and Sewing Needle key items upon defeat.

items.name: Demi-human Forest Ruins
items.description: Demi-Humans congregate here to worship their queen. Defeating her will reward players with the Demi-Human Queen's Staff, which is excellent for beginner mages.

items.name: Demi-human queen
items.description: Demi-Human Queen guarding the site. Drops Crystal Burst and Demi-Human Queen's Staff.

items.name: Demi-Human Queen Gilika
items.description: Field boss found inside the Lux Ruins

items.name: Demi-Human Queen Maggie
items.description: Optional Boss. Found in the northeast section of Hermit Village. Drops a Memory Stone and Golden Rune (1) upon defeat.

items.name: Demi-Human Queen Margot
items.description: Optional Field Boss. Found in the lowest level of the Volcano Cave.

items.name: Demi-Human Queen's Staff
items.description: Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen elite enemy in Demi-Human Forest Ruins.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ash. Found behind a hidden room in the secret passageway of Volcano Manor. After heading in the secret passage, before going downstairs, turn left and go through the hallway full of snails. At the dead end where you get the cookbook, smack the left wall to reveal the hidden room.

items.name: Devourer's Scepter
items.description: Great Hammer. Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.

items.name: Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear
items.description: Physick Flask Material. Found inside a stone receptacle on top of a craggy hill.

items.name: Diallos
items.description: NPC. He leaves the Roundtable Hold and then be found over the corpse of Lanya.

items.name: Diallos - Jarburg
items.description: NPC. If players have completed Volcano Manor, after progressing the Jarburg questline he will appear in one of the shacks, tending to a little jar.

items.name: Diallos - Volcano Manor
items.description: Diallos' second overworld location is in the Volcano Manor drawing room.

items.name: Diallos's Mask
items.description: Dropped by Diallos.

items.name: Digger's Staff
items.description: Drops from Diggers inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.

items.name: Divine Bridge
items.description: Site of Grace found on the Leyndell Divine Bridge.

items.name: Divine Bridge Site of Grace Waygate
items.description: Waygate. At the Divine Bridge Site of Grace. Teleports you you to Isolated Divine Tower. You can reach this area via the transporter trap chest atop the Tower of Return.

items.name: Divine Bridge Waygate
items.description: Waygate. Found at the edge of the bridge where it's been broken, past all the Golems. Transports you past the broken bridge sections directly to the Divine Tower of Limgrave.

items.name: Divine Fortification
items.description: Incantation. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found atop a collapsed stone structure overgrown with yellow moss.

items.name: Divine Tower of Caelid
items.description: Divine Tower located in central Dragonbarrow. Accessed via careful platforming.

items.name: Divine Tower of Caelid: Basement
items.description: Site of Grace found at the bottom of the tower, after a long platforming section to descend the central area of the tower.

items.name: Divine Tower of Caelid: Center
items.description: Site of Grace found on a balcony in the middle floor of the Divine Tower. This is where you enter the tower initially by carefully platforming along the outer edge of the tower.

items.name: Divine Tower of East Altus
items.description: Divine Tower of East Altus.

items.name: Divine Tower of East Altus: Gate
Divine Tower of Limgrave
items.description: Site of grace near the Tower of Limgrave

items.name: Divine Tower of Limgrave
items.description: Accessible only from Stormveil Castle, this location allows the player to activate the power of Godrick's Great Rune.

items.name: Divine Tower of Liurnia
items.description: A tower standing on a lone island. Seems like an event of historical value took place here...

items.name: Divine Tower of Liurnia
items.description: Site of Grace found on an upper floor of the Divine Tower of Liurnia.

items.name: Divine Tower of West Altus
items.description: The entrance to the Divine Tower of West Altus is found at the end of the Sealed Tunnel after going past many illusory walls.

items.name: Divine Tower of West Altus Gate
items.description: The Site of Grace can be found before the great entrance door to the Divine Tower.

items.name: Dominula, Windmill Village
items.description: The ruins of a village of windmills in northern Altus Plateau. Inhabitated by a Godskin Apostle.

items.name: Dozing Cross-Legged Gesture
items.description: Gesture. Found on a corpse on the largest roof in the area. Accessible from the top floor of the Rampart Tower with careful platforming.

items.name: Draconic Tree Sentinel
items.description: Non-Boss variant of the Draconic Tree Sentinel found at the end of the Great Bridge, guarding the final area of Crumbling Farum Azula. Drops the Malformed Dragon Set upon defeat.

items.name: Draconic Tree Sentinel (Capital Outskirts)
items.description: Field Boss. Defeating it is required to enter Leyndell, Royal Capital. Found right outside the capital's entrance. Drops the Dragon Greatclaw and Dragonclaw Shield upon defeat.

items.name: Dragon Communion Seal
items.description: Found in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave. Progress down the tunnel with the mechanized chariot until the path splits and you can go either up or down. Go up until you reach the end of the tunnel and inside the small room is an enemy that once killed will give you the weapon.

items.name: Dragon Cult Prayerbook
items.description: Dropped by a knight patrolling immediately south of the Liurnia Artist Shack

items.name: Dragon Greatclaw
items.description: Colossal Weapon that drops from the Draconic Tree Sentinel

items.name: Dragon Heart (Borealis the Freezing Fog)
items.description: Key Consumable. Dropped by Borealis, The Freezing Fog upon defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Decaying Ekzykes)
items.description: Dropped by Decaying Ekzykes in South Caelid. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Elder Dragon Greyoll)
items.description: Key Consumable. 5 Hearts are dropped by Elder Dragon Greyoll upon her defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Flying Dragon Agheel)
items.description: Key Consumable. Dropped by Flying Dragon Agheel. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Flying Dragon Greyll)
items.description: Key Consumable. Dropped by Flying Dragon Greyll upon defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Glintstone Dragon Adula)
items.description: Key Consumable. 3 Hearts by Glintstone Dragon Adula upon defeating it at the Cathedral of Manus Celes. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Glintstone Dragon Smarag)
items.description: Key Consumable. Drops from Glintstone Dragon Smarag upon defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Great Wyrm Theodorix)
items.description: Key Consumable. 3 Hearts are dropped by Great Wyrm Theodorix upon his defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Magma Wyrm - Gael Tunnel)
items.description: Key Consumable. Dropped by the Magma Wyrm boss inside Gael Tunnel. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Magma Wyrm - Mt. Gelmir Lava Pool)
items.description: Key Consumable. Dropped by the Magma Wyrm boss found in the lava pool west of Mt. Gelmir. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Magma Wyrm - Volcano Manor)
items.description: Key Consumable. Dropped by the Magma Wyrmboss in Volcano Manor. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Magma Wyrm Makar)
items.description: Key Consumable. Dropped by Magma Wyrm Makar upon defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Heart (Moonlight Altar Dragons)
items.description: Key Consumable. Dropped by Dragons upon defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragon Temple
items.description: Found after passing through the platform that is below the Ancient Dragon that can be seen from a distance.

items.name: Dragon Temple Altar
items.description: This Site of Grace becomes available after defeating the Godskin Duo.

items.name: Dragon Temple Lift
items.description: Site of Grace found by ascending the lift. The entrance to the lift is locked behind an Imp Statue seal that requires 2x Stonesword Keysto unlock.

items.name: Dragon Temple Rooftop
items.description: Site of Grace found atop the large structure in the north section of the region.

items.name: Dragon Temple Transept
items.description: Site of Grace found to the southeast of the bottom level of the Dragon Temple, serving as an alternate route to the Godskin Duo boss fight. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, turn around and face west then jump onto the crumbled ledges below to reach the bottom level. From here, head into the central archway and then turn right to find a hidden crypt with several sarcophagi. Go through the long crumbled hallway in the east to find the Transept site of grace in the corner of the next section.

items.name: Dragon Towershield
items.description: Greatshield. Found in a chest in the terrace section of a building far to the bottom of the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. This building can be reached by dropping down a series of cliffs east of the plaza until you see the archway leading into the building. Follow the linear path from here to a lower balcony with a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the terrace and look to the east to find the chest by the railings.

items.name: Dragon-Burnt Ruins
items.description: Located in the lake of Limgrave.

items.name: Dragonbarrow Cave
items.description: Optional Dungeon found in eastern Dragonbarrow. The entrance is found by following the road along the cliffs north of the Minor Erdtree.

items.name: Dragonbarrow Cave
items.description: Site of Grace by the entrance to Dragonbarrow Cave.

items.name: Dragonbarrow West
items.description: Site of Grace found in western Dragonbarrow.

items.name: Dragonbolt Blessing
items.description: Found inside a chest at Stormcaller Church

items.name: Dragonclaw
items.description: Incantation. Can be obtained by making a Dragon Heart offering at the altar found in the ruins of the Church of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragonclaw Shield
items.description: Greatshield that drops from the Draconic Tree Sentinel guarding the path into the capital.

items.name: Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Found in a chest on an elevated platform inside the large building in the northeast, guarded by several Pests. This platform can be reached by heading through the eastern exit from the Drainage Channel site of grace and then navigating across the branches and concrete beams to reach the roof of the building. While there are many branches and beams to traverse, the path is fairly linear. Once on the roof, drop through one of the holes onto the wooden beams below and then carefully make your way onto the platform after killing the Pests from range.

items.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
items.description: Talisman found on one of the edges of Bestial Sanctum

items.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1
items.description: Can be found in a locked imp's room in Sainted Hero's Grave.

items.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +2
items.description: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse on a chunk of floating debris in the north of the region. From the Dragon Temple Lift site of grace, take the lift back down and then head east and down the spiral staircase. Around halfway down the steps where you see some broken railings, jump off the edge to a series of floating debris below. Once you reach the lowest platforms, turn around and look for a small platform underneath one of the upper ones to find the corpse with the talisman.

items.name: Dragonfire
items.description: Incantation. Can be obtained by making a Dragon Heart offering at the altar found in the ruins of the Church of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragonlord Placidusax
items.description:
Optional Boss found near the tempest. Drops the Remembrance of the Dragonlord upon defeat. To reach this boss:
  1. From the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace, take the lift back down and head back towards the entrance of the building.
  2. From the entrance, head for cliffs directly west and look down at the edge for a series of ledges you can drop down onto.
  3. Follow the floating platforms towards the tempest where you will find a large chunk of building debris with decorative frames containing skeletal remains. Look for the empty frame which will have a prompt for you to Lie Down. Doing so will teleport you to the boss' arena.

items.name: Dragonmaw
items.description: Incantation. Can be obtained by making a Dragon Heart offering at the altar found in the ruins of the Church of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease
items.description: Found on a body at the stairs.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease (A)
items.description: Looted off a corpse behind the Glintstone Dragon Smarag.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease (A) - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Weapon Coating. On a corpse hanging off the edge of the curved platform.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease (B)
items.description: At the end of the corridor, in front of a giant door, NW of Avenue Balcony site of grace.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease (B) - 2x Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Weapon Coating. A set of 2 on a corpse near the center of the Dragon Temple which can only be accessed by circling around the back of the temple in the east. From the site of grace, head inside the archway and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right and another left into a very long hallway. At the end of this hallway is a semi-outdoors area with pillars and a set of stairs on the left. Head up the stairs and follow the hallway to find a corpse holding the item on a ledge on the left in the crumbled section at the end.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease (C) - 2x Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Weapon Coating. A set of 2 can be found on a corpse by the very edge of the cliffs southwest of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease - 4x Sage's Cave
items.description: Consumable. Found in a chest in Sage's Cave.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease - Abandoned Cave
items.description: Weapon Coating. Found on a corpse inside the Abandoned Cave.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease - Divine Tower of Caelid
items.description: Weapon Coating. Can be found on one of the 4 bodies sitting, at the base of the tower.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease -1x Atlus Plateau
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse hanging from the edge atop of the collapsed bridge in Altus Plateau, near the Goldmask NPC.

items.name: Drainage Channel
items.description: Site of Grace found in the drainage channels of Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. This area is accessed by dropping down a ladder found inside an alcove along the inner walls. This requires you to traverse the first lake of rot found after the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace.

items.name: Drake Knight Set
items.description: Armor Set comprised of the Drake Knight Helm, Drake Knight Armor, Drake Knight Gauntlets and the Drake Knight Greaves. This set can be acquired once you reach the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Use the red roof below the grace to reach the rooftop garden-like area in the northeast which has a rotunda structure with a lift inside. The lift can't be used initially so drop down onto the large red roof to the south, then down the walkway to the east. Check along the northeast edge of this walkway for a platform you can jump onto to reach the rotunda building's lower balcony. The armor set can be found in a chest at the northeast end of this balcony.

items.name: Drawing-Room Key
items.description: Key Item. Given by Tanith after pledging your allegiance to the Volcano Manor.

items.name: Drawstring Fire Grease (B)
items.description: Turn back from the Forbidden Lands site of grace, head to the body to obtain x2 Drawstring Fire Grease

items.name: Drawstring Fire Grease - 2x The Shaded Castle
items.description: Found on a body in the corner between some rubble and a sunken building.

items.name: Drawstring Fire Grease - 3x Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Consumable. Can be found on a corpse at Mt. Gelmir near the Minor Erdtree and the broken bridge.

items.name: Drawstring Fire Grease - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Two of them can be looted from a corpse located at Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Drawstring Holy Grease - Flame Peak
items.description: Weapon Coating. Found on a body near a giant rock.

items.name: Drawstring Lightning Grease - 2x Northwest Caelid
items.description: Consumable Item. Two can be found on a corpse by the side of the road guarded by a Zombie Dog.

items.name: Duelist's Furled Finger
items.description: Creates competitive multiplayer summon sign.

items.name: Dung Eater (Royal Capital Moat)

items.name: Dung Eater (Subterranean Shunning-Grounds)
items.description: Quest NPC. Found in a cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the Royal Capital. To reach his cell, head northeast from the Underground Roadside site of grace and enter a grate in the floor to access the aqueducts. Continue north past the Rats and Giant Poison Flower and climb up the ladder. You can find the cell door in the next room past the ladder. It is unlocked using the Sewer-Gaol Key given by the same NPC but in his non-corporeal form at the Roundtable Hold.

NOTE it is slightly above the bottom floor so do not jump off even if you will survive. If you miss that coffin, you will have to start from the beginning of the coffin descend all over to obtain the shield.

items.name: Frenzied's Cookbook [2]

Behind the altar in Mohg, the Omen's boss room is a hidden path which can be opened by attacking the altar behind the chest after the boss fight. Following the the hidden path, there are stairs down and will lead to collapsed rafters that you can cross; you can cross the path and follow the stairs down for a safer route, or drop directly below on second set of collapsed rafters. On the second set of rafters, you will need to drop down to the lowest set of them, and you will find Frenzied's Cookbook [2] on a sitting corpse
