items.name: Full Moon Crossbow
items.description:
Weapon. From the Debate Parlor Site of Grace, head out into the courtyard and to the left to reach the rooftops. Continue along the rooftops until the tower past the Glintstone Sorcerer and three Avionette Soldiers. Across from the tower on another rooftop, an item will be visible. Drop down to the rooftop below and jump on top of the spike near the right edge. From the spike, turn left and jump onto the gargoyle (architectural, not an enemy) protruding from a corner of the building. Another jump will bring you to the rooftop with the item, a Smithing Stone [4]. Alternatively, you can reach this item by jumping from the tower onto a roof opposite the Full Moon Crossbow's chest in the tower.
From that roof, a long jump will be required to reach the rooftops with the patrolling Marionette Soldier with spears. Sprinting before the jump is required, as a normal jump will not cover the distance. Note that there is a delay before sprinting starts (likely to determine whether the player is trying to roll or sprint).
Continue along the rooftops to the left, past the four Marionette Soldiers and jump onto a platform connected to a tower. Inside, two Marionette Soldiers will ambush you from either side. Climb up the ladder to find a chest with the Full Moon Crossbow.

items.name: Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast
items.description: Optional Field Boss found high up in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
items.description: Dropped by Old Knight Istvan after successfully invading his world.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
items.description: Dropped by Rileigh the Idle after successfully invading his world.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
items.description: Multiplayer Item. Dropped by Great Horned Tragoth after successfully invading his world.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
items.description: Multiplayer Item. Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
items.description: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse sitting at the edge of a cliff in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
items.description: Can be looted from Bloody Finger Nerijus

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
items.description: One is held by a corpse at Stormveil Castle, reached by descending through the stairs beside Stormveil Front Gates Site of Grace

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
items.description: Can be found at Stormveil Castle on the main gate.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy - 1x Castle Morne
items.description: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse to the right of the gallows on the top level on the castle. This area is accessed by hugging the right wall from the main courtyard area, past the burning corpses and harpies and then following the linear path to reach the roof.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy - 1x Leyndell Royal Capital
items.description: Found on a body in the room with the fire.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy - Highroad Cave
items.description:
Furlcalling Finger Remedy can be dropped in

Highroad Cave

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy - Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse laying on an altar in a chapel-like room within the eastern capital ramparts.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy - Revenger's Shack
items.description: Multiplayer Item. Dropped by Edgar the Revenger upon defeat.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy - Smoldering Church
items.description: Multiplayer Item. Dropped by invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when defeated.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy A
items.description: Reveals co-op and hostile summoning. Dropped by Recusant Henricus when invading.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy D
items.description: Dropped by the invader Festering Fingerprint Vyke.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy E
items.description: Looted off a corpse hanging on the fence of the second-floor balcony. The nearest site of grace is the Schoolhouse Classroom in Raya Lucaria Academy.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy F
items.description: Looted off a corpse in the middle part of the Iron Ball trap stairs.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy H
items.description: Can be looted off from a corpse once you head straight inside the Tombsward Cave.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy I
items.description: Multiplayer Item. Found under a wooden walkway in the eastern section of the castle.

items.name: Gael Tunnel
items.description: Alexander can be found inside for the second time.

items.name: Gael Tunnel (Site of Grace)
items.description: Site of grace located inside Gael Tunnel. Found once you reach the lower level.

items.name: Gaol Cave
items.description: A cave locked behind two Stone Sword Key seals. The cave has a second exit on the coast North-West of Fort Gael, where the Regalia of Eochaid can be found.

items.name: Gaol Cave
items.description: Site of Grace within Gaol Cave

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
items.description: Greataxe. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
items.description: Twinblades. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd
items.description: Halberd dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum.

items.name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
items.description: Greatsword dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum.

items.name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
items.description: Dropped byGargoyle. From the Outer Wall Phantom Tree.Site of Grace go northeast the Slope/long Stairs up until it spawns.

items.name: Gargoyle's Halberd
items.description: Dropped by the Lesser Black Blade Kindred.

items.name: Gate Town Bridge
items.description: Site of Grace found on the top of the broken bridge.

items.name: Gatefront Ruins
items.description: Heavily Guarded Area. A Map fragment, some weapons and hidden cellar offer notable loot.

items.name: Gatekeeper Gostoc
items.description: Gatekeeper Gostoc can be found by the entrance of Stormveil Castle, in the room next to the main gate into the castle

items.name: Gatekeeper Gostoc (Final Location)
items.description: Gatekeeper Gostoc can be located in the��Throne Room in Stormveil Castle��for his final location.

items.name: Gateside Chamber
items.description: Site of Grace found through an archway accessible from within the castle walls. There is a lever in this chamber that opens up the castle's main gate.

items.name: Gavel of Haima
items.description: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower.

items.name: Gelmir Hero's Grave
items.description: Optional Dungeon. The entrance can be reached by walking along the long jagged rock extending from the north of Hermit Village across the chasm.

items.name: Gelmir Hero's Grave
items.description: Site of Grace found inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave, near the entrance after descending the lift.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Set
items.description: You can loot the entire Gelmir Knight Set in the Gelmir Hero's Grave dungeon from a Gelmir Knight corpse. To find the corpse, head down the first Chariot hallway until you see a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop down into the left pit onto some wooden beams and look for a small window along the walls. Head through this window and down the ladder to find a Bloodhound Knight guarding the corpse.

items.name: Gelmir's Fury
items.description: Glintstone Sorcery. Given by Resucant Bernahl after completing three contracts for Tanith at Volcano Manor.

items.name: Ghiza's Wheel
items.description: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by Inquisitor Ghiza in Volcano Manor.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [1] - Stormfoot Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found behind the second flamethrower pillar.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [1] - Tombsward Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found in the bottom level of the first room with a second floor, near the back.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [2] - Impaler's Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found under the impaler lift, right by the entrance to the next corridor.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [2] - Laskyar Ruins drop
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the Grafted Scion enemy that spawns in the middle of Laskyar Ruins before the Waygate Gazebo.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [2] - Road's End Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. In the room with the boss' door lever, drop down one level and hit the wall under the arch in the back, closest to the stairs to dispel it and reveal a hidden corridor where the glovewort can be found.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [3] - Caelid Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Caelid Catacombs. Continue along the dungeon until you reach a room with a small set of stairs on the left. The glovewort can be found further down after turning the corner, just before the next corridor.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [3] - Cliffbottom Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. In the large multi-level hall, drop down to the very bottom via the gaps on either side of the central stair-bridge. Check around the corridors of this bottom pit for several items, one of which is a Ghost Glovewort (3).

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [4] - Caelid Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Caelid Catacombs. Continue along the dungeon until you reach a room with a small set of stairs on the left. The glovewort can be found further down after turning the corner, just before the next corridor.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [4] - Minor Erdtree Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs. After descending the lift, step on its pressure plate again to send it up and immediately jump off. Drop down into the opening and head into the scarlot rot-flooded corridor to find the glovewort, by the narrow opening on the right.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [4] - Sainted Hero's Grave
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave, in the room with the Grave Warden Duelist.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [4] - The Shaded Castle
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on one of the rocks near the dead tree at the western end of the outer courtyard of The Shaded Castle.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [4] - War-Dead Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the War-Dead Catacombs. In the main chamber with the 4 staircases, drop into the lower level and search the northeast corner for a corridor that leads to another room. Check the back of this room past the arches to find the glovewort.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [5] - Auriza Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave:
  • In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps. The glovewort can be found at the very end of the following corridor.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [5] - Sainted Hero's Grave
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave, in the back of the room with the Grave Warden Duelist.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [5] - Unsightly Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found by the wall in the pit you drop into from the L-shaped staircase.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [6]
items.description: At Auriza Hero's Grave, can be found while passing the third part of the giant chariots, on a small platform in the middle.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [6] - Auriza Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave:
  • In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps and then turn right into the next corridor. Follow the path to a second Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them. As you exit into this hall, turn left to find two ramps. In between them in the back is a small opening where the glovewort can be found.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [6] - Auriza Side Tomb
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Auriza Side Tomb:
  • Precise location to be added

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [6] - Wyndham Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in the sewer area amongst the Putrid Corpses.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [7] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in a cluster of graves far to the northeast.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [7] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on a grave in the western section of the graveyard northeast of the city.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [7] - Gelmir Hero's Grave
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One is found in the Gelmir Hero's Grave. From the first Chariot hallway, head down until just before the central concrete walkway ends and jump into the alcove on the left. Head into the room it connects to and walk up the steps in the back to find the glovewort against the back wall.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [7] - Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs:
  • Follow the main path until you reach the first lift. Descend it and then send it back up to reveal a second platform in the lift that will take you to the lowest levels of the catacombs. From here, continue past the room with the Lesser Burial Watchdog to a corridor with a frost breath trap. Continue past this trap to a second corridor with another frost breath trap at the end. Halfway through this second corridor, hit the wall on the right to reveal an alcove where the ghost glovewort can be found.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [8] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on a grave in the southwest end of the graveyard in the northeast of the city.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [9] - 1x Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
items.description: Ghost Glovewort found in a room with 2 Cleanrot Knights.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [9] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on a grave in the western section of the graveyard in the northwest of the building.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [9] - Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave.
  • To left of the locked door that leads to the boss, behind the Troll.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [9] - Ordina, Liturgical Town
items.description: It is dropped by an invisible warrior found by entering first the evergaol, you can defeat him by paying attention to the footprints on the ground.

items.name: Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]
items.description: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the western section of the graveyard in the northeast of the city.

items.name: Giant Golem
items.description: Dormant Golem guarding the divine bridge.

items.name: Giant Rat Ashes
items.description: Can be found in a wooden shack located left of the windwill.

items.name: Giant's Prayerbook
items.description: Key Item. Give to a Cleric to unlock Incantations: Giantsflame Take Thee and Flame, Fall Upon Them for purchase.

items.name: Giant's Seal
items.description:
Sacred Seal found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave:
  • In the large hall with the Troll, drop down from either side of the platform into a room with a Prelate. Defeat it and check the right side of the room for a corpse holding the seal.
  • Alternatively, you can reach this room by descending the lift and sending it back up. Pull the lever in the alcove to the right and then enter the small space in the raised lift to descend further down. In the next hall, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn left. Climb the ladder at the end of this path.

items.name: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
items.description: A complex dungeon filled with invulnerable enemies and strange golden floor seals.

items.name: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
items.description: Site of Grace found near the beginning of the dungeon.

items.name: Giant-Crusher
items.description: Colossal Weapon. Can be found in a chest inside an unmarked military camp directly to the south of Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace.

items.name: Giants' Gravepost
items.description: Site of grace at the edge of the hanging chain. Near a map shard.

items.name: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
items.description: The Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs is found in the Mountaintops of the Giants region.

items.name: Gilded Iron Shield
items.description: Shield. Found on a corpse sitting on a grave in the graveyard.

items.name: Glass Shard - Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Material. Found on the farthest corpse of a trio of corpses outside Seethewater Cave in Mt. Gelmir

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1]
items.description: Dropped by one of the Nobles in that enemy outpost.

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2]
items.description: Found in a corpse just by the Laskyar Ruins Site of Grace. Unlocks crafting of Freezing Grease.

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3]
items.description: Cookbook Key Item. Found on a corpse on a wooden walkway in an upper level of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia.

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4]
items.description: Key Item. Found at Academy Gate Town inside a chest within a tower on the rooftop of a destroyed building.

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5]
items.description: Looted from a treasure chest inside a room. From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy, go to the hallway, turn left.

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [6]
items.description: Cookbook Key Item. Found on a corpse in a small room southeast of the gardens.

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [8]
items.description: Can be found in the Consecrated Snowfield, southwest of Albinauric's Rise. There are 3 Schools of Graven Mages encircling a corpse with the Cookbook.

items.name: Glintstone Dragon Adula (Cathedral of Manus Celes)
items.description: Great Enemy. This dragon is first found roaming the Three Sisters sub-region in the north. After dealing enough damage to it, it will teleport here outside the Cathedral of Manus Celes. Drops 3x Dragon Hearts and the Adula's Moonblade spell upon defeat.

items.name: Glintstone Dragon Adula (Three Sisters)
items.description: Great Enemy. Found roaming the sub-region of Three Sisters. The dragon cannot be killed here and will teleport to the Cathedral of Manus Celes in the very south of the region after being brought to about 50% HP.

items.name: Glintstone Dragon Smarag
items.description: A fearsome magic dragon with crystalized magic formation for scales. Guards the Academy Glintstone Key. Also drops a Dragon Heart upon defeat.

items.name: Glintstone Firefly - 3x Deep Siofra Well Ravine
items.description: Crafting Material. 3x found in the crystal cluster in the ravine south of the Deep Siofra Well.

items.name: Glintstone Firefly - 4x
items.description: You can loot 4 on a corpe that is on the side of the building.

items.name: Glintstone Firefly - 4x Kingsrealm Ruins
items.description: Crafting Material. Four can be looted from a corpse near the ghost that tells you about the area.

items.name: Glintstone Firefly - 5x Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: You can find x5 Glintstone Firefly Looted off a corpse, north section of the courtyard.

items.name: Glintstone Firefly - 6x Caria Manor Gardens
items.description: Crafting Material. Six can be looted from a corpse in the garden. Beware of an ambush by many Giant Hands in this area.

items.name: Glintstone Scarab
items.description: Found inside a chest. From the garden section where you encountered the hostile NPC Moongrum Carian Knight, go west, by the gate, hug the wall and jump over the fence. Follow the path and then climb the ladder. The chest is inside the room at the top of the ladder.

items.name: Glintstone Scrap - 6x Altus Tunnel
items.description: Offensive Consumable. Found inside the Altus Tunnel. In the second cavern, head through the tunnel in the south to find a wooden balcony overlooking a pit. Drop down onto the overgrown root on the left side to reach a lower balcony below where you can find the item on a corpse.

items.name: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes
items.description: Inside Road's End Catacombs. Defeat the Spirit-Caller Snail to obtain.

items.name: Glintstone Whetblade
items.description: Looted off a corpse that is hanging on the fence of an office balcony. From the fountain of the academy's courtyard, go west and head up the slope. The office is in front of the group of kneeling Noble Zombies.

items.name: Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1]
items.description: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog boss of the Wyndham Catacombs

items.name: Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2]
items.description: Bell Bearing. Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit Boss fought inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs.

items.name: Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]
items.description: Key Item. Found inside a gazebo by the shallow pond infested by Lesser Wormfaces. You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the southern cliffs.

items.name: Glowstone - 4x Sellia Hideaway
items.description: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway guarded by two Sorcerer Miner.

items.name: Glowstone - 5x Stillwater Cave
items.description: Consumable Item. Five can be looted off a corpse on the walkway leading to the boss area, where you are ambushed by three bats.

items.name: Glowstone - Earthbore Cave
items.description: Can be found at Earthbore Cave on a dead body.

items.name: Glowstone - Limgrave
items.description: Can be found on a corpse. Beware of the two goblins that will spawn near it.

items.name: Godefroy the Grafted
items.description: Optional Boss. Imprisoned within the Golden Lineage Evergaol. Drops the Godfrey Icon upon defeat.

items.name: Godfrey Icon
items.description: Talisman. Dropped by Godefroy the Grafted when defeated.

items.name: Godfrey, First Elden Lord (Golden Shade)
items.description: This is a spectral shade of Godfrey that is encountered in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Drops a Talisman Pouch.

items.name: Godrick Soldier Ashes
items.description: Found at the Cemetery at the west of Stormhill that is filled with Spirit Jellyfish, next to a grave. Check both sides of each grave to find it.

items.name: Godrick the Grafted
items.description: The Lord of Stormveil and the first Demigod encountered. Drops Godrick's Great Rune and Remembrance of the Grafted upon defeat.

items.name: Godrick the Grafted
items.description: Site of Grace inside Godrick the Grafted's boss arena. Accessible after defeating him.

items.name: Godrick's Great Rune
items.description: Dropped as a reward for defeating Godrick the Grafted located at Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Godskin Apostle (Altus Plateau)
items.description: Can be found at Windmill Heights. Drops Godskin Peeler and Scouring Black Flame

items.name: Godskin Apostle (Caelid)
items.description: Great Enemy. Found at the basement of the Divine Tower of Caelid (See page for how to reach). Drops the Godskin Apostle Set upon defeat.

items.name: Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble
items.description: Consecutive boss fight at the end of the Spiritcaller's Cave, first against a Godskin Apostle and then a Godskin Noble. Defeating them awards the Godskin Swaddling Cloth talisman.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Set
items.description: Armor set comprised of the Godskin Apostle Hood, Godskin Apostle Robe, Godskin Apostle Bracers and Godskin Apostle Trousers. Dropped by the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid upon his defeat.

items.name: Godskin Duo
items.description: The Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble are encountered once again in a simultaneous boss encounter in the center of the Dragon Temple. Drops Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (4) and Ashes of War: Black Flame Tornado upon defeat.

items.name: Godskin Noble (Divine Tower of Liurnia)
items.description: Field boss guarding the bridge to the Divine Tower of Liurnia. Only accessible after progressing Ranni's questline and acquiring the Carian Inverted Statue, allowing access to a secret area in Carian Study Hall leading to the bridge.

items.name: Godskin Noble Set
items.description: Armor Set comprised of the Godskin Noble Hood, Godskin Noble Robe, Godskin Noble Bracelets and the Godskin Noble Trousers. Dropped by Godskin Noble Boss.

items.name: Godskin Noble(Volcano Manor)
items.description: Can be found at Volcano Manor. From the Guest Hall Site of Grace, head east across the lava and up the rooftops until you reach a stone platform with a cage elevator. Take the elevator up, go up the stairs, and activate the switch to lower the drawbridge back to the Prison Town Church Site of Grace. Then head up the last set of stairs into the church to fight the Noble.

items.name: Godskin Peeler
items.description: Dropped by the Godskin Apostle fought at the Windmill Village.

items.name: Godskin Prayerbook
items.description: Can be found at Stormveil Castle, Nearest Site of Grace: Rampart Tower. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, go out the door to the outside (where the birds are). Take a running jump onto the roof across from the door. On the left side of the roof, there will be two separate areas you can drop down to. Drop down to the one without stairs on it, and drop down again. You'll land by a set of steps going down. Go down the steps to find some rats and a white fog wall. You'll need a Stonesword Key to pass through the fog wall, and inside will be two chests. One contains the Godskin Prayerbook, the other contains the Godslayer's Seal. Alternatively, from the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace, exit from the door to the courtyard and turn right. Hug the right side wall past all the enemies. You'll find the set of stairs going down on the wall on the other side.

items.name: Godskin Stitcher
items.description: Dropped by Godskin Noble

items.name: Godskin Swaddling Cloth
items.description: Talisman. Dropped by the Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble upon their defeat in the Spiritcaller's Cave.

items.name: Godslayer's Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword found in a chest in a room behind the Godskin Apostle's arena at the Divine Tower of Caelid after defeating him.

items.name: Godslayer's Seal
items.description: Found in a room barred by an Imp Statue seal, requiring a to access. From the Rampart Tower, take the lift that leads to the Grafted Scion's hall. Exit into the courtyard where plenty of Castle Guards are mounted on ballistae. Take a hard left from this exit to find a small stairway leading into a cellar. There are several Rats in this cellar and the Imp Statue barrier behind them. The Seal is found in one of the chests behind the barrier.

items.name: Gold Firefly
items.description: Found 3 on a body laying on the middle of a road.

items.name: Gold Firefly
items.description: Can be found some at Tower of Return area in the water pond.

items.name: Gold Firefly
items.description: Can be found near waters close to Minor Erdrees.

items.name: Gold Firefly - 2x The Shaded Casle
items.description: 2 Gold fireflies can be found on a body at the end of a room full of statues. There are 2 Page enemies within this room as well, 1 hidden behind the statues and one on top of the stairs.

items.name: Gold Sewing Needle
items.description: Sewing needle made of gold. Unique item made to alter demigod attire. Located inside a chest at the right of Church of Vows' main entrance.

items.name: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot
items.description: Near the waterfall, beware of the lurking skeletons

items.name: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot - Limgrave
items.description: Can be found at the base of the crucifix on a small hill.

items.name: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot - Sealed Tunnel
items.description: Consumable. Found inside the Sealed Tunnel. At the bottom of the chamber with the lift, dispel two illusory walls to the south and walk on the overgrown root in the next chamber. Drop down onto another root below and loot the corpse hanging off of it for the item.

items.name: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Can be found at a stone balcony, above one of the rooms.

items.name: Gold-Tinged Excrement
items.description: Can be found at Earthbore Cave on some dead bodies

items.name: Golden Arrow - 14x Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Bow Ammunition. A set of 14 found on a corpse at the edge of a floating platform adjoined to a long chunk of debris as you traverse the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple.

items.name: Golden Arrow - 5x Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Bow Ammunition. Found on the back of the Minor Erdtree in Mt. Gelmir

items.name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
items.description: Greatshield. Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.

items.name: Golden Centipede
items.description: Found on the ground in front of the altar at the Church of Pilgrimage

items.name: Golden Centipede - Minor Erdtree Church
items.description: Crafting Material. Many can be found at the base of the Minor Erdtree.

items.name: Golden Epitaph
items.description: Straight Sword. Found on a corpse in a room locked behind an Imp Statue Seal just past the Site of Grace. Use a Stonesword Key to unlock the seal and beware the Basilisk guarding the treasure.

items.name: Golden Great Arrow - 10x Sage's Cave
items.description: Consumable Ammunition. Found in a chest in Sage's Cave.

items.name: Golden Halberd

items.description: Incantation Tome. From the Erdtree Sanctuary site in Leyndell, Royal Capital, exit the east side of the room. Once outside, climb up the root to the left that circles back into the building's 2nd floor. Once inside, exit the only door and immediately turn left to jump down to a nearby roof. Once on the roof, a broken window can be used to get back inside. After entering the broken window, climb the root crossing the room to reach the Golden Order Principia, which is located in the chair hanging from the ceiling.

items.description: The second body on the staircase in the main road.

items.name: Golden Rune [12] B - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Rune Consumable. After dropping down the pit into a narrow hallway in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple, ignore the first archway on the left and enter the second one instead. The rune is on a corpse at the edge of the crumbled section here.

items.name: Golden Rune [12] C - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on the broken spiral staircase in the center of the Dragon Temple. Requires circling around the back of the temple in the east to reach it. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, head inside the archway and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right and then a left into a long hallway that leads to a semi-open area with pillars and a set of stairs on the left. Head up the stairs and follow the hallway to a crumbled section where you can jump onto the aforementioned spiral staircase. The rune is found on a corpse on the top end of it.

items.name: Golden Rune [12] D - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on an upper level east of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple. From the lift, head east and down the stairs past a tree. Climb up the ledges at the end of the path to reach the upper level and head south. The rune is found on a corpse under a tree in this area.

items.name: Golden Rune [12] E - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse at the edge of some floating debris in the northern section of the region. From the Dragon Temple Lift site of grace, take the lift back down and then head east and down the spiral staircase. Around halfway down the steps where you see some broken railings, jump off the edge to a series of floating debris below. Look for one of the chunks facing southward to find the corpse holding the rune.

items.name: Golden Rune [12] F - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse in the upper crumbled segment west of the Dragon Temple, right next to where Alexander is standing if you followed his questline. To get up here, you need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section.

items.name: Golden Rune [12] G - Crumbling Farum Azula

items.name: Golden Rune [4] - The Shaded Castle
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse laying on the outer edges of the northwestern building. You can reach this area by climbing a ladder along the western walls of the main keep's grounds.

items.name: Golden Rune [4] - Wyndham Ruins
items.description: Consumable. Can be found on a sprawled out body in Wyndham Ruins, to the left of a huge archway.

items.name: Golden Rune [4] A - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Looted from a dead body hanging from the higher level.

items.name: Golden Rune [4] B - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Found on one of the dead bodies at the ramp in the northern section of the main courtyard.

items.name: Golden Rune [4] C
items.description: Found right next to a huge stone, on the ground.

items.name: Golden Rune [5]
items.description: Found by looting the sarcophagi.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] -  Sellia Hideaway
items.description: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway

items.name: Golden Rune [5] -  Sellia Hideaway B
items.description: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway, at the bottom of a pit.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - 1x Perfumer's Ruins
items.description: Located on one of the south facing walls, where the main table with the candles is.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - 2x Sealed Tunnel
items.description:
Rune Consumable. A total of 2 can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel:
  1. From the Site of Grace, look at the west wall for a section that looks slightly off. Attack or roll towards it to dispel the illusory wall revealing a hidden path. In the next chamber, look for a set of wooden stairs leading to a platform where a corpse with the first rune can be found.
  2. At the bottom of the chamber with the lift, dispel an illusory wall in the south to find a corpse with the second rune.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - Caelid's South West Sarcophagi
items.description: Found at the sarcophagi located at South-West Caelid.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - Forsaken Ruins
items.description: Looted at the Forsaken Ruins.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - Liurna's West Sarcophagi
items.description: Found within the sarcophagi in West Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - Liurnia's North Sarcophagi
items.description: Looted from the many sarcophagi within the area. Watch out for the Giant Rats.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Looted from a corpse lying atop some crumbled stone pillars at the lava lake, in west Mt. Gelmir

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - North Caelid
items.description: Found at the edge of the lake where the dragons dwell.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - Perfumer's Grotto
items.description: Found within Perfumer's Grotto in the area just outside the fog gates at the end of the tunnel.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - Sellia Gateway
items.description: Golden Rune (5) held by a corpse on top of a broken column on the path East of Sellia Gateway.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - Stillwater Cave
items.description: Found on a dead body, inside Stillwater Cave. In the same room as the Golden Rune (6).

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - Warmaster's Shack Southwest
items.description: Located within a grave area, in a sarcophagi on the hill south-west above Warmaster's Shack.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] - Wyndham Catacombs
items.description: Consumable. Found on a body in the Wyndham Catacombs in the room behind the rusted bars in the sewers. Can be reached by going under the raising floor in the room with the spike ceiling.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] A - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Looted from one of the three bodies behind the Stormveil Main Gate

items.name: Golden Rune [5] B
items.description: Found at the shore surrounded by Skeleton enemies.

items.name: Golden Rune [5] B - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Found on a dead body reached by a walking on a ledge at the outer side of the northern section of the castle.

items.name: Golden Rune [6]
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found among a cluster of sarcophagi high up on a cliff. You can reach this area by using the Spiritspring at Lenne's Rise.

items.name: Golden Rune [6]
items.description: Found by looting the sarcophagi.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] (A)
items.description: Consumable item. Dropped by an elite singing Bat enemy found along the cliffs south of the Minor Erdtree. You can hear the bat singing as you approach the cliffs. He is guarded by other Giant Bats.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - 2x
items.description: Found over the sarcophagi directly to the southof Sainted Hero's Grave There are also 2 Golden Rune (4) nearby.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Capital Outskirts
items.description: Held by a corpse next to the water, south of the Minor Erdtree.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Consecrated Snowfield South
items.description: Found in a Rune graveyard south Consecrated Snowfield

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Gelmir Hero's Grave
items.description: Looted from a corpse in Gelmir Hero's Grave, on a room guarded by two Wandering Nobles lying in ambush

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Hermit Village
items.description: Can be looted from a corpse lying atop a rock pillar connecting Hermit Village to Gelmir Hero's Grave, in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Jarburg Cemetery
items.description: Found within the graveyard.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Liurnia Highway North
items.description: Consumable Item. Held by a corpse near the armored giant spawn.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Liurnia Highway South
items.description: Dropped from a balloon in the deluged area of Liurnia of the Lakes that has some enemies attached to it. Defeat all of them and destroy the balloon to obtain the Golden Rune (6)

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Mt. Gelmir North
items.description: Looted from a body sprawled atop a rock in Mt. Gelmir

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Mt. Gelmir West
items.description: Can be looted from the open tombs in the gravesite on west Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Old Altus Tunnel
items.description: Consumable. Looted from a corpse in Old Altus Tunnel

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Redmane Castle
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse inside a guardhouse in the castle's inner grounds.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Seethewater Terminus
items.description: Consumable. Found on a body lying on the ground just before the Seethewater Terminus Site of Grace

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - Volcano Cave
items.description: Looted from a body hanging from a ledge in Volcano Cave

items.name: Golden Rune [6] - War-Dead Catacombs
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found inside the War-Dead Catacombs. In the main chamber with the 4 staircases, drop down into the lower level from the left and loot the corpse by the support structure in the northeast.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] A
items.description: You will spot a ballon, that has some enemies attached to it. Defeat all of them and destroy the ballon to obtain the Golden Rune.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] A - The Shaded Castle
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a body inside the walls, on top of a broken wooden platform jutting out from the ground.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] B
items.description: Found as you enter the cemetery, on the left side on a grave.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] B - The Shaded Castle
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a body sat in front of a series of tombstones in the inner courtyard.

items.name: Golden Rune [6] C - The Shaded Castle
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a body sitting on the eastern battlements.

items.name: Golden Rune [7]
items.description: Just in front of the Broken Statue. You can kill it from behind if you take an alternate route, allowing you to grab this item without much of a hassle.

items.name: Golden Rune [7] - 1x Cave of Forlorn
items.description: Inside Cave of the Forlorn. Just jump down from the site of grace.

items.name: Golden Rune [7] - Auriza Hero's Grave
items.description:
Rune Consumable. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave:
  • In the large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them, head all the way down to the large pit behind some pillars. The rune can be found on a corpse by the edge of this pit.

items.name: Golden Rune [7] - Liurnia's North-East Sarcophagi
items.description: Looted off Liurnia of the Lakes' north-east sarcophagi.

items.name: Golden Rune [7] - Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Consumable. Can be found at the furthest grave in the cemetery near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Golden Rune [7] - Outer Wall Battleground
items.description: Held by a corpse lying on the open field.

items.name: Golden Rune [7] - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Consumable. Held by a corpse accessible only by taking the ladder in the hidden room leading to the Sorcerers summoning the magic ball trap, then jumping out the window above the waygate.

items.name: Golden Rune [7] - Seethewater Cave
items.description: Consumable. Can be looted from a corpse hanging from a ledge in Seethewater Cave

items.name: Golden Rune [7] - Wyndham Ruins
items.description: Consumable. Can be found on a corpse in Wyndham Ruins, after doing a sharp right at the arching entryway

items.name: Golden Rune [7] B
items.description: Found inside Auriza Hero's Grave, at the edge of the path where the lone chariot passes.

items.name: Golden Rune [7]- Altus Tunnel
items.description: Rune Consumable. One is found inside the Altus Tunnel. In the second cavern, head through the tunnel in the south to find a wooden balcony overlooking a pit. The rune is found on a corpse sitting on this balcony.

items.name: Golden Rune [8]
items.description: Found on between the bushes to the right of a big staircase.

items.name: Golden Rune [8]
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found among a cluster of sarcophagi high up on a cliff. You can reach this area by using the Spiritspring at Lenne's Rise.

items.name: Golden Rune [8] - Fort Laiedd
items.description: Consumable. Looted from a soldier's corpse lying near a wall atop Fort Laeidd in Mt. Gelmir

items.name: Golden Rune [8] - Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Looted from a corpse in Mt. Gelmir, found between two formations of rocks.

items.name: Golden Rune [8] B
items.description: Found at the end of the alleway.

items.name: Golden Rune [8] C
items.description: Found at the end of an alleway, there is a Broken Statue at the end. There is also a Golden Rune (11)

items.name: Golden Rune [8] D
items.description: Found on the left side of the sewers, where the rats are.

items.name: Golden Rune [8] E
items.description: The first body on the staircase in the main road.

items.name: Golden Rune [9]
items.description: Can be found near the wheel of a chariot, at the main road.

items.name: Golden Rune [9] - 1x Caelid Treasure
items.description: Consumable Item. Found as a treasure in Caelid

items.name: Golden Rune [9] - 1x Castle Sol
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse in the middle level of the eastern section of the castle. Accessible via ladder outside the church's main entrance.

items.name: Golden Rune [9] - Consecrated Snowfield Sout
items.description: Found in a Rune graveyard south Consecrated Snowfield

items.name: Golden Rune [9] - Moonfolk Ruins
items.description: Held by a corpse in one of the edges of the structure.

items.name: Golden Rune [9] - Sealed Tunnel
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found inside the Sealed Tunnel, on a corpse at the bottom of the deep pit with roots strewn across, near the end of the dungeon.

items.name: Golden Rune [9] A - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse on some floating debris to the right and below the walkway, leading to the balcony.

items.name: Golden Rune [9] B
items.description: Found at the patio, on a body.

items.name: Golden Rune [9] B - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse behind a stone column after dropping down the floating platforms north of the Tempest-Facing Balcony.

items.name: Golden Rune [9] C
items.description: Found on a body that two dogs are devouring.

items.name: Golden Rune [9] D
items.description: Found on a big chapel with statues, where there's also a knight that performs the same moveset as Crucible Knight Ordivis, on a body , near the left exit.

items.name: Golden Scarab
items.description: Dropped by Cleanrot Knight (Sickle) & Cleanrot Knight (Spear) boss found in Abandoned Cave. It can be accessed by going east from Smoldering Wall site of grace and walking across canyon by using tree branches.

items.name: Golden Seed (A) - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree by some pillars south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

items.name: Golden Seed (A) - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found next to a Phantom Tree in the northeastern section of the castle, behind the courtyard. This tree is outside the cellar where you meet Nepheli Loux.

items.name: Golden Seed (B) - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree amongst several sets of pillar structures up on a hill in the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Beware the Warhawks guarding the area.

items.name: Golden Seed (B) - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Obtained by defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the underground area of Stormveil Castle. This area can be accessed via a hidden path above the door of the room with some Living Jar enemies, or by making a damaging drop outside the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace.

items.name: Golden Seed (Consecrated Snowfield)
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found by a pillar within the snowstorm, near a cookbook north from Consecrated Snowfield site of grace.

items.name: Golden Seed (F)
items.description: Golden Seeds allow the user to upgrade the number of Crimson and Cerulean Flask Uses, but not the amount of Wondrous Physik flasks available.

items.name: Golden Seed - 1x Fringefolk Hero's Grave
items.description: This item is obtained after Defeating the Ulcerated Tree Sprit located within Fringefolk Hero's Grave.

items.name: Golden Seed - 2x Capital Outskirts Northwest
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Two can be found under the Phantom Tree in the northwestern outer wall section.

items.name: Golden Seed - 2x Capital Outskirts West
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. 2 can be found underneath the Phantom Tree at the Capital Outskirts.

items.name: Golden Seed - 2x Leyndell Royal Capital
items.description: The first one is found by the by defeating the Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit NW of the Avenue Balcony Site of grace. The second one is found on a balcony to the SW of West Capital Rampart site of grace.

items.name: Golden Seed - Academy Gate Town
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. One can be found on the ground next to a glowing sapling.

items.name: Golden Seed - Altus Highway Junction
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found right next to the road heading north from the Altus Highway Junction site of grace.

items.name: Golden Seed - Capital Outskirts (Ulcerated Tree Spirit Drop)
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit enemy in an unmarked military camp directly south of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace.

items.name: Golden Seed - Caria Manor
items.description: Flask Upgrade material. Found under a Phantom Tree in the manor's upper level.

items.name: Golden Seed - Dragonbarrow Northeast
items.description: Flask upgrade material. Found along the main road, while heading to the Bestial Sanctum

items.name: Golden Seed - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit lurking beneath the second lake of rot, past a second set of branches within the inner walls.

items.name: Golden Seed - Flame Peak
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree before a frozen giant.

items.name: Golden Seed - Forbidden Lands
items.description: From the Forbidden Lands Site of grace, move towards the Grand Lift of Rold. You'll eventually come across the Golden Seed.

items.name: Golden Seed - Fort Haight
items.description: Flask Upgrade. Found right in front of the entrance to Fort Haight.

items.name: Golden Seed - Liurnia Northern Ravine
items.description: Found just south of where Poison Pods are located. Found besides a glowing tree.

items.name: Golden Seed - Liurnia of the Lakes
items.description: Can be found north of the Main Academy Gate site of grace, on the bridge.

items.name: Golden Seed - Lux Ruins
items.description: Found just north of Lux Ruins

items.name: Golden Seed - Minor Erdtree Altus Plateau
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found northwest of the Minor Erdtree of Altus Plateau.

items.name: Golden Seed - Mountaintops of the Giants East
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree in the lower valley northeast of the Minor Erdtree.

items.name: Golden Seed - Northwest Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. One can be found underneath a Phantom Tree.

items.name: Golden Seed - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: 1 can be found on the ground, next to the glowing sapling. West of the academy's courtyard.

items.name: Golden Seed - Seethewater River
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree as you exit the narrow channel north of Seethewater River.

items.name: Golden Seed - Sellia, Town of Sorcery
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree at the top of the large stairs in the northern section of town.

items.name: Golden Seed - South Caelid
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree by the side of the road in south Caelid.

items.name: Golden Seed - War-Dead Catacombs
items.description: Obtained by defeating the Putrid Tree Spirit inside the War-Dead Catacombs

items.name: Golden Seed - Weeping Peninsula
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found underneath a Phantom Tree up on a ridge southwest of the Weeping Peninsula Map Fragment

items.name: Golden Seed - Windmill Village
items.description: One can be found at a phantom tree South East of Windmill Village site of grace (following the road).

items.name: Golden Tailoring Tools
items.description: Tools made of gold brought with the red-haired Radagon when he married into the Carian line. Located inside a chest at the right of Church of Vows' main entrance.

items.name: Golden Vow (Spell)
items.description: Incantation. Found on a corpse inside the Corpse-Stench Shack.

items.name: Goldmask
items.description: Found around the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge.

items.name: Goldmask (Second Location)
items.description: NPC found alongside Brother Corhyn

items.name: Golem Greatbow
items.description: Chance to drop by Golem Archer.

items.name: Golem's Halberd
items.description: Dropped by one of the Golems at the bridge.

items.name: Gostoc's Bell Bearing
items.description: Dropped by Gatekeeper Gostoc

items.name: Gowry
items.description: Quest NPC. A once great Sage living in isolation. Found inside his shack near Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

items.name: Gowry's Shack
items.description: A lone shack found below the eastern hills near Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

items.name: Grace Mimic
items.description: Consumable. Given as a reward by a non-hostile Commoner NPC sitting on the roof of a building. Use the ladder nearby to reach him.

items.name: Grace Mimic - 3x Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Consumable Item. Three can be Looted off a corpse at the northwest of the graveyard. The body is next to a gravestone, sitting by the ledge.

items.name: Grace Mimic - 5x Sealed Tunnel
items.description: Consumable. A set of 5 can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel. In the large cavern with the Iron Virgin roaming the bottom, navigate the roots at the top to reach a tunnel in the east. Drop down the opening on the right and proceed east to find a corpse on the ground with the items.

items.name: Grace Mimic - Capital Outskirts
items.description: Consumable. Found on a dead body on the path to the Minor Erdtree.

items.name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword. Dropped by Leonine Misbegotten upon defeat.

items.name: Grafted Scion
items.description: Optional Miniboss. Patrols the main hall of his fortress. No special drops.

items.name: Grafted Scion
items.description: A Grafted Scion can be found at the destroyed camp across the stone pillar, at the bottom of the cliffs.

items.name: Grafted Scion (Tutorial)
items.description: Boss fought within the tutorial stage at Chapel of Anticipation.

items.name: Grand Lift of Dectus
items.description: Site of Grace found on the Liurnia side of the Grand Lift of Dectus.

items.name: Grand Lift of Dectus
items.description: A massive lift that connects the Altus Plateau to Liurnia. Requires collection of both Dectus Medallion (Left) and Dectus Medallion (Right) to activate.

items.name: Grand Lift of Rold
items.description: Elevator connecting Lyndell and Mountaintop of the Giants. Can also be used to access Consecrated Grounds, by those who have obtained the Haligtree Medallion pieces.

items.name: Grand Lift of Rold (Site of Grace)
items.description: Site of grace, located at the side of the Grand Lift of Rold

items.name: Grave Glovewort [1] - 2x Tombsward Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found in the room to the right of the boss door. A second one is found near a sarcophagus on the bottom level of the first room with a second floor.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [1] - 3x Caria Manor Outkirts
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. 3 Can be found spread throughout the graveyard area close to the 'Behind Caria Manor' Site of Grace. They can be looted behind the gravestones.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [1] - 3x Impaler's Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found on top of a sarcophagus in the room to the left of the boss door. A second one can be found in the second section of the sewers with Zombies, after dropping down underneath the Impaler Lift and one more can be found in the third section before climbing up the ladder.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [1] - 5x Deathtouched Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is located in the first large room left of the boss' door, right in front of the stairs. The second one is an alcove under the stairs in the same room. The third is found by going through the very narrow corridor adjacent to the stairs in the same room. The fourth one is found by going through the doorway south of where you collected the previous one, sitting on an L-shaped ledge. The fifth one is found by dropping down from where you collected the fourth.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [1] - 5x Stormfoot Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found by a sarcophagus in the room with the boss door. The second one is found in the next room, behind a pillar near the entrance to the narrow corridor. The third is found after climbing the ladder in the hallway where the second flamethrower pillar is. The fourth is found in a room west of where you got the third one. The final one is found to the left of the boss' door's lever.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [1] - Murkwater Cave
items.description: Multiple found inside Murkwater Catacombs.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [2] - 3x Caria Manor Outkirts
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. 3 Can be found spread throughout the graveyard area close to the 'Behind Caria Manor' Site of Grace. They can be looted behind the gravestones.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [2] - 3x Impaler's Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found in a dead end room with two statues and a sarcophagus. A second one can be found in the first section of the sewers with Zombies after dropping down underneath the impaler lift. A final one can be found in the corridor after pulling the boss door's lever.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [2] - 3x Tombsward Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found in the room to the right of the boss door, behind the central column. A second one is found in the room to the left of the flamethrower pillar. A third one is found in a room on the upper level after riding the flamethrower pillar and before the room with the boss door's lever.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [2] - 4x Black Knife Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found to the left of the boss door, just before the steps leading downwards. The second one is found just past the Imp Statue-sealed room, in a dead end to the left. The third and fourth are found in the first section of the sewer area after dropping down the ladder.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [2] - 4x Cliffbottom Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found by facing east while riding down the lift by the entrance and jumping onto a small balcony as the lift passes it by. The second one is found by turning the corner in the corridor to the right of the boss door. The third one is found by heading up the stairs to the right of the door sealed by an Imp Statue and following the path to an alcove in a small room at the end. The final one is found along a corridor leading up to the room with a ladder to the library.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [2] - 4x Road's End Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 4 are found inside the dungeon. 1) In the room with the boss' door lever, drop down one level to find it on the floor. 2) Found in a corridor to the east of the room with the boss door lever, accessed from the bottom-most floor of the room. 3) From the second glovewort, the third one is found in the right corner by the entrance of the next room. 4) Found just before the illusory wall concealing the boss door.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [3] - 2x Caelid Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Caelid Catacombs:
  1. The first one is found in the corner of the connecting corridor after the scarlot rot-flooded corridor past the Site of Grace.
  2. Continue along the dungeon until you reach a room with a small set of stairs on the left. The second glovewort is on the far wall opposite the stairs.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [3] - 3x Minor Erdtree Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs:
  1. After descending the lift by the entrance, head into the western corridor and look behind the central support of the next room to find the first glovewort.
  2. The second one is found in the scarlet rot-flooded room east of the lift. The glovewort is to the right of the doorway.
  3. The last one can be found by returning to the lift, sending it up and then dropping into the opening below it. Go through the scarlet rot-flooded corridor and enter the small opening on the right. Continue through the next room and look for a ladder on the right. Climb the ladder and you can find the glovewort in the hallway above.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [3] - 3x Sainted Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave:
  1. The first one is found in the room you fall into after the floor above crumbles. Check the southeast of this room to find the glovewort.
  2. Continue north from the previous room to find a large hall with falling cleaver traps. The glovewort is found near the end of the second set of cleavers, next to an opening in the wall on the right.
  3. The last one is found after after opening the boss door by defeating the Grave Warden Duelist. There is a connecting room between the door and the mist gate, you can find the glovewort by a statue on the right.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [3] - 4x Black Knife Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found in the center of a small room past the hall with the cleaver traps. The second one is found in the second section of the sewer area, after dropping down the ladder. The third one is found by returning to the cleaver trap room, waiting for the second-to-last cleaver to fall and then standing on top of it. It will bring you up where you can jump onto a tunnel entrance. Follow this path past the statues and the glovewort will be in a small alcove on the right. The final one is found by dropping down the hole in the alcove where the third glovewort was found to a sewer section where the boss door's lever can also be found.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [3] - 4x Cliffbottom Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found in the large room with the Imp Statue seal - Check the area behind the stairs leading up to the Imp Statue. The second one is found in a narrow corridor on the top level of the multi-leveled hall where you can see the boss lever statue. In the same multi-leveled hall, drop down onto the central stair-bridge and then drop further down into the pit below and check the corridors for the third and fourth Grave Glovewort (3).

items.name: Grave Glovewort [3] - 4x Road's End Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 4 are found inside the dungeon. 1) In the room with the boss' door lever, drop down one level to find it on the floor. 2) Just a few steps from the first. 3) In the same room, drop down to the bottom most level and hit the wall under the arch in the back, closest to the stairs to reveal a hidden room. 4) In the next room to the east, near the back.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [4] - 2x Black Knife Catacombs
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found in the room with the cleaver traps. Wait for the second-to-last cleaver to fall and then stand on top of it to use it as a lift. Jump onto the tunnel in the wall and the glovewort can be found just to the right of the entrance. The next one is found by continuing along the same tunnel. All the way to the end of the path is an illusory wall hiding the Black Knife Assassin's mist gate. The glovewort is found just before this gate.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [4] - 2x Minor Erdtree Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs:
  1. The first one is found inside the eastern corridor, after descending the lift by the entrance.
  2. Go back to the lift and step on the plate to send it up and immediately jump off. Head into the opening and through the scarlot rot-flooded corridor. Look to the right for a narrow opening and follow it into a room where you can find the glovewort in the back.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [4] - 2x Sainted Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave:
  1. From the Site of Grace, head into the corridor in the east and take the first turn to the right. Go through the large hallway ahead and turn left into a large room with a set of stairs on the left. Check behind the stairs to find the first glovewort.
  2. From the room that you fall into after the floor above crumbles, head north into a large hall with falling cleaver traps. The second glovewort is found halfway through this hall, on the right side.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [4] - 2x Wyndham Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Two are found within the Wyndham Catacombs.
  1. The first is found in the room with the cleaver traps, at the back.
  2. The second one is found in the sewer area, right where the Golden Order Knight is fought.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [4] - 3x Caelid Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Caelid Catacombs:
  1. The first is found on the left side of the scarlet rot-flooded corridor just past the Site of Grace.
  2. The second one is found in the room before the boss door, in the corner of the central support.
  3. The third one is found in the same room, in the right corner in the back.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [4] - Unsightly Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 are found within the Unsightly Catacombs.
  1. The first one is found in the room with the L-shaped staircase.
  2. The second one is found by dropping into the pit from the L-shaped staircase and heading through the corridor in the north.
  3. The last one is found in the dark hall just before the boss' door.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [5] - 2x Auriza Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave:
  1. In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps and then turn right to find the first glovewort in the next corridor.
  2. Continue on from the previous glovewort to the large Chariot Hall with two Chariots running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. Head all the way down to the bottom where there is a large pit. Looking down, you will see several wooden beams you can jump onto. Navigate your way across the beams, heading to the north where you can find a hidden area with a statue to the right. Enter the corridor behind the statue to find a small room where the second glovewort can be looted from the back wall.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [5] - 2x Auriza Side Tomb
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Auriza Side Tomb:
  • Precise locations to be added

items.name: Grave Glovewort [5] - 2x Caelid Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Caelid Catacombs:
  • Continue along the dungeon until you reach a room with a small set of stairs on the left. Check under the stairs and hit the walls to reveal an alcove with 2 of the gloveworts.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [5] - 2x Minor Erdtree Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs:
  1. The first one is found in the back of the scarlet rot-flooded room, east of the lift.
  2. The second glovewort can be found by sending the lift up and dropping into the opening below. Head into the scarlot rot-flooded corridor and go through the narrow opening on the right. Continue on through the next room and climb up the ladder on the right. Follow the linear path and turn right to wind up on the upper balcony of the scarlot rot-flooded room. The glovewort is found by a pillar in the back on the left side.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [5] - 3x Sainted Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave:
  1. From the Site of Grace, head into the corridor towards the east, ignoring the first turn and going all the way to the end. Check behind the stairs in the following room to find the first glovewort.
  2. From the room that you fall into after the floor above crumbles, head north into the hall with the falling cleaver traps. Wait for the first cleaver to fall then stand on top of it to use it as a lift and then jump into the opening in the western wall. In the next room, unlock the Imp Statue barrier to find the glovewort.
  3. Go back down to the cleaver trap hall and continue along north and then east. Climb the ladder in the opening in the wall to the right near the end of the second set of cleavers and you can find the last glovewort in the corner of the next room.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [5] - 3x Unsightly Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Unsightly Catacombs.
  1. The first is found in the first big hall with multiple levels. Go through the side corridors towards the back to find the glovewort.
  2. The second one is found by going down one level and heading to the connecting room in the east, behind the Winged Misbegotten and Rotten Stray.
  3. The last one is found in a corner of a pit you drop into from an L-shaped staircase.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [5] - Wyndham Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Two are found inside the Wyndham Catacombs:
  1. The first one is found as you are descending the lift from the entrance. Face towards the west wall and jump onto a balcony as the lift passes it by to find the glovewort.
  2. The second one is found shortly after the room with the cleaver traps, in a pile of rubble in the corner.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [6] - 4x Auriza Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 4 can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave:
  1. In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp and then check the eastern wall in the bottom room. Beware the multiple Basilisks that emerge from the ground as you approach.
  2. From the first glovewort, head west and up the steps and then turn right in the next corridor. Follow the path towards a second Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them. The second glovewort can be found shortly after exiting into this hall, right down the middle before the second ramp.
  3. In the same large hall, head all the way to the bottom where there is a large pit. Look down to find some wooden beams you can drop onto. Navigate your way to the lowest beam and then head south towards an archway with a ladder in the back. Head up the ladder and you will end up in another hall with a single Chariot. Wait for it to run down the ramp and then head up and turn right into a chamber with a flamethrower pillar. The third glovewort can be found behind this pillar.
  4. From the flamethrower pillar, head back into the last Chariot hall and head all the way down to the bottom. Enter the corridor on the left and then take another left to find a lift which will take you up to a chamber where the flamethrower pillar is raised (if you have previously hit it). If the pillar is active, it will be spewing flames into the northern corridor. Wait for breaks in between spews and head inside. There is an alcove on the right where you can safely wait for another break before heading to the end of the corridor. Turn left at the end to find the final glovewort just before the path leads back to the large double Chariot Hall.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [6] - 4x Auriza Side Tomb
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 4 can be found inside the Auriza Side Tomb:
  • Precise locations to be added

items.name: Grave Glovewort [6] - Gelmir Hero's Grave
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One is found in the Gelmir Hero's Grave. From the first Chariot hallway, head down until just before the central concrete walkway ends and jump into the alcove on the left. Head into the room it connects to where you can find the glovewort just by the left wall.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [6] - War-Dead Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 5 can be found inside the War-Dead Catacombs:
  1. Right in the center of the main chamber with the 4 staircases, you can find the glovewort under a torch on the left wall.
  2. In the same chamber, take the first staircase on the left, closest to the entrance and follow the ledge west to find the second glovewort.
  3. Get back into the center of the main chamber and take the stairs in the back on the right this time and head down the corridor on the left. Continue all the way to the end and then turn right to find the third glovewort on the left side in the next corridor.
  4. Continue on from the previous glovewort and you will find the fourth one in a small room at the very end of the path.
  5. Backpedal a bit from the previous glovewort and you will find a window in the west side of the hallway. Jump through and then head up the stairs on the left in the next room. Turn right to find another window, through which you can find the final glovewort.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [7] - 2x Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of2 can be found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave.
  1. By a set of steps opposite the first Lesser Burial Watchdog encountered.
  2. Upon reaching the lift, take it to the lower level and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When it's fully raised, you can find an opening in the lift column. Pull the lever in the nearby alcove and go inside the opening in the lift column to descend further down. At the bottom level, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn right. Climb the long ladder to the right of a second Lesser Burial Watchdog to reach an otherwise inaccessible area far west of the Troll hall. You can find the second glovewort on the west wall up here.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [7] - 3x Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs:
  1. The first one is found by heading straight west from the Site of Grace, in the back wall of the room at the end.
  2. Back in the main path from the first lift, head left from the Boss Doors and descend the dungeon's second lift. Continue along the path and then turn right in the room with the statue. Proceed through the hall with the guillotine traps and then take the first left in the next corridor to a room with several Land Squirts. Keep moving forward until you reach a small room at the end of the path with a large Living Jar. The second glovewort can be found pressed against the right wall here.
  3. From the last glovewort, backtrack into the previous hall and look for an opening in the alcove in the right. Drop down this opening and you will end up in a balcony overlooking a room with a statue that looks identical to the one you previously passed. Head west from the statue and follow the identical pathway through another set of guillotine traps, another room with Land Squirts and another small room at the end with a Living Jar. The final glovewort is found behind the door frame of this room, on the right.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [7] - 7x Gelmir Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 7 can be found inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave:
  1. In the first Chariot hallway, head down until just before the central strip of concrete ends and jump into the alcove to the left to find the first glovewort
  2. From the first glovewort, continue through the alcove to a large room. The second glovewort can be found by the right wall.
  3. In the same room, head to the back and under the stairs to find the third one.
  4. Still in the same room, head up the stairs and go past the flamethrower pillar heading east to a second Chariot hall. The glovewort is just directly opposite of where you enter the hall from.
  5. Head back to the first Chariot hall and from the top, head down until the point where there is no lava on either side of the central concrete walkway. Drop down into the pit on the left and land on the crossbeams. Drop down to the area below and you can find the fifth glovewort in an alcove along the eastern wall. Beware the Cemetary Shade guarding it.
  6. Head back to the first Chariot hallway once more and head all the way down. Look for an alcove on the right at the end of the path, past the lava to get the sixth glovewort
  7. From the same alcove, drop down into the hole to find the final glovewort, just outside the boss door

items.name: Grave Glovewort [8] - 3x Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave.
  1. One found in the large hall locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. This is directly above the flamethrower pillar and there is a hole in the ground where a section of the pillar can rise through.
  2. Upon reaching the lift, take it to the lower level and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When it's fully raised, you can find an opening in the lift column. Pull the lever in the nearby alcove and go inside the opening in the lift column to descend further down. At the bottom level, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn right to find the second glovewort behind a second Lesser Burial Watchdog.
  3. Directly after picking up the second glovewort, climb the long ladder in the alcove to the right to reach an otherwise inaccessible area far west of the Troll hall. You can find the third glovewort on the north wall up here.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [8] - 3x Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs:
  1. Descend the first lift you find and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When fully raised, there is a second platform on the lift that will take you to the lowest levels of the catacombs. From here, continue east to a room with a set of stairs on the right and a Lesser Burial Watchdog. Check underneath the stairs for the first glovewort.
  2. Continue north from the first glovewort to a narrow corridor with a frost breath trap at the end. Turn left halfway through the corridor and pick up the second glovewort at the end of this path.
  3. Get back on the first lift and ascend back onto the main path. Head left from the Boss Doors and descend the dungeon's second lift. Turn right in the room with the statue and you will wind up in a hall with guillotine traps. Past the guillotines, turn left in the next corridor and go through the room with several Land Squirts. In the next hall, you will see a small room in the back with a Living Jar guarding it. Ignore that room and instead, look for an alcove on the left that you can drop down through.
