You will end up on a balcony overlooking a room with a statue that looks identical to the one you have previously passed but this is an entirely different floor. Head west from the statue and you will end up in another identical hall filled with guillotine traps, except this time, you can see another statue in a room in the distance. The final glovewort is found next to this statue.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [8] - Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
items.description: Upgrade material. One is found in the first room with a frost trap.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [9] - 2x Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave.
  1. One is found behind the first Lesser Burial Watchdog encountered, in a room under the circle of light.
  2. When you reach the lift, take it down and then step on the plate again to send it up back up but jump off immediately. Once it's fully raised, you will see an opening in the column. Pull the lever in the nearby alcove and enter the opening in the lift. It will take you further down. At the bottom, check behind the lift column for the second glovewort.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [9] - 6x Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
items.description: Upgrade material. 6 in total. First is found within the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs, in a room filled with imps. Another one is found in the room before taking the stairs to the second floor of the frost trap. Third is on second floor by the trap. A fourth is guarded by two Cleanrot Knights in a room in the second floor by the trap. A fifth one can be looted on the third floor by the lever to open the boss door. Final one is in a room in the second floor, guarded by a Burial Tree Watchdog.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [9] - Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs:
  • From the Boss Doors, head left and descend the dungeon's second lift. Turn right in the room with the statue and you will wind up in a hall with guillotine traps. Past the guillotines, turn left in the next corridor and go through the room with several Land Squirts. In the next hall, you will see a small room in the back with a Living Jar guarding it. Ignore that room and instead, look for an alcove on the left that you can drop down through. You will end up on a balcony overlooking a room with a statue that looks identical to the one you have previously passed but this is an entirely different floor. Head for the corridor the statue is facing to find a third lift. Ascend the lift and get past the hallway with Imps to find a small room with the glovewort, guarded by a Lesser Burial Watchdog.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [9] - Hidden Path to the Haligtree
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. 3 can be found in the Hidden Path to the Haligtree. The first is guarded by two Land Octopuses and a Vulgar Militiaman near the exit to the Consecrated Snowfield. The next two are found in the secret catacombs below. One is in the first alcove that you can access after jumping down onto the invisible walkways under the staircase. The last one can be found in a third alcove across to the west from the second alcove guarded by two Vulgar Militants.

items.name: Grave Violet - 1x Liurnia East Graveyard
items.description: Crafting Material. One can be found by a tombstone north from the Chuch of Vows. Beware of an undead ambush.

items.name: Grave Warden Duelist (Auriza Side Tomb)
items.description: Field Enemy located inside Auriza Side Tomb.

items.name: Grave Warden Duelist (Limgrave)
items.description: Found within Murkwater Catacombs.

items.name: Gravel Stone
items.description: Crafting Material. Two obtained by a grave marker overlooking the cliffs. Guarded by a Pumpkin Head.

items.name: Gravel Stone (B)
items.description: Crafting Material, found in the middle of the lake. Before of the lurking Dragons in the area.

items.name: Gravel Stone - 2x Altus Plateau
items.description: Material. Can be found in the ground at a crumbled ruin, north of Woodfolk Ruins

items.name: Gravel Stone - 3x Crumbling Farum Azula (B)
items.description: Crafting Material. A set of 3 found on a sarcophagus in the upper level of the large building. To reach this area, head out of the balcony of the room after the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and jump up onto the roof right next to it. You can enter the building's upper level from here.

items.name: Gravel Stone - 3x Crumbling Farum Azula (C)
items.description: Crafting Material. A set of 3 found on a corpse in the roofed hallway in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple.

items.name: Gravel Stone - 5x Crumbling Farum Azula (A)
items.description: Crafting Material. A set of 5 can be found on a corpse far to the east of the southern cliffs. You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the cliffs.

items.name: Gravel Stone - 6x Leyndell Royal Capital
items.description:
You can find Gravel Stone at three different parts:
1) Found at the end of a dark alley, near the main road.
2) Found over the "wing" of the dragon once you manage to get over it.
3) Found at the ruined area, past the Fortified Manor.

items.name: Gravel Stone - Mt. Gelmir West
items.description: Material. Can be looted from a corpse lying at the edge of a rock, at west Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Gravel Stone Seal
items.description: From the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, walk north to the next room with the single guard inside. Jump over the balcony railing to get to the area next to the Fortified Manor with the dragon foot. The knight with the spear supported by an archer drops this seal.

items.name: Graven-Mass Talisman
items.description: Talisman found in a chest atop the Albinauric Rise tower.

items.name: Graven-School Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Found beyond the illusory wall before the Red Wolf of Radagon boss fight. Go up the ladder close to the Debate Hall Site of Grace and then down the hole to another the room with potboys. This opens the door inaccessible as you entered this area.

items.name: Gravity Stone Chunk - 3x Sellia Crystal Tunnel
items.description: Offensive Throwable. 6x found inside a chest in the central storage shed in the main cavern. This is the same shed you are teleported to upon using the trap coffer at the Dragon-Burnt Ruins.

items.name: Gravity Stone Fan
items.description: Offensive Consumable Item. Found on a corpse by the cliffs.

items.name: Gravity Stone Fan - 6x Sellia Crystal Tunnel
items.description: Offensive Throwable. 6x found inside a chest in the central storage shed in the main cavern. This is the same shed you are teleported to upon using the trap coffer at the Dragon-Burnt Ruins.

items.name: Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter that spawns at this location at night time.

items.name: Gravity Well
items.description: Dropped by the Monolith Guardian enemy that appears from a gravity portal. The section is near the graveyard and the large rotating lift of Raya Lucaria Academy.

items.name: Great Arrow - 5x Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Consumable Ammunition. Looted from a body atop one of the ladders in Mt. Gelmir

items.name: Great Club
items.description: Hammer Weapon. Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll boss inside the Old Altus Tunnel upon defeat.

items.name: Great Dragonfly Head
items.description: On a corpse underwater at the Dragon-Burnt Ruins.

items.name: Great Dragonfly Head
items.description: A Great Dragonfly Head can be found on the ground by one of the effigies.

items.name: Great Dragonfly Head - 3x Auriza Hero's Grave
items.description: Material. Found on a corpse at the stairs of a secluded room in Auriza's Hero Grave.

items.name: Great Dragonfly Head - 5x Liurnia East
items.description: Crafting Material. Five can be looted from a corpse in a graveyard just south-east from the Artists's Shack in Eastern Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Great Epee
items.description: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, and get down, you will find a group of enemies. The Great Epee is inside a chest. on the right side.

items.name: Great Grave Glovewort - Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the boss of Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs, Putrid Grave Warden Duelist.

items.name: Great Grave Glovewort - Crumbling Farum Azula (A)
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in a recess in the northeastern-most wall of the upper level of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths. To reach this upper area, head out of the balcony of the room next to the site of grace and jump up onto the red roof right next to it. You can head into the building's upper level from here.

items.name: Great Grave Glovewort - Crumbling Farum Azula (B)
items.description: Upgrade Material. After dropping down the pit into a narrow hallway in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple, head into the first archway on the left and up the stairs heading northwest to a ruined balcony where you can navigate across a series of floating debris to reach a second balcony with a ladder. Head up the ladder to reach a hidden tomb with the glovewort sitting on the main sarcophagus in the back.

items.name: Great Grave Glovewort - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in the center of the second lake of rot, past a second set of branches inside the inner walls. Beware the Ulcerated Tree Spirit lurking beneath.

items.name: Great Grave Glovewort - Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
items.description:
Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave.
  • In the large hall with the Troll, drop down from either side of the platform into a room with a Prelate. Defeat it and check the very back of the room for the glovewort.
  • Alternatively, you can reach this room by descending the lift and sending it back up. Pull the lever in the alcove to the right and then enter the small space in the raised lift to descend further down. In the next hall, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn left. Climb the ladder at the end of this path.

items.name: Great Horned Tragoth
items.description: Assassination target for the Volcano Manor. You can invade their world using a summoning sign after accepting the assassination request.

items.name: Great Mace
items.description: Can be found inside a chest, in the bandit camp.

items.name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
items.description: Greataxe. Dropped by the boss duo of Perfumer's Grotto: Omenkiller and Miranda the Blighted Bloom.

items.name: Great Rune of the Unborn
items.description: Great Rune of Rennala, Queen of the Moon. Acquired as a reward for defeating the supreme sorceress.

items.name: Great Stars
items.description: On a guarded wagon in Altus Plateau, traveling on the road SouthWest of the Road of Iniquity Side Path site of grace.

items.name: Great Turtle Shell
items.description: Small Shield. Found on a corpse atop the eastern-most tower of the Castle Morne Ramparts. This area can be reached by using Torrent to jump from the Spiritspring located just east of the Site of Grace nearby.

items.name: Great Wyrm Theodorix
items.description: Optional Dragon Boss found outside of the Cave of the Forlorn. Drops 3 Dragon Hearts upon defeat.

items.name: Great-Jar's Arsenal
items.description: Reward for completing the 3 duelist NPC invasions in Dragonbarrow (Caelid North) for The Great-Jar. You will only be able to access this area by coming up from Siofra Deep River Well in the underground.

items.name: Greataxe
items.description: Found inside the treasure chest within the carriage being pulled by two large Trolls and defended by militia and aristocracy.

items.name: Greatblade Phalanx
items.description: Sorcery. Dropped by Bols, Carian Knight inside the Cuckoo's Evergaol.

items.name: Greatbow
items.description: Found in a chest at the top of the Highway Lookout Tower.

items.name: Greathood
items.description: Helm. Reward for finding the painter of the Sorcerer Painting.

items.name: Greatshield Talisman
items.description: Found in a chest on a Wagon East of Grace "Erdtree-Gazing Hill" behind Ancient Dragon Lansseax.

items.name: Greatsword
items.description: Colossal Sword. Looted from the chest in the enemy caravan traveling the Caelid Highway.

items.name: Green Turtle Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Found in an underground area filled with Turtles. The entrance is found slightly south-east of Summonwater Village and requires 1 Stonesword Key to unlock.

items.name: Greenburst Crystal Tear
items.description: Physick Flask material. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar guarding this tree.

items.name: Greenspill Crystal Tear
items.description: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Found on an altar next to the Minor Erdtree in Mistwood.

items.name: Groveside Cave
items.description: Site of Grace found inside the Groveside Cave, right before the boss fight.

items.name: Groveside Cave
items.description: Small cave north from Church of Elleh.

items.name: Guardian Golem
items.description: Found within the Highroad Cave. Drops Blue Dancer Charm

items.name: Guardians' Garrison
items.description: A garrison of Fire Priests guard the path to the Giant Forge.

items.name: Guest Hall
items.description: Site of Grace.

items.name: Guilty Hood
items.description: Held by a corpse on the right side of the sewer-like tunnel.

items.name: Gurranq Beast Clergyman
items.description: A non-hostile NPC found within the Bestial Sanctum. Awards various items for handing in Deathroot.

items.name: Gurranq's Beast Claw
items.description: Bestial Sanctum: Reward from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman after giving him the eighth Deathroot.

items.name: Haligdrake Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Drop down from the cliff near the Seaside Ruins site of grace. Explore the lower area and between fallen columns, there is a small entrance. Enter and take the path until you fing a hanging body.There you will find the Haligdrake Talisman - this is the unreachable item seen in the Cave of Knowledge starting tutorial

items.name: Haligdrake Talisman +1
items.description: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse next to a Lesser Spirit-Caller Snail inside the Leyndell Catacombs. From the Lyndell Catacombs site of grace, head up the elevator in the southeast to find a room with 3 spirit crossbowmen. Look next to the stairs for an illusory wall. Hit it to dispel the illusion, and then hit the wall on the left to dispel another illusion. The corpse and snail are found in here.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Helm
items.description: Helmet. Found on a corpse in an upper level room next to the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace. There is a ladder adjacent to the grace which leads to the room.

items.name: Haligtree Roots
items.description: Found underground after taking the lift from the large building in the northeast.

items.name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left)
items.description: Key Item. Found in the castle's northeast tower after defeating Commander Niall.

items.name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right)
items.description: Key Item. Hit Albus, who is disguised as a pot past the Perfumer guarding the path up from the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace. This medallion opens the path to a secret location past Lyndell.

items.name: Haligtree Soldier Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ashes. Found under a large decorative chalice in the northern edge of the main city proper.

items.name: Hammer
items.description: Found inside the Fortified manor, beside the Sanctified Whetblade

items.name: Hammer Talisman
items.description: Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against blockers.

items.name: Hand Ballista
items.description: At the top of the Forest Lookout Tower, west of the Bridge of Sacrifice.

items.name: Harp Bow
items.description: Acquired by solving the Champion's Song Painting, found in The Shaded Castle

items.name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
items.description: Medium Shield. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

items.name: Heart of Aeonia
items.description: Site of grace in the heart of the Aeonia Swamp

items.name: Hefty Beast Bone - 10x Highway Lookout Tower
items.description: Crafting Material. 10x can be found on a corpse hanging off a wooden beam on the first floor of the Highway Lookout Tower.

items.name: Hefty Beast Bone - 2x Altus Plateau
items.description: Material. Looted from a corpse near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge site of grace, below the bridge itself.

items.name: Hefty Beast Bone - 2x Seethewater Cave
items.description: Material. Found in one corpse of a trio of corpses outside Seethewater Cave in Mt. Gelmir

items.name: Hefty Beast Bone - 4x The Shaded Castle
items.description: Found on a body on the walkway up in the castle area, to the right when exiting the first room after the ladder up.

items.name: Helphen's Steeple
items.description: Greatsword. Dropped by the Tibia Mariner boss found up on a ridge south of Castle Sol.

items.name: Herba - 3x Seethewater River
items.description: Material. Found on a corpse hanging low from a rock in Seethewater River

items.name: Heretical Rise
items.description: Puzzle tower that hides the Founding Rain of Stars spell. Unlock the entrance by finding the invisible bridge from the other side of the ravine, and carefully follow the misty path to find the way to enter.

items.name: Hermit Merchant
items.description: Merchant within the Hermit Merchant's Shack. Replaced by Bell Bearing Hunter at night.

items.name: Hermit Merchant Mountaintops East
items.description: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found south of Stargazer's Ruins, beneath the cliffs.

items.name: Hermit Merchant's Shack
items.description: Merchant dwells here. Sells Sentry's Torch and Prophet Set among other items.

items.name: Hermit Village
items.description: A secluded village found southeast of the volcano.

items.name: Hermit's Shack
items.description: A small shack found south of the volcano.

items.name: Hero's Rune [1]
items.description: Found inside Fortified Manor, at the second room.

items.name: Hero's Rune [1] - Hidden Path to the Haligtree
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse on a balcony before the room with the boss door's lever. This is in the secret catacombs underneath the large staircase, accessed by navigating a series of invisible walkways.

items.name: Hero's Rune [1] - Spiritcaller Cave
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found inside the Spiritcaller Cave, in a small cavern with three corpses.

items.name: Hero's Rune [2]
items.description: On a body against a wall, beware of the soldier and the lion guarding it.

items.name: Hero's Rune [2]
items.description: Found on a body by the edge of the large pillar hanging off the edge.

items.name: Hero's Rune [2] - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse sitting by the wall next to the staircase to the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.

items.name: Hero's Rune [5]
items.description: Found inside the big room with the statues and the knight that can perform the same moves as Crucible Knight Ordovis, on a body.

items.name: Hero's Rune [5] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse behind a large decorative chalice at the end of the hallway after the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace.

items.name: Hero's Rune [5] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse under a large tree in the eastern graveyard.

items.name: Hero's Rune [5] - Yelough Anix Tunnel
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a body in the center of the room where the Onyx Lord is fought.

items.name: Hero's Rune [5] B
items.description: Rune Consumable. One found on a corpse by an outer ledge behind a wall. You can get to the ledge by carefully walking on the broken section while hugging the wall.

items.name: Hidden Path to the Haligtree
items.description: Catacombs leading from the Grand Lift of Rold to Consecrated Grounds. Can only be accessed by those who have found both pieces of the Haligtree Secret Medallion

items.name: Hierodas Glintstone Crown
items.description: Can be looted from a corpse behind a house on the southern end of the village.

items.name: Highland Axe
items.description: Axe. Found in the same hall as the Grafted Scion miniboss, under a large painting.

items.name: Highroad Cave
items.description: A cave that houses a tomb, deep within. It is situated at the northmost part of Limgrave. It has been inhabited by a pack of Wolves, Land Octopuses, and Giant Bats.

items.name: Highroad Cave Site
items.description: Site of grace, located inside the entrance of Highroad Cave.

items.name: Highway Lookout Tower (Altus Plateau)
items.description: A lookout tower overlooking the main road heading into the Capital Outskirts' northwest entrance.

items.name: Highway Lookout Tower (Liurnia)
items.description: Tower overlooking the highway of Liurnia's eastern landmass.

items.name: Holy Grease
items.description: Over The main road, at the top of the wrecked chariot.

items.name: Holy Grease - 2x Auriza Hero's Grave
items.description:
Weapon Coating. A set of 2 can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave:
  • In the large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them, head all the way down to the large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you can find several wooden beams you can drop down to. Align yourself with the closest one and drop down, then drop down once more to a second beam below where the items can be looted off a corpse.

items.name: Holy Grease - 3x Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Consumable. 3 are found on a corpse on the bridge towards the Prayer Room at the base of Elphael.

items.name: Holy Grease 2x D
items.description: Consumable. Found on a body lying atop the small stone platform near the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace

items.name: Holy Grease B
items.description: Take the giant tree branches located south of West Rampart Capital south of grace. There is one that gets neer a yellowish roof. Jump there and walk along until you find an enemy. Behind it you will find the item

items.name: Holy Grease C
items.description: Down the stairs after facing Godfrey, First Elden Lord, you will find it

items.name: Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear
items.description: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar.

items.name: Holyproof Dried Liver
items.description: On the sewers, past the Broken Statue, on the room below there are three items to grab, one of those is this one.

items.name: Homing Instinct Painting
items.description: Key Info Item. Painting inside the Artist's Shack in Limgrave.

items.name: Hookclaws
items.description: Claw weapon. Found on a corpse in the corner of a small corridor on the first level of the wine cellar, filled with crates and patrolled by a single Castle Guard.

items.name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
items.description: Whip. Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood upon defeat.

items.name: Hoslow's Set
items.description: Armor Set comprised of Hoslow's Helm, Hoslow's Armor, Hoslow's Gauntlets and Hoslow's Greaves. Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood upon defeat.

items.name: Howl of Shabriri
items.description: Incantation. Found in a chest on the second level of the Frenzy-Flaming Tower.

items.name: Human Bone Shard - 6x Second Church of Marika
items.description: Crafting Material. Looted from a corpse lying near a grave at the Second Church of Marika.

items.name: Human Bone Shard 5x
items.description: Crafting Material. Can be found on a corpse lying at the corner of a structure in Wyndham Ruins.

items.name: Hyetta (Final Location)
items.description: NPC. Hyetta will move to this location if her questline has been followed.

items.name: Hyetta (First Location)
items.description: Hyetta, Location 1. Hyetta roams The Lands Between in search of the distant light, drawn to her destiny by a guiding shine she feels in the back of her eyes when eating Shabriri grapes.

items.name: Hyetta (Fourth location)
items.description: Hyetta moves here if you have given her shabiri grapes at her previous locations.

items.name: Hyetta (Second Location)
items.description: Hyetta, Location 2. She is found at the western side of the Purified Ruins. She asks for another Shabriri Grape but does not give any reward this time.

items.name: Hyetta (Third Location)
items.description: Hyetta spawns near the site of grace. She will ask for another Shabriri Grape and will ask what the grapes really are. Telling her will make her puke and then thank you for telling her. After sitting down at the grace nearby she will have more dialog. After once again sitting at the grace she will move to her next location.

items.name: Ice Crest Shield
items.description: Small Shield. Found on a corpse up on a ledge by a jagged stone pillar. This area is in the gardens, jumping up on the rocks from the Teardrop Scarab nearby.

items.name: Icerind Hatchet
items.description: Axe found inside a chest in the Temple Quarter. The chest is located in what remains of the tower of a ruined building, by some poison flowers.

items.name: Icon Shield
items.description: Found inside a crumbling building. Beware of the enemies inside.

items.name: Iji's Mirrorhelm
items.description: Need to confront Blaidd during Ranni's questline. War Counselor Iji will have new dialogue available. After that, his corpse can be found near his usual spot at the Road to the Manor Site of Grace. The anvil has Iji's Mirrorhelm as well as Iji's Bell Bearing.

items.name: Imbued Sword Key - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Key Item used to activate a Waygate. It can be looted off a corpse found on the east side of the Raya Lucaria Academy rooftops.

items.name: Imbued Sword Key - Sellia, Town of Sorcery
items.description: Key Item used to activate a Waygate at The Four Belfries. Found in a chest in the northeast section of town. This location is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

items.name: Imbued Sword Key - The Four Belfries
items.description: Key Item used to activate a Waygate at The Four Belfries. Found in a chest at the very top of the hill, at the fourth belfry tower.

items.name: Immunizing Cured Meat
items.description: Found in the small group of Poison Flowers in the outskirts of the Waypoint Ruins.

items.name: Immunizing Cured Meat - Seethewater Cave
items.description: Consumable. Looted from a body on the room with the giant Miranda Sprouts in Seethewater Cave

items.name: Immunizing White Cured Meat
items.description: Temporarily boosts immunity.

items.name: Immunizing White Cured Meat - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse at the end of the eastern walkway, on the bottom level.

items.name: Imp Head (Cat)
items.description: Helm. Rare drop inside the Impaler's Catacombs.

items.name: Imp Head (Corpse)
items.description: The easiest way to reach is by falling from above over the buildings with golden roofs and then down again, head to the northern dark passage between the buildings to the west and at the end of it, jump down. You will find this item on a dead body.

items.name: Imp Head (Elder)
items.description: Found as a treasure inside Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs. Inside a room on the second floor, guarded by a Burial Tree Watchdog.

items.name: Imp Head (Wolf)
items.description: Helmet. Found inside Minor Erdtree Catacombs, held by a corpse laying over a sarcophagus.

items.name: Impaler's Catacombs
items.description: Mini-dungeon. The entrance can be found by following the cliffside on the eastern edge of Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Impaler's Catacombs
items.description: Site of Grace found within the Impaler's Catacombs, near the entrance.

items.name: Impassable Greatbridge
items.description: A heavily guarded great bridge that leads to the Redmane Castle of Caelid.

items.name: Impassable Greatbridge Redmane Waygate
items.description: Waygate. Found across the Impassable Greatbridge Site of Grace towards Redmane Castle. Teleports you to the waygate inside Redmane Castle.

items.name: Impassable Greatbridge Waygate
items.description: Waygate. Found at the Impassable Greatbridge Site of Grace outside Redmane Castle. Teleports you inside Redmane Castle.

items.name: Incantation Scarab
items.description: Need to examine the Homecoming Painting at Artist's Shack first. The Incantation Scarab can be found Southwest of the Dragon Burnt Ruins, there will be a gravestone with a ghost sitting in front of it. Interact with the ghost, and it will drop the Incantation Scarab.

items.name: Inescapable Frenzy
items.description: After making your way past Subterranean Shunning-Grounds and defeating Mohg, the Omen, attack the altar at the front of the boss room. It should lower revealing a new area. Continue through here until you are forced to parkour downwards using stone coffins as platforms. Near the bottom you will see a corpse that has Inescapable Frenzy on it.

items.name: Inner Aeonia
items.description: Site of grace within the Swamp of Aeonia

items.name: Inquisitor Ghiza
items.description: NPC Invader. Appears at the far end of the dining room when going up to the upper floor of Volcano Manor.

items.name: Inquisitor's Girandole
items.description: Spear. Dropped by the Abductor Virgins.

items.name: Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear
items.description: From Road to the Manor Site of Grace, head southeast down the slope and turn back towards north. Loot from a small, half-bowl structure guarded by a few Lesser Spider Hand and one Spider Hand.

items.name: Invigorating Cured Meat - 1x Ordina, Liturgical Town
items.description: Found on a body on top of the stairs in Ordina, Liturgical Town

items.name: Invigorating Cured Meat - Zamor Ruins
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse on the eastern side of the ruins.

items.name: Invigorating White Cured Meat - Flame Peak
items.description: Consumable. Found at the bottom of a tree.

items.name: Invigorating White Cured Meat - Woodfolk Ruins
items.description: Found on a corpse guarded by two wormface enemies in Woodfolk Ruins.

items.name: Invigorating White Cured Meat 2x
items.description: Found on a body in the middle of the bridge.

items.name: Irina
items.description: NPC found sitting on a rock at the beginning of the main road in eastern Weeping Peninsula. Hands you Irina's Letter and asks that you deliver it to her father at Castle Morne in the south.

items.name: Iron Ball
items.description: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart.

items.name: Iron Cleaver
items.description: Dropped by one of the enemies that can be found at behind the big door, on the right side.

items.name: Iron Cleaver - Castle Morne
items.description: Dropped by one of the Misbegotten creatures attacking a soldier before reaching the top of Castle Morne.

items.name: Iron Fist Alexander (Eight Location)
items.description: Found in Crumbling Farum Azula. From the Dragon Temple Lift grace (can be accessed by using two Stonesword Keys), go past the plaza full of undead up the flight of stairs, turn right and you'll see two square bracket shaped archways. Jump on the archway on the left (closest to the dragon) to get over to the other side. Alexander can be found directly on the flat arena after crossing the crumbling tower. He will challenge you to a warrior's duel, and if you win, he will reward you with Alexander's Innards and Shard of Alexander. If you lose, he will continue letting you challenge him until you win.

items.name: Iron Fist Alexander (Fifth Location)
items.description: NPC. Alexander's fifth location on this questline. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes, just south of Carian Study Hall. Follow the path south from the Artist's Shack Site of Grace. Alexander will call out for help as the player gets closer to his location. He will ask you to make him "slippery". Use an Oil Pot to free him.

items.name: Iron Fist Alexander (First Location)
items.description: Alexander, a huge cauldron with arms and legs, is stuck on the ground and needs help.

items.name: Iron Fist Alexander (Fourth Location)
items.description: NPC. Third location on this questline. He can then be summoned for the boss fight against Starscourge Radahn. If he has not been interacted with prior to this, he will show up at the festival anyway and introduce himself. Before moving to his next location, he can be found scavenging at Starscourge Radahn's Site of Grace.

items.name: Iron Fist Alexander (Second Location)
items.description: Found inside Gael Tunnel, at the rear entrance. After talking to him, he sets off to Redmane Castle

items.name: Iron Fist Alexander (Sixth Location)
items.description: NPC. Alexander's Fifth location on this questline. Found near the Seethewater Terminus Site of Grace at a lava lake south of Fort Laiedd in Mt. Gelmir. Alexander is sitting in the lake behind a Magma Wyrm. It is recommended to consider healing before engaging in conversation.

items.name: Iron Fist Alexander (Third Location)
items.description: He can be found here waiting for the festival to start.

items.name: Iron Whetblade
items.description: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

items.name: Isolated Divine Tower
items.description: Tower to activate Malenia's Great Rune

items.name: Isolated Merchant
items.description: General Goods vendor found sitting in his shack. Sells the Lantern and Lost Ashes of War, among other useful items.

items.name: Isolated Merchant (Raya Lucaria)
items.description: Merchant. Sells Spirit Ashes, Cookbook, Stonesword Key, Warrior Set, and several useful items.

items.name: Isolated Merchant Dragonbarrow
items.description: General Goods vendor found sitting outside his shack in western Dragonbarrow.

items.name: Isolated Merchant's Shack (Dragonbarrow)
items.description: Secluded hut found in western Dragonbarrow.

items.name: Isolated Merchant's Shack (Dragonbarrow)
items.description: Site of Grace found inside the Isolated Merchant's Shack.

items.name: Isolated Merchant's Shack (Weeping Peninsula)
items.description: Site of Grace outside the Isolated Merchant's Shack.

items.name: Isolated Merchant's Shack (Weeping Peninsula)
items.description: A wooden hut far to the west of the Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Ivory Sickle
items.description: Dagger. Can be found at the Village of the Albinaurics.It is up a small hill from the Site of Grace, past a perfumer enemy, behind a coffin. Nearby, Albus hides as a pot.

items.name: Jar
items.description: Given by Iron Fist Alexander.

items.name: Jar Bairn
items.description: Jar Bairn can be found in Jarburg and will ask you to become Potentate, but deems your hands too rough.

items.name: Jar Cannon
items.description: Ballista. Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot when defeated.

items.name: Jarburg
items.description: Jarburg Village of Living Jars. Abundant herb materials and some Smithing Stone (3) can be found here.

items.name: Jarburg
items.description: Site of Grace found in the village of Jarburg.

items.name: Jarwight Puppet
items.description: Spirit Ashes. Can be bought from a body in Seluvis's Rise for Starlight Shards after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

items.name: Jellyfish Shield
items.description: On a dead body surrounded by four Jellyfish directly north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace.

items.name: Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood
items.description: A hostile NPC that you can invade as part of the final contract for the Volcano Manor questline. Drops Hoslow's Petal Whip along with Hoslow's Set upon defeat.

items.name: Juvenile Scholar Cap
items.description: Light Helmet. Found by touching a ghost at the graveyard. This ghost also gives Juvenile Scholar Robe and 1x Larval Tear. This is the location from the Resurrection Painting.

items.name: Juvenile Scholar Robe
items.description: Light Chest Armor. Found by touching a ghost at the graveyard. This ghost also gives Juvenile Scholar Cap and 1x Larval Tear. This is the location from the Resurrection Painting.

items.name: Kaiden Sellsword Ashes
items.description: Found within Cliffbottom Catacombs. Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog.

items.name: Karolos Glintstone Crown
items.description: Drops from the Crystallized Crab that can be found by a corner on the west side of the academy's courtyard.

items.name: Katar
items.description: First Weapon. Looted from a treasure chest in Fort Gael. You can find the chest inside a dark room on the elevated platform above the Lion Guardian.

items.name: Kenneth Haight (Final Location)
items.description: Kenneth Haight can be located in the Throne Room in Stormveil Castle��for��his final location.

items.name: Kenneth Haight (First Location)
items.description: Kenneth Haight is first encountered at this spot. He is seen dramatically calling out for someone to aid him in his plight.

items.name: Kenneth Haight (Second Location)
items.description: Kenneth Haight will move to this location after you clear our Fort Haight. He can be found up on the battlements where you fought the Beast Crest Heater Knight.

items.name: Kindred of Rot
items.description: Optional Boss. Found by falling through holes to reach the lowest floor of Seethewater Cave.

items.name: Kindred of Rot Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in the Caelid Catacombs.

items.name: Kindred of Rot's Exultation
items.description: Talisman. Dropped by the Kindred of Rot.

items.name: Kingsrealm Ruins
items.description: A large set of ruins found in northwest Liurnia.

items.name: Kukri
items.description: Looted off a corpse behind the Glintstone Dragon Smarag.

items.name: Lake-Facing Cliffs
items.description: Site of grace facing the vast lake

items.name: Lakeside Crystal Cave
items.description: Small cave south from the Scenic Isle Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Lance
items.description: On top of the big square structure to the west of Deathtouched Catacombs. Jump off the nearby cliff to reach the top.

items.name: Lance Talisman
items.description: Found at the north of Limgrave past the main road close to the edge.

items.name: Land Octopus Ovary
items.description: Defeat Land Octopus to obtain.

items.name: Land Octopus Ovary (B)
items.description: Crafting Material, found against the wall, on a small campsite where two Ghost Jellyfish dwell.

items.name: Land Squirt Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ashes. Found at a grave with several groups of land squirts nearby on the east shore of Liurnia Lake. To reach it, start at the Gate Town Bridge site of grace, go down to ground level, and simply travel north along the shore.

items.name: Lannseax's Glaive
items.description: Dropped by Ancient Dragon Lansseaxt.

items.name: Large Club
items.description: On the lowest cliff south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, near a spiritspring

items.name: Large Glintstone Scrap
items.description: Accessed from Limgrave Tunnels. Underground. It can be found on a body, inside a little hut guarded by dogs.

items.name: Large Glintstone Scrap - 2x Morne Tunnel
items.description: Two can be looted off a corpse behind the small shack in Morne Tunnel.

items.name: Large Glintstone Scrap - 3x Sealed Tunnel
items.description: Offensive Consumable. A set of 3 can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel. In the chamber with the exploding Abnormal Stone Clusters, check the northeast for a corpse behind a wheelbarrow.

items.name: Larval Tear
items.description: Dropped by a Runebear disguised as a pilgrim in the Consecrated Snowfield. The disguised pilgrim is half-buried in snow with two other pilgrims, one carrying a torch, standing around it. They are located southeast of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield site of grace, nearly on the straight-line path between the grace and the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

items.name: Larval Tear (B)
items.description: Key Item. Found by touching a ghost at the graveyard. This ghost also gives Juvenile Scholar Cap and Juvenile Scholar Robe. This is the location from the Resurrection Painting.

items.name: Larval Tear - 1x Enemy Drop Caelid
items.description: Larval Tear dropped by a Troll disguised as a regular enemy.

items.name: Larval Tear - 1x Limgrave Bear Drop
items.description: Key item used for Rebirth. Obtained by defeating a regular Noble enemy, that transforms into a Lesser Rune Bear. If you kill the Bear form a larval tear will drop.

items.name: Larval Tear - Liurnia of the Lakes
items.description: Key item used for Rebirth. Dropped by a Grafted Scion disguised as a Giant Lobster when defeated. Located between Rose Church and Boilprawn Shack.

items.name: Larval Tear - Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Dropped by Colossal Wormface disguised as charred corpse when defeated. Due East from the Road of Inequities grace, upon entering the ruined camp, and next to the first corpse fire will be the charred remains enemy

items.name: Larval Tear - Ruins
items.description: Dropped from a Miniboss disguises as a noble inside the ruins.

items.name: Larval Tear - Village of the Albinaurics
items.description: Key Item. Can be found at the graveyard in the Village of the Albinaurics, near the town well.

items.name: Laskyar Ruins
items.description: Ruins found in the marshes south of the lake.

items.name: Laskyar Ruins Waygate
items.description: A Waygate that transports the user to the Raya Lucaria Academy's main entrance. Found in a gazebo in the center of the Laskyar Ruins.

items.name: Latenna
items.description: NPC found in Slumbering Wolf's Shack. Promising Latenna to take her to the Haligtree, she will join the player and willingly become a Spirit Ash summon, Latenna the Albinauric. She will also hint at the location of the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left).

items.name: Latenna the Albinauric
items.description: In order for Latenna to be friendly and become a spirit, one has to have the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), give to the player by Albus at the Village of the Albinaurics.

items.name: Lazuli Glintstone Crown
items.description: Looted from a Crystal Crab. Click Here for a detailed guide on how to get it.

items.name: Leaden Hardtear
items.description: Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit

items.name: Leather Set (No Helmet)
items.description: Dropped by Patches if the player decides to defeat him.

items.name: Leather-Draped Tabard
items.description: Chance to drop from regular Soldier enemies found in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Lenne's Rise
items.description: Tower located at the eastern part of Caelid.

items.name: Lenne's Rise. (Site of Grace)
items.description: Site of Grace at the entrance of Lenne's Rise

items.name: Leonine Misbegotten
items.description: Optional Greater Enemy Boss. Can be found by heading southeast from the "Beside the Rampart Gaol" Site of Grace, through the wooden bridge and down a ladder onto the shores below. Drops the Grafted Blade Greatsword upon defeat.

items.name: Letter from Volcano Manor
items.description: Quest Item. A letter outlining your mission after pledging your services to the Volcano Manor. Found in a room unlocked using the Drawing-Room Key.

items.name: Letter to Bernahl
items.description: Quest Item. A letter outlining Bernahl's mission. Given by Bernahl after completing two quests for the Volcano Manor.

items.name: Letter to Patches
items.description: Quest Item. A letter outlining Patches' mission. Given by Patches after completing two quests for the Volcano Manor.

items.name: Leyndell Catacombs
items.description: The Leyndell Catacombs is a massive underground mausoleum found beneath the Royal Capital. These catacombs are accessed via the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

items.name: Leyndell Colosseum
items.description: The Colosseum in Leyndell can be seen immediately when you enter the city from East Capital Rampart, in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Ashes
items.description: Found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave. After a floor collapsed, make your way back up and retrieve from a corpse.

items.name: Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description: Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Lhutel the Headless
items.description: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade inside the Tombsward Catacombs

items.name: Liftside Chamber
items.description: Site of Grace within Stormveil Castle, towards the west.

items.name: Lightning Grease - 4x Sealed Tunnel
items.description: Weapon Coating. A set of 4 can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel. In the chamber with the exploding Abnormal Stone Clusters near the end of the dungeon, dispel the wall opposite the wooden stairs to reveal a deep pit with roots strewn jutting across the walls. Drop down onto the second root and check the corpse on a ledge along the north wall.

items.name: Lightning Grease - 5x Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Weapon Coating. A set of 5 can be found behind the narrow path laden with dragon statues. Traverse the length of the path and then turn left at the end to get to the backside, behind the wall. The items are found on a corpse near the southern end of this area.

items.name: Lightning Grease - Altus Plateau
items.description: Consumable. Looted from a corpse in the middle of a camp in Altus Plateau

items.name: Lightning Greatbolt - 5x Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Ammunition. A set of 5 can be found on a corpse on a small upper balcony connected to the rotunda structure northeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. To get up here, drop down the large roof south of the gazebo and then down to the walkway in the east. Check the northeast edge of this walkway to find a platform you can jump onto to reach the rotunda's lower balcony where you can ride the lift to the top level. The corpse is guarded by a Beastman.

items.name: Lightning Scorpion Charm
items.description: Found in Wyndham Catacombs in a room sealed by an Imp Statue, requires a Stonesword Key.

items.name: Lightning Strike
items.description: Incantation. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the lower section of the crevasse. When approaching from either the eastern or western cliffs, look for stone platforms jutting out of the cliffside to safely descend to the area. Beware as the area is constantly being pummeled by lightning and there are several Giant bats guarding the scarab as well.

items.name: Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear
items.description: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar.

items.name: Lightningproof Dried Liver
items.description: Found on the third body on the staircase in the main road.

items.name: Lightningproof Dried Liver - Altus Plateau
items.description: Consumable. Found on a wrecked carriage near the Altus Plateau Site of Grace

items.name: Lightningproof Dried Liver - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Consumable. On a corpse in front of a hole in the wall on the right, guarded by Beastmen.

items.name: Limgrave Colosseum
items.description: Can be reached by following the path north of Warmaster's Shack.

items.name: Limgrave Tower Bridge
items.description: Site of Grace found near the eastern bridge.

items.name: Limgrave Tunnels
items.description: On the northern area of the Agheel Lake, you can find the rich Limgrave Tunnels

items.name: Limgrave Tunnels
items.description: Limgrave Tunnels Site of Grace, located just below the main elevator.

items.name: Lionel's Set
items.description:
Next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace, over a bed.
IMPORTANT: If you burn the Erdtree and progress to the Ashen Capital, you can no longer obtain Lionel's Set if you haven't picked it up earlier.

items.name: Liurnia Highway North
items.description: Site of Grace found on the side of the road.

items.name: Liurnia Highway South
items.description: Site of Grace on the side of the road.

items.name: Liurnia Lake Shore
items.description: Site of Grace found on the southern landmass, by the Nomadic Merchant.

items.name: Liurnia Tower Bridge
items.description: Site of Grace at the bridge leading to the Divine Tower of Liurnia.

items.name: Living Jar Shard - 1x Jarburg
items.description: Crafting Material. Looted from a body inside one of the shacks in Jarburg.

items.name: Living Jar Shard - 3x Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: You can find x3 Living Shard at the Raya Lucaria Academy in the Debate Hall door.

items.name: Lone Wolf Ashes
items.description: Given to players by Renna at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave. Return to the Church after getting the ability to summon your Spectral Steed from Melina. You will find Renna sitting by the ruins of the church.

items.name: Longhaft Axe
items.description: Rare drop from enemies wielding it at Castle Mourne in Weeping Peninsula. There is an easy to kill one from Beside the Rampant Gaol site of grace, cross the bridge and will be on the left sleeping.

items.name: Longtail Cat Talisman
items.description: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the bottom section of the large rotating lift. Past the graveyard section of Raya Lucaria Academy, simply ride the lift down and defeat the single Pendulum Statue enemy.

items.name: Lord Contender's Evergaol
items.description: Evergaol with Boss Fight: Roundtable Knight Vyke, who drops the Fingerprint Set.

items.name: Lord of Blood's Exultation
items.description: Drops from Esgar, Priest of Blood in Leyndell Catacombs.

items.name: Lord of Blood's Favor
items.description: Key Item. Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading other players 3 times and talking to him, then accepting to be knighted.

items.name: Lord of Blood's Favor - Church of Inhibition
items.description: Key Item. Found on a seated deceased maiden with the Church of Inhibition. Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading other players 3 times and talking to him, then accepting to be knighted.

items.name: Lord's Rune
items.description: Drops from the Erdtree Avatar that patrols the road.

items.name: Lord's Rune - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found atop the fountain located just outside the Dragon Temple Lift, after ascending the lift into the plaza.

items.name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword. Found inside a Wagon Chest.

items.name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword (B)
items.description: Dropped by a head-less, undead Soldier at Fourth Church of Marika.

items.name: Loretta's Greatbow
items.description: Sorcery. Dropped by Royal Knight Loretta upon defeat.

items.name: Loretta's Mastery
items.description: Sorcery. Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree

items.name: Loretta's War Sickle
items.description: Halberd. Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

items.name: Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree
items.description: Great Enemy. Found in the large courtyard of a temple in Miquella's Haligtree.

items.name: Lost Ashes of War - 1x Mountaintops of the Giants
items.description: Key Item. Found on a corpse sitting on a chair in the narrow stretch heading north in Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Lost Ashes of War - Capital Outskirts
items.description: Key Item used to duplicate Ashes of War. Found by the locked gate in the northwestern Capital Outskirts.

items.name: Lost Ashes of War - Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description: Found at the bottom of the sewers.

items.name: Lost Ashes of War - Miquella's Haligtree
items.description: Ash of War Upgrade. Found on a corpse slumped over in front of a statue in Miquella's Haligtree canopy.

items.name: Lost Ashes of War - Ruin-Strewn Precipice
items.description: Behind two Chanting Winged Dames within the higher levels of Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

items.name: Lost Ashes of War - Sellia Hideaway
items.description: Found on a corpse in Sellia Hideaway, at the bottom of a pit.

items.name: Lost Ashes of War - Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
items.description: Lost Ashes of War. Found in the room before Dung Eater's cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the Royal Capital. Beware the Giant Spider Hand that emerges as you loot the item.

items.name: Lucerne
items.description: East of Highland Lookout Tower in East Liurnia of the Lakes, found in the battlefield between phantoms and knights near where the armored giant spawns. Break some carts to reveal the treasure.

items.name: Lucidity
items.description: Dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the secret area of the Carian Study Hall unlocked using the Carian Inverted Statue.

items.name: Lump of Flesh
items.description: can be looted from a corpse by the beachside near the Seaside Ruins Site of Grace in south of Limgrave. The corpse is being guarded by a Giant Crab.

items.name: Lump of Flesh
items.description: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse on the field.

items.name: Lump of Flesh
items.description: Can be found on a dead body by the road.

items.name: Lump of Flesh
items.description: The item can be looted from a dead body.

items.name: Lump of Flesh - 5x Volcano Cave
items.description: Material. Looted from a body at the bottom of Volcano Cave

items.name: Lump of Flesh - Seethewater Cave
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse in Seethewater Cave, guarded by some Giant Rats.

items.name: Lunar Estate Ruins
items.description: The ruins of a large estate found in the southern plateau of Liurnia, accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline.

items.name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
items.description: Glintstone Staff. Found in a chest in the building north of the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses' chamber after defeating them.

items.name: Lusat's Set
items.description: After completing Sorceress Sellen questline, you will find the complete Lusat's Set at Master Lusat's location.

items.name: Lux Ruins
items.description: Ruins located north of the Grand Lift of Dectus.

items.name: Mad Pumpkin Head (Caelem Ruins)
items.description: Dual Boss Fight against two Mad Pumpkin Heads. They are found in an underground room, the entrance to which is in the eastern side of the ruins. No drops but allows access to a treasure room upon defeat.

items.name: Mad Pumpkin Head (Waypoint Ruins)
items.description: Field Boss. Found directly below the Waypoint Ruins.

items.name: Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes
items.description: Spirit Summon Ash. Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog duo bosses within the Minor Erdtree Catacombs.

items.name: Magic Downpour
items.description: Magic Downpour is a Sorcery dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the Carian Study Hall.

items.name: Magic Grease - 1x Raya Lucaria Academy Entrance
items.description: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the platform to the right of the gate after entering Raya Lucaria Academy

items.name: Magic Grease - 1x Second Graveyard Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Consumable Item. Looted of a corpse in the second graveyard of Raya Lucaria Academy, before the room leading to the elevator to the higher areas.

items.name: Magic Grease - 2x Caria Manor
items.description: Consumable. Two found on a corpse on a lower ledge reachable by jumping to the building on the left of the door as you enter and going up the ladder to the higher platform.

items.name: Magic Grease - 2x Converted Tower
items.description: Consumable Item.Two can be looted from a corpse behind Converted Tower

items.name: Magic Grease - 2x Raya Lucaria Rooftops
items.description: Consumable Item. Looted off a corpse on the rooftops of the Church of Cuckoo, protected by two Avionette Soldiers.

items.name: Magic Grease - 3x Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description: Weapon Coating. A set of 3 can be found in the southeast corridor after ascending the lift near the Capital Rampartgrace. The items are on a corpse pressed against the right wall.

items.name: Magic Grease - 3x War-Dead Catacombs
items.description: Weapon Coating. Found inside the War-Dead Catacombs, on a corpse right in the center of the large chamber with the 4 staircases.

items.name: Magic Grease - East Limgrave
items.description: Can be found in the graveyard on the small cliff.

items.name: Magic Grease - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Can be found inside Stormveil Castle, on a corpse laying in the courtyard.

items.name: Magic Grease - Wyndham Ruins
items.description: Found in the room behind the rusted bars in the sewers. Can be reached by going underneath the raising floor in the spiked room.

items.name: Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear
items.description: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar.

items.name: Magma Shot
items.description: Sorcery. Rewarded by Tanith after completing the first letter quest.

items.name: Magma Whip Candlestick
items.description: Whip. Rewarded by Patches after completing his Volcano Manor quest.

items.name: Magma Wyrm (Gael Tunnel)
items.description: Found inside Gael Tunnel. Drops x1 Dragon Heart and Moonveil

items.name: Magma Wyrm (Mt Gelmir Lava Pool)
items.description: Optional Dragon Boss in the lava pool on the western section of Mt. Gelmir. Drops a Dragon Heart upon defeat.

items.name: Magma Wyrm (Volcano Manor)
items.description: Optional Field Boss. Pops out of the lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon after taking the cage lift down.

items.name: Magma Wyrm Makar
items.description: This Boss fight is accessed through Ruin-Strewn Precipice, upon reaching the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook Site of Grace.

items.name: Magma Wyrm Site of Grace
items.description: Site of Grace for Magma Wyrm

items.name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
items.description: Curved Greatsword dropped by Magma Wyrm Makar

items.name: Magnus the Beast Claw
items.description: The red summon sign for this NPC can be found at Writheblood Ruins in Altus Plateau, after accepting Varre's quest in Liurnia of the Lakes. 1x Festering Bloody Finger is needed for each invasion attempt, and counts towards completion of the questline.

items.name: Main Academy Gate
items.description: Site of grace at the main entrance to Raya Lucaria Academy.

items.name: Main Caria Manor Gate
items.description: Site of Grace found by the southern gate to Caria Manor. Be careful when traversing the fields outside the manor, as a rain of energy projectiles will constantly bombard you until you reach this Site of Grace.

items.name: Malefactor's Evergaol
items.description: Evergaol found on the southern landmass of Liurnia. The boss Adan, Thief of Fire is imprisoned within.

items.name: Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan
items.description: Non-Invader Hostile NPC. Found in the fields west of The Shaded Castle. Drops Antspur Rapier, Marais Mask and Marais Robe upon defeat.

items.name: Malenia's Great Rune
items.description: Great Rune. Dropped by Malenia, Blade of Miquella upon defeat.

items.name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
items.description: Demigod. Found past a fog door southwest of the Haligtree Roots Site of Grace.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Set
items.description: Armor Set comprised of the Malformed Dragon Helm, Malformed Dragon Armor, Malformed Dragon Gauntlets and the Malformed Dragon Greaves. Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel at the end of the Great Bridge, guarding the final area of Crumbling Farum Azula.

items.name: Man-Serpent Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ash. Found on an altar protected by some enemies in Volcano Manor's dungeon.

items.name: Manor Lower Level
items.description: Site of Grace found in a chapel building on the west side of the estate.

items.name: Manor Towershield
items.description: Greatshield. From the Secluded Cell site of grace, backtrack to the west and up the ramp where the Living Jars are and turn around towards the wooden platform. At the end of the platform, jump onto the ledge on the wall and follow it to the right towards some archways. Past the archways, enter the storage room on the right and head up the stairs to a walkway above. Head to the left towards a larger storage room full of Commoners. You can find the shield under the second set of stairs in this room.

items.name: Manor Upper Level
items.description: Site of Grace found in a room in the east. Accessible by using the garden walkways from the chapel building in the west and then taking a lift up a tower.

items.name: Mantis Blade
items.description: Dropped by a Cemetary Shade inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave. This enemy can be found by heading down the first Chariot hall until you reach a point where there is a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop into the left pit onto some wooden beams and then drop into the room below. The shade is in an alcove in the eastern wall.

items.name: Map (Altus Plateau)
items.description: Can be found near the round, just north of the Altus Highway Junction site of grace

items.name: Map (Caelid)
items.description: Map Fragment. Reveals the Caelid region excluding Dragonbarrow. Found on a monolith at the Caelid Highway South intersection.

items.name: Map (Consecrated Snowfield)
items.description: Map for all of Consecrated Snowfield: follow the road north past the snowstorm until you go down and cross a frozen river, then you will spot the map pillar ahead.

items.name: Map (Dragonbarrow)
items.description: Map Fragment. Reveals the Dragonbarrow region. Found on a monolith along the road east of the Dragonbarrow West Site of Grace.

items.name: Map (Leyndell, Royal Capital)
items.description: Map Fragment. Reveals the Leyndell region. Found on a monolith near the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace.

items.name: Map (Limgrave, East)
items.description: At the foot of a pillar with ancient writings on it. Unlocks Eastern Limgrave on your map.

items.name: Map (Limgrave, West)
items.description: At the foot of a pillar. Unlocks Western Limgrave on your map

items.name: Map (Liurnia, East)
items.description: It's in the middle of the swampy lake, by a monument that has highlightened texts over it.

items.name: Map (Liurnia, West)
items.description: Map Fragment. Reveals western Liurnia. Found on a monolith along the road by a junction.

items.name: Map (Mountaintops of The Giants, East)
items.description: Found at the altar. You can arrive by walking on the chain from the enemy encampment.

items.name: Map (Mt. Gelmir)
items.description: Map of Mt. Gelmir region

items.name: Map (Weeping Peninsula)
items.description: Map for all of Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Map Mountaintops of the Giants, West
items.description: As you leave the Grand Lift of Rold, take the path forward until you reach a stone monument on your right, interact with it to obtain the map Fragment.

items.name: Map: Liurnia, North
items.description: Can be found over a grave-like big stone, at Academy Gate Town,

items.name: Marais Executioner's Sword
items.description: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle.

items.name: Marais Mask
items.description: Light Helm. Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan upon defeat.

items.name: Marais Robe
items.description: Light Chest Armor. Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan upon defeat.

items.name: Margit, the Fell Omen
items.description: Margit the Fell Omen Site of Grace, located at the boss arena of Margit, near Stormvel Castle.

items.name: Margit, the Fell Omen
items.description: A large, apparently elder creature, self-proclaimed as "The last of all kings". Drops Talisman Pouch and 12000 Runes upon defeat.

items.name: Margit, The Fell Omen (Leyndell)
items.description: Margit can be fought again as a non-respawning miniboss in Capital Leyndell, near the end of the game.

items.name: Marika's Soreseal
items.description: Talisman. Found on an altar in a room requiring 2 Stonesword Keys to unlock. This room is in the southeast, on the lower levels.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Ashes
items.description: When you reach the graveyard section, as you cross the other side of the bridge, make a hard left and drop down to find a path that curves to where the Marionette Soldiers are, kill the two soldiers and then loot the corpse that is hanging by the ledge to find this item.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Birdhelm
items.description: Dropped by Avionette Soldier enemies. Right next to the site of grace

items.name: Marred Leather Shield
items.description: Shield. Found on a corpse on a wooden platform, outside the castle walls.

items.name: Marred Wooden Shield
items.description: Medium Shield. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, exit onto the walkway with explosive barrels and War Hawks. Kill the War Hawk sitting on the western tower and then jump down the edge onto a ledge below. Follow the ledge north and jump down to the broken pillar below to find the shield.

items.name: Mask of Confidence
items.description: Helm. Found on a corpse laying on the walls of the secret area of the Carian Study Hall unlocked using the Carian Inverted Statue.

items.name: Master Lusat
items.description: A Quest NPC found inside the Sellia Hideaway dungeon, by dropping down pits surrounded by crystals. The path to him is sealed by a barrier that requires a key acquired from Sorceress Sellen during her questline.

items.name: Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter at the Church of Vows upon defeat.

items.name: Medicine Peddler's Bell Bearing
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter that invades the Hermit Merchant's Shack at night time.

items.name: Meeting Place Map
items.description: Can be found at the entrace of the Raya Lucarian academy, on lying corpse.

items.name: Memory Stone - Converted Tower
items.description: Memory Upgrade Material. Found in a chest on the top floor of the Converted Tower.

items.name: Memory Stone - Hermit Village
items.description: Memory Slot Upgrade Material. Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Maggie upon defeat.

items.name: Memory Stone - Lenne's Rise
items.description: Memory Slot Upgrade Item. Found in a chest at the top of Lenne's Rise. The entrance to the tower is sealed but you can use a Spiritspring in the back of the tower to land on a balcony and gain entry.

items.name: Memory Stone - Oridys's Rise
items.description: Memory Upgrade Material. Found in a chest at the top floor of Oridys's Rise.

items.name: Memory Stone - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Rewarded as a drop upon defeating Red Wolf of Radagon.

items.name: Memory Stone - Seluvis's Rise
items.description: Memory Slot Upgrade Material. Found on the top floor of Seluvis's Rise.

items.name: Memory Stone - Testu's Rise
items.description: Memory Slot Upgrade Material. Found in a chest at the top floor of Testu's Rise.

items.name: Merchant Kale
items.description: General Goods Vendor. Found sitting by the fire in the ruins of the Church of Elleh. Sells the Telescope and Crafting Kit key items.

items.name: Meteor Bolt - 5x Raya Lucaria Academy Rooftops
items.description: Consumable Item. Five can be looted from a corpse on the tower after the encounter with three Avionette Soldiers and a Sorcerer

items.name: Meteoric Ore Blade
items.description: Katana. Found inside a chest in a small room at the back of an underground hall filled with sarcophagi and Prawn Miners enemies. The entrance is found in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins.

items.name: Meteorite
items.description: Sorcery. Dropped by the Alabaster Lord upon defeat.

items.name: Meteorite of Astel
items.description: Gravity Sorcery. Dropped by Astel, Stars of Darkness, the boss of Yelough Anix Tunnel.

items.name: Meteorite Staff
items.description: Glintstone Staff with S scaling but no upgrades. Found on a corpse hanging from a window in Street of Sages Ruins in the swamp of Caelid.

items.name: Millicent (Fifth Location)
items.description: NPC. Millicent will move to the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace at��Mountaintops of the Giants��after her encounter at the��Windmill Heights Grace.

items.name: Millicent (Final Location)
items.description: NPC. Millicent will be available at the Prayer Room Grace at��Elphael Brace of the Haligtree. She will not move from this spot until the player has defeated a��Ulcerated Tree Spirit��mini-boss just before the Drainage Channel Grace. Go up the slope, up the stairs, up the hill, and then across the branch to reach the boss arena.��

items.name: Millicent (First Location)
items.description: Millicent can be found in the Church of the Plague slumped against a wall.

items.name: Millicent (Fourth Location)
items.description: Moves here after Godskin Apostle is defeated.

items.name: Millicent (NPC Invader)
items.description: Found in the South-East of the Swamp of Aeonia near the geysers. NPC drop: Sacremental Bud, Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [5], Golden Rune [10]

items.name: Millicent (Second Location)
items.description: She will appear here, after you give her the Unalloyed Gold Needle

items.name: Millicent (Third Location)
items.description: Found at the hill.

items.name: Millicent's Prosthesis
items.description:
When you are given the choice between assisting Millicent and challenging her, choose to challenge her. When you kill
her, you will automatically receive this talisman.

items.name: Mimic's Veil
items.description: Reusable Key Item. Found in a chest inside the assembly room with the large war table. There is a Banished Knight in this room.

items.name: Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau)
items.description: Minor Erdtree found in central Altus Plateau.

items.name: Minor Erdtree (Caelid)
items.description: Erdtree of Caelid found in the northwest, near the border to Limgrave.

items.name: Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield)
items.description: Minor Erdtree found in the Consecrated Snowfield

items.name: Minor Erdtree (Dragonbarrow)
items.description: A Minor Erdtree in eastern Dragonbarrow, overlooking the eastern roads.

items.name: Minor Erdtree (Liurnia Northeast)
items.description: Minor Erdtree in the Northeast part of the Liurnia of the Lakes region.

items.name: Minor Erdtree (Liurnia Southwest)
items.description: Minor Erdtree found in the plateaus in the southwest of Liurnia.

items.name: Minor Erdtree (Mistwood)
items.description: A Minor Erdtree found in the Mistwood sub-region of Limgrave in the east.

items.name: Minor Erdtree (Mountaintops East)
items.description: Minor Erdtree found on the eastern half of the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir)
items.description: A withered Minor Erdtree found in northern Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Minor Erdtree Catacombs
items.description: Optional Dungeon found beneath the Minor Erdtree. The entrance is found slightly southeast of the tree, by the cliff face.

items.name: Minor Erdtree Catacombs
items.description: Site of Grace found within the Minor Erdtree Catacombs, a few steps from the entrance.

items.name: Minor Erdtree Church
items.description: Found outside the west gate to Leyndell Capital City surrounding a Minor Erdtree..

items.name: Minor Erdtree Church
items.description: The Site of Grace is right in front of the Erdtree.

items.name: Miquella's Haligtree
items.description: Legacy Dungeon. North from the Consecrated Snowfield. Miquella's Haligtree is accessed by doing the Evergaol puzzle located at Ordina, Liturgical Town

items.name: Miquella's Lily
items.description: Can be found near the Village of the Albinaurics before the bridge.

items.name: Miquella's Lily
items.description: Can be found next to a tree on the cliff.

items.name: Miquella's Lily
items.description: Can be found at Lenne's Rise , under the arch tower.

items.name: Miquella's Lily
items.description: Can be found in front of the cliffside near the trees.

items.name: Miquella's Lily
items.description: Can be foun near a broken pillar on the cliff, next the Gatekeeper Statue.

items.name: Miquella's Lily
items.description: Can be found in front of a massive tree next to the cliff.

items.name: Miquella's Lily
items.description: Can be found Behind Forth Faroth.

items.name: Miquella's Lily
items.description: Can be found at the end of the righ side of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

items.name: Miquella's Lily
items.description: Crafting Item. Can be found on the road to the Minor Erdtree (Dragonbarrow).

items.name: Miquella's Lily - 3x Caria Manor Grounds
items.description: Crafting Material. Found within the grounds of Caria Manor

items.name: Miquella's Lily - 3x Temple Quarter
items.description: Crafting Material. Can be gathered from the ruins near the circle of white flowers.

items.name: Miquella's Lily - 5x Liurnia Ravine
items.description: Crafting Material. Can be gathered near the gravestones behind a Lesser Red Wolf of Radagon, in the graveyard behind Caria Manor

items.name: Miquella's Lily - Altus Plateau
items.description: Crafting Material. Can be grabbed from a gravestone near Mirage Rise in Altus Plateau

items.name: Miquella's Lily - Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description: Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital. 5 can be found in planters in a plaza off the main road.

items.name: Miquella's Lily - Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Material. Can be gathered in west Mt. Gelmir, on the cliffs behind the Craftsman's Shack.

items.name: Miquella's Lily - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: You can find x3 Miquella's Lily near the a fountain, in the center of the academy's courtyard, guarded by five lake humanoid creatures.

items.name: Miquella's Lily - Sellia, Town of Sorcery
items.description: Can be found at Sellia, Town of Sorcery, right from the main road of Siella, between two houses.

items.name: Miquella's Lily - Shaded Castle Outskirts
items.description: Material. Can be scavenged Found on the cliff behind the Shaded Castle

items.name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
items.description: Straight Sword. Found atop a belltower. You can reach this belltower by entering the second alcove on the left of the eastern walkway, heading up the stairs and then jumping onto the tree branch on the balcony. Follow the tree branch up and across to reach the tower.

items.name: Mirage Rise
items.description: An area with a mystic glow. Adventurers who solve the riddle and touch the Phantom Crests found across the fields will unveil the Mirage Rise and reap its rewards.

items.name: Miranda Powder
items.description: Once you are back inside, roll onto the blocked door, and loot this on your left. You will get x10 Miranda Powder.

items.name: Miranda Sprout Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ashes. Found behind a hidden wall in Caelid Catacombs. You must attack a wall to the right of the staircase to reveal a path to the ashes.

items.name: Miranda the Blighted Bloom
items.description: Miranda the Blighted Bloom is a large, poisonous flower within the Tombsward Cave.

items.name: Miranda the Blighted Bloom (Perfumer's Grotto)
items.description: Miranda the Blighted Bloom is encountered in a Duo Boss Fight with an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Grotto. Defeating them both awards the Great Omenkiller Cleaver.

items.name: Miriel, Pastor of Vows
items.description: Miriel is the steward of Church of Vows, and will accept Scrolls and Tomes and teach lore, Incantations and Sorceries.

items.name: Misbegotten Crusader
items.description: Boss found at the end of the Cave of the Forlorn. Drops Golden Order Greatsword

items.name: Misbegotten Shortbow
items.description: There are flying enemies at the top of the castle. Thet may drop this weapon when killed.

items.name: Misbegotten Warrior
items.description: Duo boss of Unsightly Catacombs - paired with Perfumer Tricia. Defeating them grants the Perfumer Tricia Ashes spirit ashes.

items.name: Misericorde
items.description: Dagger. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

items.name: Missionary's Cookbook [3]
items.description: Cookbook item. Found on one of the two corpses in the Smoldering Church.

items.name: Missionary's Cookbook [4]
items.description: Can be found on Minor Erdtree Church, Capital area.

items.name: Missionary's Cookbook [6]
items.description: Key Item. Found by going to Temple of Eiglay Grace and up the elevator, then taking a right onto a balcony to access a tower. Go to the bottom of this tower and find the book in a cell.

items.name: Mistwood Outskirts
items.description: Site of Grace situated next to the main road North of Mistwood Ruins, in the middle of a group of large stones.

items.name: Mistwood Ruins
items.description: An old ruin occupied by a Lesser Runebear. The site is home to a few prized Trina's Lilies.

items.name: Mohg, the Omen
items.description: Located at the end of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

items.name: Moonfolk Ruins
items.description: Ruins found in the southwest of the Liurnia of the Lakes region

items.name: Moongrum, Carian Knight
items.description: Moongrum, Carian Knight. The last line of denfense before reaching Rennala's arena. Drops the Carian Knight's Shield upon defeating the hostile NPC.

items.name: Moonlight Altar
items.description: Site of Grace located outside of the Deep Ainsel Well's exit point, high above the Moonlight Altar plateau in the southwest of Liurnia of The Lakes.

items.name: Moonveil
items.description: Katana. Dropped by Magma Wyrm inside Gael Tunnel.

items.name: Morgott's Great Rune
items.description: Drops from Morgot, The Omen King

items.name: Morgott, The Omen King
items.description: Main Boss. Drops Remembrance of the Omen King and Morgott's Great Rune upon defeat.

items.name: Morne Moangrave
items.description: Site of Grace accessible after defeating the Leonine Misbegotten boss.

items.name: Morne Tunnel
items.description: Morne Tunnel can be found in Weeping Peninsula. To reach it jump down towards the bottom of the canyon next to Ailing Village in Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Morne Tunnel
items.description: Located at Underground Level 1 of Morne Tunnel.

items.name: Morning Star
items.description: Hammer-type Weapon. Found in a chest inside a broken wagon along the road.

items.name: Murkwater Catacombs
items.description: Following the Murkwater, you can find the Murkwater Catacombs.

items.name: Murkwater Cave
items.description: Found halfway over the Murkwater River.

items.name: Murkwater Cave (Site of Grace)
items.description: Site of grace just inside Murkwater Cave

items.name: Murkwater Coast
items.description: Site of grace located at the coasts of Murkwater

items.name: Mushroom
items.description: Can be found at Tower of Return area on a dead body near to the ledge cliff.

items.name: Mushroom
items.description: Can be found at Stormveil Castle, on a dead body down stars.

items.name: Mushroom
items.description: Can be found at Summonwater Village on a dead body

items.name: Mushroom - 5x Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Material. Looted from a corpse outside Gelmir's Hero Grave, guarded by a pack of Wolves

items.name: Mushroom - 5x Purified Ruins North
items.description: Crafting Material. Four can be looted from a corpse guarded by two zombie dogs north from Purified Ruins.

items.name: Mushroom - 5x Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: You can find x5 Mushroom at the Raya Lucaria Academy on a corpse that is behind a tree by the wall.
