items.name: Mushroom - 5x Second Graveyard Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Crafting Material. Five can be looted of a corpse hidden behind some tombstones to the left of the doorway leading to the lift on the second graveyard area.

items.name: Mushroom - 5x Seethewater Terminus
items.description: Material. Looted from a corpse atop a rock, near Seethewater Terminus Site of Grace

items.name: Mushroom - Caelid (Impassable Greatbridge)
items.description: Can be found on a dead body inside a tent.

items.name: Mushroom Set (No Crown)
items.description: Entire armor set excluding Mushroom Crown. Found in a room inside the Seethewater Cave filled with Servants of Rot and a Giant Poison Flower. Includes Mushroom Head, Mushroom Body, Mushroom Arms and Mushroom Legs.

items.name: Nagakiba
items.description: Can be obtained by completing Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's questline at the Second Church of Marika

items.name: Nascent Butterfly
items.description: An exceedingly rare butterfly to find, can be found west on the edge of the mountain near the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly
items.description: Can be found on a corpse on the cliff.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly (D)
items.description: Found on a body over the stairs.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly - 1x Altus Plateau
items.description: Material. Can be gathered under the broken bridge in Altus Plateau

items.name: Nascent Butterfly - 1x Mountaintops of the Giants
items.description: Found near the eastern cliffs of the starting zone in Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly - 1x Mt Gelmir
items.description: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse near the edge of a cliff, outside Seethewater Cave in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly - 1x Ordina, Liturgical Town
items.description: Nascent Butterfly found under the stairs in Ordina, Liturgical Town

items.name: Nascent Butterfly - 1x Perfumer's Ruins
items.description: Material. Looted from a corpse lying in an enclosed space in Perfumer's Ruins.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly - 1x Sage's Cave
items.description: Consumable. Found in a chest behind a illusory wall in Sage's Cave.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly - 1x Zamor Ruins
items.description: Material. Found atop a crumbled wall in Zamor Ruins

items.name: Nascent Butterfly - 2x Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Crafting Materia. A set of 2 found on a corpse under a tree east of the fountain plaza. This area is accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly - Castle Sol
items.description: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse in a room filled with skeletal slimes in the northwest section of the castle, by a ladder.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly - South Zamor Ruins
items.description: Material. Found at the farthest end of Zamor Ruins, near the cliffs

items.name: Necromancer Garris
items.description: One of the bosses of Sage's Cave. Drops flail: Family Heads

items.name: Nepheli Loux (Final Location)
items.description: Nepheli Loux can be located in the Throne Room in Stormveil Castle������������������for������������������her final location.

items.name: Nepheli Loux (First Location)
items.description: Nepheli Loux Location 1. A fellow Tarnished warrior NPC found in a small room near the north of the castle. The entrance to this room is behind the courtyard, along the path leading up to the huge steps guarded by a Troll.

items.name: Nepheli Loux (Second Location)
items.description: NPC. If her quest is being progressed, she can be found at the Village of the Albinaurics after meeting her at the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Neutralizing Boluses - 2x The Shaded Castle
items.description: 2x found on a body on the western ramparts of The Shaded Castle.

items.name: Night Comet
items.description: Night Sorcery spell. Found in a chest in the central section of town. This location is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

items.name: Night's Cavalry (Altus Plateau)
items.description: Found patrolling the road. Only appears at night.

items.name: Night's Cavalry (Caelid)
items.description: Night's Cavalry Miniboss. Roams the Caelid Highway South. Only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight upon defeat.

items.name: Night's Cavalry (Dragonbarrow East)
items.description: Boss that spawns only at night. Drops Ash of War: Bloodhound's Step.

items.name: Night's Cavalry (Forbidden Lands)
items.description: Roams the Forbidden Lands at night time, along the path to the Grand Lift of Rold. Drops the Ash of War: Phantom Slash upon defeat.

items.name: Night's Cavalry (Limgrave)
items.description: Night's Cavalry roams the bridge near Agheel Lake North, only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Repeating Thrust

items.name: Night's Cavalry (Liurnia of the Lakes North)
items.description: Spawns only at night. Drops Ash of War: Giant Hunt and Nightrider Glaive

items.name: Night's Cavalry (Liurnia)
items.description: Night's Cavalry Miniboss found patrolling near the Gate Town Bridge. Only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Ice Spear

items.name: Night's Cavalry (Weeping Peninsula)
items.description: Night's Cavalry Miniboss found patrolling the roads around the Castle Morne Ramparts. Only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Barricade Shield

items.name: Night's Cavalry - 2x (Consecrated Snowfield)
items.description: Two Night's Cavalry mini-bosses guard the wagon in the Consecrated Snowfield. Spawn at night only. Drops Night Cavalry's Set and Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

items.name: Night's Cavalry Set
items.description: Full Set dropped by one of the two mini-boss Night's Cavalry guarding a Consecrated Fields caravan at night.

items.name: Nightrider Flail
items.description: Dropped by Night's Cavalry that spawns at night near Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

items.name: Nightrider Glaive
items.description: Halberd dropped by miniboss Night's Cavalry. Only appears at night.

items.name: Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite
items.description: Site of Grace

items.name: Noble Presence
items.description: Incantation. Dropped by Godskin Noble

items.name: Noble Sorcerer Ashes
items.description: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog inside the Stormfoot Catacombs.

items.name: Noble's Set
items.description: An Armor Set comprised of the Navy Hood, Noble's Traveling Garb, Noble's Gloves and Noble's Trousers.The entire set can be found within East Windmill Pasture, Altus Plateau, in the fire in the middle of a circle of dancing women.

items.name: Nomad Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse in the Subterranean Shunning-Groundsbeneath the capital. This is in a large, multi-level section in the east.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant Caelid South
items.description: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire in south Caelid. Sells the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (15), among other items.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant Castle Morne Rampart
items.description: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire near the Castle Morne Rampart site of grace. Sells Stonesword Key

items.name: Nomadic Merchant East Limgrave
items.description: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire next to the road between Mistwood Ruins and Fort Haight.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant Liurnia of the Lakes
items.description: Found by a campfire on the west road after passing through the outpost to the northwest of Church of Irith, before entering the forest in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire on a ledge halfway up Mt. Gelmir. Sells Stonesword Key and a full set of Confessor armor.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant North Limgrave
items.description: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found playing music by a campfire east of the bridge connecting Stormhill and East Limgrave.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant North Liurnia of the Lakes
items.description: Merchant NPC located next to the river, just pass the Bellum Church's hole in order to find him.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant West Altus Plateau
items.description: Found at the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant West Limgrave
items.description: General Goods vendor found southeast of the Coastal Cave entrance along the beach, sitting by a fire under a collapsed stone structure.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Set
items.description:
Full Armor Set. In the hidden tunnels behind the altar in Mohg, the Omen's boss room at the Cathedral of the Forsaken Site of Grace in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds below Leyndell, Royal Capital. After opening the secret passage behind the altar and taking the stairs down, after crossing the narrow fallen rafter, directly to the left is a tent and in the far corner you can find the full Nomadic Merchant's set.
To get access to the set, you need to destroy tent by either aggroing the enemy close by, leading it next to the tent and baiting its frenzy attack onto it or quit-outing while standing very close to tent itself.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [10]
items.description: Can be found on a dead body in Stormveil Castle. From Rampart Tower (Site of Grace), head out the north door. Jump to the roof immediately visible to the east. Follow the left ledge, then jump down to the level with the 2 enemies (optional combat). Cross the bridge, the recipe is on the corpse directly ahead guarded by 2 weak enemies.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [12]
items.description: Cookbook item found inside the Rose Church, by the southern walls.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14]
items.description: Cookbook item. Found on one of the two corpses in the Smoldering Church.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19]
items.description: Can be found on the ground inside of the smaller ruined building at Woodfolk Ruins in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [21]
items.description: Can be found Inside the Volcano Manor, going upstairs when you enter the hallway from the lobby, enter the first door to the right, the same one with the corpse with a Perfume Bottle. Follow the path through a room full of Snails and you'll end up with a room with two ways forward - one down a flight of steps, another through an open doorway to your left. Head left first, being wary of Snails that may ambush you and continue until you reach a dead end. The corpse at the end of this passageway has the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [21] on it, and to the left of it, reveal another hidden door that opens up into a room with the Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [23]
items.description: On a corpse lying by the road soon after the first Site of Grace of the area.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [4]
items.description: Cookbook item. Obtained in the south of Mistwood. Found on a corpse at the side of the road close to the Siofra River Well.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6]
items.description: Cookbook item. Can be looted from the chest in the room at the top of the main stairs of Fort Haight.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7]
items.description: It can be taken from a dead man sitting at the edge of the collapsed bridge.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8]
items.description: Can be found on a corpse within the Tombsward Cave.

items.name: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9]
items.description: Cookbook item. Found inside the Tombsward Catacombs, locked behind an imp statue barrier. Requires a Stonesword Key to break the seal.

items.name: Northern Liurnia Lake Shore
items.description: Site of Grace found by the road leading to north Liurnia.

items.name: Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame
items.description: Info Item. Found on a corpse in a corner behind a broken shack, soon after entering Frenzied Flame Village from the northeast (Frenzy-Flaming Tower side)

items.name: Nox Flowing Sword
items.description: Curved Sword. Dropped by the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses upon defeat.

items.name: Nox Mirrorhelm
items.description: Helmet. Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs: In the sealed room, accessible by using a Stonesword Key at the Imp Statue.

items.name: Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest
items.description: Duo Boss fight. The entrance to their chamber is initially sealed by a barrier which can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the northwest section of town. Drops Nox Flowing Sword upon defeat.

items.name: Numen's Rune - Divine Tower of Caelid
items.description: Found on the backside of the Divine Tower of Caelid. This requires some jumping and ladder puzzles.

items.name: Numen's Rune - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse at the edge of a broken section of the ring walkway in the east.

items.name: Numen's Rune - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse in the southwest end of the graveyard in the northwest of the city.

items.name: Official's Attire
items.description: From the Forbidden Lands Site of Grace, turn back and head towards the elevator. Face southwest before activating the elevator, and then watch for an opening to jump off into. The Official's Attire is on the corpse in this hidden hallway alongside Blade of Calling.

items.name: Okina Mask
items.description: Dropped by NPC Invader Bloody Finger Okina alongside his trusted katana, Rivers of Blood

items.name: Old Altus Tunnel
items.description: Optional Dungeon. An old mining site rich with crystals. The Stonedigger Troll boss can be found at the end.

items.name: Old Altus Tunnel
items.description: Site of Grace found within the Old Altus Tunnel. Found after descending the lift at the entrance.

items.name: Old Fang
items.description: Crafting Material. 2 are found on a corpse hidden within a huge clutch of Poison Pods under a fallen structure.

items.name: Old Fang
items.description: Dropped at Castle Morne by one of the Misbegotten enemies, past the caged spirit.

items.name: Old Fang - 2x Consecrated Snowfield
items.description: Crafting Material. Looted from a body in the middle of a bout between Wandering Nobles and Wolf enemies.

items.name: Old Fang - 3x Cliffbottom Catacombs
items.description: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse by the lever that opens the Boss Room Door in Cliffbottom Catacombs.

items.name: Old Fang - 3x Crumbling Farum Azula (A)
items.description: Crafting Material. 3 found on a corpse in a room where the Beastmen are roaming around.

items.name: Old Fang - 5x Caria Manor Rooftop
items.description: Crafting Material. Five can be looted from a corpse on the rooftops of the chapel of Caria Manor, above the Manor Lower Level site of grace. This area is only accessible by dropping down from the cliffs in the Three Sisters area.

items.name: Old Fang - 5x Crumbling Farum Azula (B)
items.description: Crafting Material. A set of 5 can be found on a corpse hanging off the crumbled floor of a ruined building north of the Dragon Temple.

items.name: Old Fang - 8x Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description:
x5 Found in what it looks like a small stable, outside of Fortified Manor, protected by two guards.
x3 Found on a body that's being devoured by two dogs. Near the main road.

items.name: Old Fang - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Can be acquierd at Stormveil Castle main castle grounds by defeating the Lion Guardian.

items.name: Old Knight Istvan
items.description: Assassination target for the Volcano Manor. You can invade their world using a summoning sign after accepting the assassination request.

items.name: Old Lord's Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Found in a chest inside a rotunda on the east edge of the Dragon Temple Rooftop area. This area is accessed by heading north from the Great Bridge and entering the building there. Exit onto the balcony on the right and take the ladder nearby down to the walkway leading to the rotunda. Beware as the chest is surrounded by Beastmen and, if you've killed Rykard in the Volcano Manor, you will be invaded by Recusant Bernahl on the walkway.

items.name: Olivinus Glintstone Crown
items.description: Looted from a corpse on a narrow path that leads back to the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy. You need to pass through the illusory wall and jump over the balcony on the left, and circle back to the said site of grace. To find the illusory wall, go to the hallway from the schoolhouse classroom site, turn left. The illusory wall is in front of the corpse inside the room.

items.name: Omen Cleaver
items.description: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the Omen enemy in the northwest section of the courtyard. It is advised to take out all of the lesser enemies nearby before taking on the ogre.

items.name: Omen Set
items.description: Drops from Dung Eater if defeated in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

items.name: Omenkiller (Perfumer's Grotto)
items.description: An Omenkiller encountered in a Duo Boss Fight with Miranda the Blighted Bloom inside the Perfumer's Grotto. Defeating them both awards the Great Omenkiller Cleaver.

items.name: Omenkiller (Village of the Albinaurics)
items.description: Field Boss.Found at the Village of the Albinaurics. Drops Crucible Knot Talisman

items.name: Omenkiller Rollo
items.description: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Fell Twins bosses.

items.name: Omenkiller Set (No Helm)
items.description: The Omenkiller Robe, Long Gloves and Boots drops from Omenkiller after defeating in Perfumer's Ruins.

items.name: Omensmirk Mask
items.description: Dropped an Omensmirk wielding double swords and wearing this mask outside of the Lower Capital Church Site of Grace.

items.name: One-Eyed Shield
items.description: Shield. Dropped by mini-boss NPC Chief Guardian Arghanthy inside Guardian's Garrison.

items.name: Onyx Lord
items.description: Enemy. Found in the Sealed Tunnel blocking the path to the Divine Tower of West Altus.

items.name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
items.description: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the Onyx Lord when defeated.

items.name: Opaline Bubbletear
items.description: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar boss upon defeat.

items.name: Opaline Hardtear
items.description: Dropped by Putrid Avatar at the Minor Erdtree in Dragonbarrow.

items.name: Oracle Envoy Ashes
items.description: Miquella's Haligtree near Haligtree Town site of grace

items.name: Ordina, Liturgical Town
items.description: It's easy to find once you gain access to Consecrated Snowfield. Loot is only found by interacting with the Evergaol.

items.name: Ordovis's Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword. Obtained by defeating Crucible Knight Ordovis and his regular Crucible Knight companion in their Duo Boss Fight inside the Auriza Hero's Grave.

items.name: Oridys's Rise
items.description: Lookout Tower. Initially sealed by a barrier. Inspecting the statue at the entrance, you are asked to "seek three wise beasts". These can be found as Ghostly Tortoises that you need to attack. The first is just a few steps directly to the north, opposite the entrance. There is another one hiding in the bushes left of the steps leading up to the tower. The last one is found in a pond slightly west of the tower and is invisible until struck. Attack near the center of the pond to reveal the Tortoise. Once all three have been defeated, the tower's seal is broken.

items.name: Ornamental Straight Sword
items.description: Straight Sword. Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.

items.name: Outer Wall Battleground
items.description: Site of Grace found near the northwestern gate of the outer walls.

items.name: Outer Wall Phantom Tree
items.description: Site of Grace found next to the Phantom Tree on the outskirts of Leyndell.

items.name: Page Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ashes. Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs, in an altar right before you pull the lever to open the Boss Door.

items.name: Partisan - Limgrave
items.description: A Partisan Spear that can be dropped from a Godrick Knight in Fort Haight.

items.name: Patches (Bossfight)
items.description: Found within Murkwater Cave. After defeating him, he sets up a shop in the Cave.

items.name: Patches (First Liurnia Location)
items.description: Location of Patches if forgiven during the Bossfight.

items.name: Patches (Fourth Location)
items.description: NPC. You can then find him at the Shaded Castle before the boss and he gives you Dancer's Castanets.

items.name: Patches (Second Location)
items.description: NPC. Seen hiding behind some bushes. Following the glowing stones to the ledge will trigger a cutscene with an ambush.

items.name: Patches (Third Location)
items.description: Appears by the Volcano Manor's entrance after pledging your service to the manor.

items.name: Pearldrake Talisman +1
items.description: Upgraded Talisman. Found in an cellar near the top of the Wyndham Ruins. The entrance requires a Stonesword Key to unlock.

items.name: Pearldrake Talisman +2
items.description: Talisman. Down the steps and up the ladder from the Haligtree Town Site of Grace, there is a Rot Grease. The platform behind that has the Pearldrake Talisman.

items.name: Perfume Bottle - 2x Perfumer's Ruins
items.description: One Perfume Bottle is near the chest that holds Perfumer's Cookbook [1]. The other one is in the back section, under the Giant Poison Flower in the ruin's basement cache.

items.name: Perfume Bottle - Altus Highway Junction
items.description: Located south of the Second Church of Marika. North Altus Highway Junction, in the small camp next to the Erdtree sappling, enemies are guarding a body with the bottle.

items.name: Perfume Bottle - Leyndell, Royal Capital (A)
items.description: Found inside a chest, within the second floor on the tower next to the East Rampart.

items.name: Perfume Bottle - Leyndell, Royal Capital (B)
items.description: Found guarded by a lesser Leonine Misbegotten on the east side of the eastern pond.

items.name: Perfume Bottle - Perfumer's Grotto
items.description: Crafting Material. One bottle can be looted from a chest inside Perfumer's Grotto. In the second area after encountering the second Giant Poison Flower, turn back towards the corner to find two chests, one of which contains the bottle.

items.name: Perfume Bottle - Street of Sages Ruins
items.description: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the corner of the ruins along with the Traveler's Set.

items.name: Perfume Bottle - The Shaded Castle
items.description: Key Crafting Item. Found on a body hanging by the edge of the top part of the inner ramparts. You can reach this area by climbing a ladder in the eastern section of the inner courtyard and following the ramparts as it curves to the west.

items.name: Perfumer Traveler's Set
items.description: Set includes: Traveler's Hat, Perfumer's Traveling Garb, Traveler's Gloves, Traveler's Slops, can be found on a corpse in a corner in the ruins.

items.name: Perfumer Tricia
items.description: Optional Duo Boss Fight. Perfumer Tricia is found at the end of the Unsightly Catacombs and is accompanied by a Misbegotten Warrior.

items.name: Perfumer Tricia Ashes
items.description: Dropped from Perfumer Tricia at the Unsightly Catacombs

items.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [1]
items.description: Located at a chest west of the table with the candles on it.

items.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [2]
items.description: Found on a corpse sitting on a chair on the roof of the northwestern building. You can reach this area by climbing a series of ladders in the Castellan's Hall building.

items.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [3]
items.description: Auriza Side Tomb, open the transporter chest in the room with many benches. The room you'll be teleported to will have a corpse with Perfumer's Cookbook [3] on it.

items.name: Perfumer's Grotto
items.description: A cave found below the Great Bridge to the Capital Outskirts. Its entrance is found below the northern side of the bridge.

items.name: Perfumer's Ruins
items.description: A set of ruins found in Altus Plateau, far to the west and below Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Perfumer's Talisman
items.description: In a chest underground below stairs in the room with the yellow Giant Poison Flower.

items.name: Pickled Turtle Neck - 1x Castle Morne
items.description: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse in a small room with a caged ghost. Beware of the Skeletal Slime that drops from the ceiling when you collect this.

items.name: Pickled Turtle Neck - 3x Earthbore Cave
items.description: Found in the chest just inside Earthbore Cave

items.name: Pickled Turtle Neck - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse in a dark building in the northeast, guarded by 3 Crystalians. This room is in the bottom level of the area.

items.name: Pidia's Bell Bearing
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by Pidia, Carian Servant in Caria Manor upon death.

items.name: Pidia, Carian Servant
items.description: Pidia is a Merchant. Can be found by falling down from the cliff at Three Sisters.

items.name: Pike
items.description: Can be looted off a corpse that's lying on the heavily guarded courtyard. The nearest checkpoint is the Liftside Chamber site of grace

items.name: Pillory Shield
items.description: Small Shield. Found inside Gaol Cave.

items.name: Poison Armament
items.description: Incantation. Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab roaming around the northeast section of Aeonia Swamp. Figure out its pattern via the footprints and wait for the prints to approach and then attack.

items.name: Poison Grease - 1x Altus Plateau
items.description: Consumable. Looted from a body on the village near the Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau

items.name: Poison Grease - 1x Shaded Castle Outskirts
items.description: Consumable. Can be scavenged from a corpse lying in the poison pool outside the Shaded Castle.

items.name: Poison Grease - 2x Sellia, Town of Sorcery
items.description: Weapon Coating. 2x found on a corpse under a dead tree in the eastern section of town.

items.name: Poison Grease - 2x Stillwater Cave
items.description: Consumable Item. Two can be looted from a corpse found just before the boss room fog in Stillwater Cave.

items.name: Poison Grease - 2x Volcano Cave Entrance
items.description: Consumable/ Looted from a corpse outside Volcano Cave

items.name: Poison Mist
items.description: Incantation. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the forested area.

items.name: Poisonbloom
items.description: Can be found x8 Poisonblom around the poison swampland.

items.name: Poisonbloom
items.description: Can be found on a dead body in the waters.

items.name: Poisonbloom - 4x Southwest Caelid
items.description: Crafting Material. 4x found on a corpse sitting at the end of the cliffs.

items.name: Poisonbloom - 5x
items.description: Can be found 5 Poisonbloom at Witchbane Ruins Around the ruins.

items.name: Poisonbloom - Sellia, Town of Sorcery
items.description: Can be found at Sellia, Town of Sorcery, on the roof of a building on the lower leve. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

items.name: Poisonbloom - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Can be found at Stormveil Castle Castle's Underground Crypt, on a dead body nex to the ruins.

items.name: Poisonbone Dart
items.description: An offensive consumable that can be found on a corpse inside Tombsward Cave.

items.name: Poisonbone Dart - 10x Seethewater Cave
items.description: Ammunition Consumable. Looted from a corpse surrounded by 2 rats in Seethewater Cave

items.name: Poisonbone Dart - 5x The Shaded Castle
items.description: Offensive Throwable. 5x found on a body in the middle of the poisoned area by the eastern rampart.

items.name: Poisonbone Dart - 5x Woodfolk Ruins
items.description: Ammunition. Found on a body lying in the corner in Woodfolk Ruins on Altus Plateau

items.name: Poisonbone Dart - 8x Leyndell Royal Capital
items.description: On a small corridor, against the fence (Sewers)

items.name: Prattling Pate (Apologies)
items.description: Reusable Item. Found on a corpse in the Unsightly Catacombs, along the corridors in the room with the lever that opens the final door.

items.name: Prattling Pate (Hello)
items.description: Can be found in Stormfoot Catacombs on a corpse behind the first pillar that exudes fire.

items.name: Prattling Pate (Let's get to it)
items.description: Found within Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau. Found by the entrance of the room with the shadow enemy that, when killed, opens the final door.

items.name: Prattling Pate (My Beloved)
items.description: Pratting Pate "My beloved" can be found on Miquella's Haligtree, shortly after taking the way gate from Ordina, Liturgical Town. It is two branches down from where you are transported to.

items.name: Prattling Pate (Please Help)
items.description: Found within Impaler's Catacombs, held by a corpse in the water underneath the spikes trap.

items.name: Prattling Pate (Thank You)
items.description: Reusable Item. Obtained inside the Tombsward Catacombs. Found on a corpse at the end of the main path, past the flamethrowing pillar.

items.name: Prattling Pate (Wonderful)
items.description: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs, in the very bottom level of the large multi-leveled hall. You can drop down to this level via the gap on either side of the central stair-bridge. Check around the corridors here for several items, one of which is the Prattling Pate.

items.name: Prattling Pate (You're Beautiful)
items.description: Tool Item. Found by a door just near the Hierodas Glintstone Crown in Hermit Village.

items.name: Prayer Room
items.description: Can be easily found at the entrance of the church a few metters away after go just enter Elphael, <a href="/Brace+of+the+Haligtree">Brace of the Haligtree<a/>.

items.name: Preceptor Miriam
items.description: Found at the hall middle way up the stairs.

items.name: Preceptor's Set
items.description: Armor Set. Found on a body in Seluvis's Rise after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

items.name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
items.description: Drops from the Prelate wielding it inside Fort Laiedd

items.name: Preserving Boluses
items.description: Inside the next room, after you get down the lift. Beware of the lurking enemies.

items.name: Preserving Boluses - 1x Seethewater Cave
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse in an enclosed space in Seethewater Cave, after a poison pool

items.name: Preserving Boluses - 5x Shack of the Rotting
items.description: Consumable Item. Five can be found inside the Shack of the Rotting.

items.name: Preserving Boluses - Sellia Hideaway
items.description: Can be looted from a corpse located at the right of the entrance of the second room with huge crystal formations in Sellia Hideaway. To the left of the corpse there's also an illusory wall.

items.name: Primal Glintstone Blade
items.description: Talisman. Found in an underground area of the Stargazer's Ruins. The entrance is sealed by a barrier and there is a talking jellyfish atop the steps. Summon the Spirit Jellyfish next to her to unlock the seal.

items.name: Primeval Sorcerer Azur
items.description: Site of Grace

items.name: Primeval Sorcerer Azur
items.description: Mysterious NPC. Hands you the Comet Azur spell after interacting with them.

items.name: Prince of Death's Pustule
items.description: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the pit of the castle's crypt after defeating the Ulcerated Tree Spirit. The body can be found next to a giant face.

items.name: Prison Town Church
items.description: Site of Grace located in a church in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

items.name: Prophecy Painting
items.description: Info Item. Found by inspecting the large painting inside a building in the northwest section of the main courtyard.

items.name: Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom
items.description: Finish the sidequest given by Gowry in Caelid, then return to Millicent to receive the talisman.

items.name: Protection of the Erdtree
items.description: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab. It can be found on top of the stone ruin.

items.name: Pulley Bow
items.description: Pulley Bow can be found on a sitting corpse (at the top of a siege tower near Mt. Gelmir campsite. The tower is located to the northeast of Gelmir Hero's Grave.

items.name: Pulley Crossbow
items.description: Can be found on a body at the Craftsman's Shack

items.name: Pumpkin Helm - 1x Waypoint Ruins
items.description: Dropped when defeating Mad Pumpkin Head boss.

items.name: Pureblood Knight's Medal
items.description: Key Tool Item. Reward for advancing White-Mask Varre questline and giving him the blood-soaked Lord of Blood's Favor item. Gives player early access to Mohgwyn Dynasty underground.

items.name: Purified Ruins
items.description: A set of ruins along the lake shore of the eastern landmass.

items.name: Purified Ruins Waygate
items.description: Leads to the entrance of the Academy

items.name: Purifying Crystal Tear
items.description: It can be found at the Second Church of Marika after defeating the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger

items.name: Putrid Avatar
items.description: A Putrid Avatar is found at the bottom of the Minor Erdtree here in the Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Putrid Avatar (Dragonbarrow)
items.description: Optional boss. It guards the Minor Erdtree in Dragonbarrow, just before the bridge leading to the Bestial Sanctum.

items.name: Putrid Corpse Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ash. Dropped by the boss of Gaol Cave: Frenzied Duelist

items.name: Putrid Grave Warden Duelist
items.description: Boss of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs. Drops Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak and Great Grave Glovewort

items.name: Putrid Tree Spirit (War-Dead Catacombs)
items.description: Boss of the War-Dead Catacombs in eastern Caelid. Drops Redmane Knight Ogha Spirit Ashes and a Golden Seed

items.name: Queen's Bedchamber
items.description: Site of grace

items.name: Radagon Icon
items.description: Found inside a treasure chest on the second floor of the Debate Hall Site of Grace. From the gate entrance leading to the courtyard, make a hard right and jump over the fence. Climb up the ladder and head through the broken glass window. The treasure chest is on the east section.

items.name: Radagon's Scarseal
items.description: Dropped by Ancient Hero of Zamor

items.name: Radagon's Soreseal
items.description: Talisman. Found on a corpse by dropping down the opening on the roof and looking around the wooden walkways.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ashes found within War-Dead Catacombs Go up the stairs to the back right of the first room and go left. Past the archer at the end of the hall turn right, turning right again at the end of that hall past the greatsword knight. Jump through the window to the right near the end of this hall. Go left up the stairs and the ashes will be in a room in front of you behind a knight.

items.name: Radahn's Great Rune
items.description: Dropped by Starscourge Radahn

items.name: Radiant Gold Mask
items.description: Part of the Goldmask's Set. Found on a corpse on the collapsed bridge North-East of Writheblood Ruins. Drop down two times heading South to find the body.

items.name: Raging Wolf Set
items.description: After obtaining the second to last letter from Volcano Manor, You will be sent to assist Bernahl with an invade in a familiar location. Upon invasion completion, you will receive the full Raging Wolf set, including: Raging Wolf Greaves, Raging Wolf Gauntlets, Raging Wolf Armor and Raging Wolf Helm.

items.name: Rainbow Stone
items.description: Can be found on a dead body nerby to the campfire.

items.name: Rainbow Stone (B)
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse among some sacks and wooden objects.

items.name: Rainbow Stone - 5x Weeping Peninsula
items.description: Can be found at the foot at the cruficix.

items.name: Rainbow Stone - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Can be found on a corpse near the Lifside Chamber site of grace. You can only access if you head through the hidden passage and drop down.

items.name: Rampart Tower
items.description: Site of grace located at the Rampart Tower of the Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Rampartside Path
items.description: Site of grace found at the western side of Leyndell.

items.name: Rancorcall
items.description: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab that can be found at the underground crypt of the castle

items.name: Ranni the Witch
items.description: You can talk to Ranni at the very top of Ranni's Rise in the Three Sisters, northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Ranni the Witch (2nd Location)
items.description: �� Ranni the Witch can be found in the Cathedral of Manus Celes

items.name: Ranni's Dark Moon
items.description: Sorcery Spell. Found in a chest at the top of Chelona's Rise after unlocking the tower's seal.

items.name: Ranni's Rise
items.description: One of three towers found in the Three Sisters sub-region. Three Sisters is accessible after completing Caria Manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta.

items.name: Ranni's Rise
items.description: Site of Grace found in Ranni's Rise. Up on the first floor.

items.name: Raptor Talons
items.description: Located at Sage's Cave, in one of the chests, behind several secret walls

items.name: Raptor's Black Feathers
items.description: Inside Sage's Cave, in a chest behind an illusory wall. Alongside Skeletal Mask.

items.name: Ravine-Veiled Village
items.description: Ravine-Veiled Village Site of Grace, right below the entrance to the Miners' cave that lead to Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

items.name: Raw Meat Dumpling - 10x Village Windmill Pasture
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse in the left stables at the Village Windmill Pasture.

items.name: Raw Meat Dumpling - 5x Edgar the Revenger
items.description: Consumable Item. Five are dropped by Edgar the Revenger if deafeated in the scripted invasion at Revenger's Shack.

items.name: Raw Meat Dumpling - 5x Revenger's Shack
items.description: Consumable Item. Five can be looted from corpses within the Revenger's Shack.

items.name: Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: The second Legacy Dungeon of the game, Raya Lucaria hides multiple riches, particularly for those interested in magic.

items.name: Raya Lucaria Academy Waygate
items.description: A Teleporter Waygate located past the Iron ball trap. Transports users to the Church of Vows.

items.name: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel
items.description: Site of Grace found inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, after taking the first lift down.

items.name: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel
items.description: One of the vast networks of tunnels used prominently for the academy's crystal mining operation.

items.name: Raya Lucaria Grand Library
items.description: Site of Grace at the Main Library of the Raya Lucaria Academy

items.name: Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes
items.description: Found inside a chest at the end of the Road's End Catacombs. Hit the final wall to dispel the illusion, allowing you to move on. Beware of the many Imps in the final room.

items.name: Rear Gael Tunnel Entrance
items.description: Site of Grace found by the rear entrance to Gael Tunnel.

items.name: Recusant Bernahl
items.description:
If you've killed Rykard in the Volcano Manor, you will be invaded by Recusant Bernahl on the walkway leading to the rotunda with a chest containing the . This area is accessed by heading north from the Great Bridge and entering the building there. Exit onto the balcony on the right and take the ladder nearby down to the walkway leading to the rotunda. Berhnal drops the following items upon defeat:
  • Bernahl's Bell Bearing
  • Beast Champion Set
  • Blasphemous Claw
  • Devourer's Scepter

items.name: Recusant Finger
items.description: Multiplayer Item. Found in a locked room with the Letter from Volcano Manor after pledging your services to the Volcano Manor.

items.name: Recusant Henricus
items.description: Hostile invader equipping a mace and wearing full body armor.

items.name: Red Branch Shortbow
items.description: Drops from an Assassin on the study, past the Trumpeteer

items.name: Red Letter
items.description: Quest Item. A letter outlining your final mission after pledging your services to the Volcano Manor. Found in a room unlocked using the Drawing-Room Key.

items.name: Red Wolf of Radagon
items.description: Sub-boss of the area. A giant red wolf Great Enemy Boss found in Raya Lucaria within Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops 1x Memory Stone.

items.name: Red Wolf of the Champion
items.description: Large wolf enemy found in Gelmir Hero's Grave.

items.name: Red-Feathered Branchsword
items.description: Dropped by the Deathbird at Liurnia of the Lakes

items.name: Red-Hot Whetblade
items.description: Key Item. Found in Redmane Castle, at the bottom level of the gate house building east of the main gate.

items.name: Redmane Castle
items.description: Major Dungeon. A small castle that is heavily guarded at the castle's outskirts by Radahn Knights and Soldiers. Redmane Castle serves as the gathering point for warriors alike who are wanting to participate in the Radahn Festival.

items.name: Redmane Castle Waygate
items.description: Waygate. Within Redmane Castle. Teleports you to the waygate next to Impassable Greatbridge Site of Grace.

items.name: Redmane Knight Ogha Ashes
items.description: Dropped by the Putrid Tree Spirit in the War-Dead Catacombs located in eastern Caelid. To find the entrance of the catacombs, travel to the site of grace that appears after defeating Starcourge Radahn and proceed to head north until you have reached the upper most corner of the area, you'll be able to see the small door along the cliffside.

items.name: Redmane Painting
items.description: Key Info Item. Found as a large painting under some rubble near the center of town.

items.name: Reduvia
items.description: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus

items.name: Regalia of Eochaid
items.description: Straight Sword. Accessed by dropping down to this area after progressing through Gaol Cave

items.name: Rejuvenating Boluses
items.description: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse by jumping on a trap to access a higher area of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

items.name: Rejuvenating Boluses - 1x Seethwater Cave
items.description: Consumable. Found on the nearest corpse of a trio of corpses outside Seethewater Cave in Mt. Gelmir

items.name: Rejuvenating Boluses - 5x Sage's Cave
items.description: Consumable. Found in a chest behind a illusory wall in Sage's Cave.

items.name: Rejuvenating Boluses - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse in the center of the shallow pond infested with Lesser Wormfaces. This area can be reached by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the southern cliffs.

items.name: Remembrance of the Black Blade
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by Maliketh, the Black Blade upon defeat.

items.name: Remembrance of the Blasphemous
items.description: Remembrance Key Item. Dropped by Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy upon defeat.

items.name: Remembrance of the Dragonlord
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by Dragonlord Placidusax upon defeat.

items.name: Remembrance of the Fire Giant
items.description: Drops from Fire Giant upon defeat.

items.name: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen
items.description: Remembrance of Rennala, Queen of the Moon. Acquired as a reward for defeating the supreme sorceress. To be given to Enia to draw out the power within.

items.name: Remembrance of the Grafted
items.description: Obtained as a reward for defeating Godrick the Grafted at Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Remembrance of the Omen King
items.description: Drops from Morgot, The Omen King

items.name: Remembrance of the Rot Goddess
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by Malenia, Blade of Miquella upon defeat.

items.name: Remembrance of the Starscourge
items.description: Dropped Starscourge Radahn

items.name: Renna
items.description: Renna appears in the Church of Elleh after you get your horse from Melina. Gives the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.

items.name: Renna's Rise
items.description: One of three towers found in the Three Sisters sub-region. Three Sisters is accessible after completing Caria Manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta.

items.name: Renna's Rise Waygate
items.description: Waygate. Found at the top of Renna's Rise. Teleports you to Ainsel River Main.

items.name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
items.description: One of the demigods. She can be fought at the top of Raya Lucaria Academy.

items.name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon (NPC)
items.description: Rennala becomes a merchant in her boss room after defeating her. She provides rebirthing services, allowing you to respec your character.

items.name: Resurrection Painting
items.description: Key Info Item. Painting found inside the Artist's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Revenger's Shack
items.description: An isolated shack north of the Minor Erdtree.

items.name: Rileigh the Idle
items.description: One of the assassination targets for the Volcano Manor questline. Drops Crepus's Vial, a Rune Arc and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy upon defeat.

items.name: Rimed Crystal Bud - 2x Caria Manor
items.description: Crafting Material. Two can be looted from a corpse in the frontal gardens before accessing the higher areas of Caria Manor.

items.name: Rimed Crystal Bud - 2x Caria Manor Garden
items.description: Crafting Material. Two can be looted from a corpse near two Giant Hands and several small ones in Caria Manor.

items.name: Rimed Crystal Bud - 3x Caria Manor
items.description: Crafting Material. Three Rimed Crystal Buds can be found within the garden of the Caria Manor

items.name: Rimed Crystal Bud - 3x Caria Manor Upper Gardens
items.description: Crafting Material. Three can be looted from a corpse on the gardens in upper Caria Manor.

items.name: Rimed Crystal Bud - 3x in Temple Quarter
items.description: Crafting Material. 3 are found as a treasure within a circle of white flowers in Temple Quarter. They are protected by Albinaurics and entering the circle triggers an ambush.

items.name: Rimed Crystal Bud - 5x Caria Manor Entrance
items.description: Crafting Material. Five can be looted from a corpse where a Giant Hand waits in ambush near the entrance.

items.name: Rimed Crystal Bud - 5x Caria Manor Upper
items.description: Crafting Material. Five can be looted off a corpse on the final staircase leading to the boss of Caria Manor.

items.name: Rimed Crystal Bud - 8x Caria Manor Ramparts
items.description: Crafting Material. Eight can be looted from a corpse on a wooden platform on Caria Manor's Outer Walls. Reach this area by jumping down from the overhead walkway used to access the lift toward Manor Upper Level.

items.name: Ringed Finger
items.description: Hammer found inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave. From the first Chariot hallway, head all the way down and turn left at the end of the path to find a room with a chest containing the weapon.

items.name: Ringleader's Evergaol
items.description: Evergaol located at the west of Liurnia of the Lakes. You can fight Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader

items.name: Ritual Pot - 2x Jarburg
items.description:
Crafting Pot. Two can be found in the village of Jarburg:
  1. The first is found on a corpse on the roof of a hut in the north, use the cliffs to get on top of the hut and loot the corpse.
  2. The second can be found on top of a large decorative jar in the south. Use the boulders nearby or your horse to get on top of the jar.

items.name: Ritual Pot - Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
items.description:
Crafting Pot. One found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs:
  • Head left from the Boss Doors and descend the dungeon's second lift. Continue along the path and then turn right in the room with the statue. Proceed through the hall with the guillotine traps and then take the first left in the next corridor to a room with several Land Squirts. Keep moving forward until you reach a small room at the end of the path with a large Living Jar. There is a corpse by the back wall holding the Ritual Pot.

items.name: Ritual Pot - Laskyar Ruins
items.description: Special Tool Key Item. Found on a corpse in the northern section of the Laskyar Ruins, in front of a set of pillars.

items.name: Ritual Pot - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Special Tool Key Item. Found inside a treasure chest, at the end of the hallway that is guarded by sorcerers and a giant Living Jar. The nearest site of grace is the Schoolhouse Classroom in Raya Lucaria Academy.

items.name: Ritual Shield Talisman
items.description: From the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, follow the marble stairway heading South-Southwest, past a Valiant Gargoyle near a Golden Seed and up the stair toward a giant Colloseum, the talisman is at the top of the hill, in front of the door of the Colloseum.

items.name: Ritual Sword Talisman
items.description: Located in Lux Ruins, in a chest after defeating Demi-Human Queen Gilika

items.name: Rivers of Blood
items.description: Katana dropped by NPC invader Bloody Finger Okina. Spawns near the Church of Repose in the later areas of the game.

items.name: Road of Iniquity
items.description: Site of Grace.

items.name: Road to the Manor
items.description: Site of Grace found along the main road towards Caria Manor.

items.name: Road's End Catacombs
items.description: A tomb found at the end of a narrow path below the western edge of the plateau that the Minor Erdtree is sitting on.

items.name: Road's End Catacombs (Site of Grace)
items.description: Site of grace located just inside the Road's End Catacombs.

items.name: Roar Medallion
items.description: Dropped by Stonedigger Troll. Located in Limgrave Tunnels.

items.name: Rock Blaster
items.description: Glintstone Sorcery. Found inside the Sellia Crystal Tunnel, in a chest inside a shed at the top level of the main cavern.

items.name: Rock Sling
items.description: Gravity Sorcery. Found inside a chest in a cellar in the northern section of the Street of Sages Ruins.

items.name: Roderika
items.description: In Stormhill Shack there's a Woman with a Red Hood. She is Roderika and has a quest for the player that unlocks Spirit Ash upgrades

items.name: Roiling Magma
items.description: Sorcery. Found on a corpse inside the Hermit's Shack.

items.name: Rold Medallion
items.description: Given by Melina at the Site of Grace once you defeat Morgott, The Omen King.

items.name: Ronin's Set
items.description: Dropped by Shabriri.

items.name: Root Resin
items.description: Consumable item. 4x Found on a corpse on the first trap room.

items.name: Root Resin - 5x Cliffbottom Catacombs
items.description: Crafting Material. Five can be looted from a corpse in the first chamber after descending the lift into Cliffbottom Catacombs.

items.name: Root Resin - 5x Gelmir Hero's Grave
items.description: Material. Looted from a corpse buried under some jars, atop a ladder in Gelmir Hero's Grave

items.name: Root Resin - Road's End Catacomb
items.description: Can be found by breaking a hidden wall next to the stairs, inside Road's End Catacomb

items.name: Rose Church
items.description: An abandoned church overgrown with bloodroses and rot.

items.name: Rosus' Axe
items.description: An Axe found in the room sealed by the Imp Statue in the Black Knife Catacombs.

items.name: Rot Grease - 3x The Shaded Castle
items.description: Weapon Coating. Found on a body in the middle of the raised garden-like area in the main keep.

items.name: Rotten Battle Hammer
items.description: Warhammer. Guaranteed drop from the Rotten Duelist enemy in the area

items.name: Rotten Crystal Sword
items.description: Straight Sword. Found in a chest guarded by 3 Crystalians. From the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, head down the steps and jump over the rubble on the left. You can engage the Crystalians one by one by luring them to the hallway.

items.name: Rotten Duelist Greaves
items.description: Leggings dropped by the large rotten duelist enemy guarding the rear of Ordina, Liturgical Town.

items.name: Rotten Duelist Helm
items.description: Guaranteed Drop from the Rotten Duelist enemy in the area

items.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak
items.description: Dropped by the Boss of Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs in Consecrated Snowfield, Putrid Grave Warden Duelist.

items.name: Rotten Greataxe
items.description: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by the duelist enemy guarding the rear of Ordina, Liturgical Town

items.name: Rotten Staff
items.description: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar patrolling the ring walkway in the east.

items.name: Rotten Stray Ashes
items.description: Found on a body within a broken building, there is a Rotten Stray nearby.

items.name: Rotten Winged Sword Insignia
items.description: Earned after choosing to assist Millicent and successfully defeat her sisters.

items.name: Rotview Balcony
items.description: Site of Grace on a cliffside overlooking Caelid.

items.name: Roundtable Knight Vyke
items.description: Optional Boss. Located in Contender's Evergaol. Drops Fingerprint SetVyke's Dragonbolt upon defeat.

items.name: Royal Grave Evergaol
items.description: Evergaol found east of Caria Manor. The Alabaster Lord is imprisoned within.

items.name: Royal Greatsword
items.description: Obtainable at the end of Ranni's questline; Blaidd will spawn in front of Ranni's Rise tower. Best him in combat for a final time to obtain this weapon along with his armor set.

items.name: Royal House Scroll
items.description: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Keep going to a structure to see a man standing watching over the big structure, alongside a dead body. In that body, you will find the Royal House Scroll.

items.name: Royal Knight Loretta
items.description: Great Enemy. The guardian of Caria Manor. Drops Loretta's Greatbow and Ash of War: Loretta's Slash upon defeat.

items.name: Royal Moongazing Grounds
items.description: Site of Grace found after defeating Royal Knight Loretta.

items.name: Royal Revenant
items.description: Optional Boss found in an underground area of the Kingsrealm Ruins. The stairs leading down to the location is hidden by an illusory floor in the northeast section of the ruins. You need to step on the floor to dispel the illusion.

items.name: Ruin-Strewn Precipice
items.description: A large precipice over Ravine-Veiled Village with Miners' caves all the way to the top.

items.name: Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook
items.description: Site of Grace located on top of Ruin-Strewn Precipice, right before Magma Wyrm Makar Bossfight.

items.name: Ruined Labyrinth
items.description: Site of Grace found amongst the ruins and broken statues in the area of unmarked "Uld Palace Ruins"

items.name: Ruins Greatsword
items.description: Acquired by defeating the Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo bosses at Redmane Castle

items.name: Ruler's Set
items.description: Found on a corpse laying face-down on a carriage northeast of the Abandoned Coffin Site of Grace. You'll find it alongside the Ruler's Mask.

items.name: Rune Arc
items.description: Dropped by Old Knight Istvan after successfully invading his world.

items.name: Rune Arc
items.description: Dropped by Rileigh the Idle after successfully invading his world.

items.name: Rune Arc
items.description: Dropped by Great Horned Tragoth after successfully invading his world.

items.name: Rune Arc
items.description: Consumable. Looted from a chest near the enemy caravan traveling Dragonbarrow's Road.

items.name: Rune Arc  - Caelid Swamp
items.description: Located on the island in the Caelid Swamp

items.name: Rune Arc - 1x Black Knife Catacombs
items.description: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the lowest area of the catacombs, where two giant crabs spawn.

items.name: Rune Arc - 1x Castle Morne
items.description: Can be looted off a defeated Giant Rat.

items.name: Rune Arc - 1x Cliffbottom Catacombs
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse on a dead-end chamber within Cliffbottom Catacombs, near the Stone Sword Key Imp gate.

items.name: Rune Arc - Academy Crystal Cave
items.description: Found inside the Academy Crystal Cave. Enter the room protected by a Great Sage, open the chest to find the Rune Arc.

items.name: Rune Arc - Albinauric Rise
items.description: Consumable. In a chest located next to Albinauric Rise on a cliff. You can drop down or reach this area from the tower itself.

items.name: Rune Arc - Altus Tunnel
items.description: Consumable Item. Found inside the Altus Tunnel. In the first cavern past the Site of Grace, head through the door on the right to find the item in a chest.

items.name: Rune Arc - Caelid Minor Erdtree
items.description: Can be found on one of the roots of the erdtrees. You can reach it by dropping down from the roots above.

items.name: Rune Arc - Caria Manor
items.description: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the upper walkways of the garden. This is accessible from the chapel in the west.

items.name: Rune Arc - Castle Sol
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse by a campfire atop the building in the south of the courtyard. This area is accessed by climbing a ladder behind the church in the southeast and following the path along the outer walls. Rune Arcs are also frequently dropped by Rat enemies in the castle.

items.name: Rune Arc - Crumbling Farum Azula (A)
items.description: Consumable. Found on the northeastern edge of the Dragon Temple, at the bottom level. To reach this, turn around from the Dragon Temple site of grace and face west. Drop down by using the crumbled ledges below and then head north to find the corpse holding the item by one of the crumbled pillars.

items.name: Rune Arc - Crumbling Farum Azula (B)
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse near a Phantom Tree by some pillars south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

items.name: Rune Arc - Dominula, Windmill Village
items.description: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse inside a small shack in Dominula, Windmill Village.

items.name: Rune Arc - Fort Gael
items.description: Consumable. Looted off a corpse next to the locked gate of Fort Gael.

items.name: Rune Arc - Gaol Cave
items.description: Consumable. Found in a chest inside the Gaol Cave, next to the Site of Grace.

items.name: Rune Arc - Liurnia West Encampment
items.description: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse inside a large enemy outpost.

items.name: Rune Arc - Road's End Catacombs
items.description: Consumable. In the room with the boss' door lever, drop down one level and hit the wall under the arch in the back, closest to the stairs to reveal a hidden corridor. The Rune Arc is found on a corpse on the right.

items.name: Rune Arc - Sealed Tunnel
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse in the Sealed Tunnel, at the bottom section of the chamber with the Iron Virgin.

items.name: Rune Arc - Sellia Crystal Tunnel
items.description: Consumable. Found inside Sellia Crystal Tunnel. Head up the slope in the main cavern all the way to the top and then look for a corpse hanging off the edge of a wooden walkway on the left.

items.name: Rune Arc - Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank
items.description: Consumable. Found on a body on a chair on the southern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia.

items.name: Rune Arc - Southern Liurnia of the Lakes
items.description: Can be found on some scaffolind behind the Slumbering Wolf's Shack

items.name: Rune Arc - Spiritcaller Cave
items.description: Consumable Item. Found inside the Spiritcaller's Cave, in a small cavern with three corpses.

items.name: Rune Arc - Village of the Albinaurics
items.description: After fighting Omenkiller, turn to the right and you will find it at the end of the path, on a body.

items.name: Rune Arc E
items.description: On a body, found near the gravestones leading down the cliff

items.name: Rune Arc M
items.description: Climb the "wing" of the dragon and once you are on top, jump to the room below. you will find one there.

items.name: Rune Arc N
items.description: Found inside the Fortified Manor, in the room with the big table in the middle.

items.name: Runebear
items.description: Optional Miniboss. Found in the lower level of Earthbore Cave after leaping down into a hole near the end. Drops the Spelldrake Talismanupon defeat.

items.name: Ruptured Crystal Tear
items.description: Dropped by Erdtree Avatar.

items.name: Ruptured Crystal Tear
items.description: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar under the Minor Erdtree in Consecrated Snowfield

items.name: Rusted Anchor
items.description: Greataxe dropped by Scaly Misbegotten located in Morne Tunnel.

items.name: Rusty Key
items.description: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the room with the Banished Knight.

items.name: Rya (End of Questline Location)
items.description: NPC.��Her finally location Volcano Manor at the end of her Questline.

items.name: Rya (First Location)
items.description: Npc. She can be found next to the telescope. She is runnng an errand for the Volcano Manor but was robbed. She asks you to retrieve Rya's Necklace

items.name: Rya (Second Location A)
items.description: Rya spawns here if the player completed the interaction with her in Liurnia of the Lakes but has not obtained both portions of the Dectus Medallion. She will teleport you to the Volcano Manor if you talk to her.

items.name: Rya (Second Location B)
items.description: Rya spawns at the top of the Grand Lift of Dectus if it is taken from the bottom, if the player completed the interaction with her in Liurnia of the Lakes. She will teleport you to the Volcano Manor if you talk to her.

items.name: Rya (Second Location)
items.description: The scout of Volcano Manor.

items.name: Rykard's Great Rune
items.description: Great Rune Key Item. Dropped by Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy upon defeat.

items.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
items.description: Demi God opponent found in Volcano Manor. Initially encountered in his first phase as the God-Devouring Serpent. Drops Rykard's Great Rune and Remembrance of the Blasphemous upon defeat.

items.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
items.description: Site of Grace that spawns after Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy's defeat.

items.name: Sacramental Bud
items.description: Can be found next to the Raven enemy.

items.name: Sacramental Bud (A)
items.description: A Sacramental Bud can be found at the edge of the cliffs, red buds on a small white tree.

items.name: Sacramental Bud (B)
items.description: 2 small white plants with red Sacramental Buds can be found on a cliff in Mt. Gelmir. On the edge of the cliffside down the ladder from the Nomadic Merchant Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Sacramental Bud (D)
items.description: Many sacramental buds can be found within the Church of the Plague

items.name: Sacramental Bud - 2x Hermit Village
items.description: Material. Can be looted from a demi human's corpse at the entrance of the Hermit Village in Mt. Gelmir

items.name: Sacramental Bud - 3x Haligtree Canopy
items.description: Material. Found near the Haligtree Canopy Site of Grace, guarded by an Oracle Envoy

items.name: Sacramental Bud - 4x Fort Laiedd
items.description: Material. Can be gathered on the cliffs behind Fort Laeidd in Mt. Gelmir

items.name: Sacramental Bud - 4x Hermit Village (A)
items.description: Material. Can be gathered near the cliffs behind to the right of the Hermit Village at Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Sacramental Bud - 4x Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir)
items.description: Can be gathered north of Mt. Gelmir, Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir) surrounded by bow wielding Marionette Soldiers

items.name: Sacramental Bud - 4x Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Material. Can be gathered in east Mt. Gelmir, sprouting from small mounds of corpses

items.name: Sacramental Bud - Mt. Gelmir North
items.description: Material. Can be gathered in Mt. Gelmir, guarded by two foot soldiers

items.name: Sacramental Bud - Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank
items.description: Crafting Material. Found on a body sat on a chair in the southern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia.

items.name: Sacred Scorpion Charm
items.description: Talisman. Dropped by invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when defeated.

items.name: Sacred Tear (Bellum Church)
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found Inside Bellum Church, below the big statue.

items.name: Sacred Tear (Callu Baptismal Church)
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found on the ground in front of the altar at the Callu Baptismal Church.

items.name: Sacred Tear (Church of Inhibition)
items.description: Found within the Church of Inhibition

items.name: Sacred Tear (Church of Irith)
items.description: Found inside the Church of Irith

items.name: Sacred Tear (Church of Pilgrimage)
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found on the ground in front of the altar at the Church of Pilgrimage.

items.name: Sacred Tear (Church of Ripose)
items.description: Flask upgrade, found inside the Church of Ripose, below the main statue.

items.name: Sacred Tear (Church of the Plague)
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found on the ground in front of the altar at the Church of the Plague.

items.name: Sacred Tear (First Church of Marika)
items.description: A flask upgrade found within the First Church of Marika

items.name: Sacred Tear (Fourth Church of Marika)
items.description: Flask Upgrade Material. Found on the ground in front of the altar at the Fourth Church of Marika.

items.name: Sacred Tear (Second Church of Marika)
items.description: Found inside the Second Church of Marika

items.name: Sacred Tear (Stormcaller Church)
items.description: Found inside Stormcaller Church

items.name: Sacred Tear (Third Church of Marika)
items.description: Allows the user to upgrade the Crimson and Cerulean Flask Potency. Located on the ground in front of the statue in Third Church of Marika.

items.name: Sacrificial Axe
items.description: Axe. Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Weeping Peninsula)

items.name: Sacrificial Twig
items.description: Special Consumable Talisman. Found on a corpse on a stone platform jutting out of the cliff to the east. Accessible from above only, by heading east from Malefactor's Evergaol.

items.name: Sacrificial Twig - Altus Plateau
items.description: Can be found inside a chest at an enemy camp.

items.name: Sacrificial Twig - Mistwood Ruins
items.description: Can be found on a ledge of the cemetery that's overlooking the ruins.

items.name: Sacrificial Twig 1x - Castle Morne
items.description: Give the letter to Edgar and he'll give you x1 Sacrificial Twig.

items.name: Sage Set
items.description: Armor Set comprised of the Sage Hood, Sage Robe and Sage Trousers. Can be found in Stillwater Cave - Liurnia of the Lakes, just ahead and below the Lake Facing Cliffs. Sitting on a poison submerged corpse near the end, guarded by Giant Bats that will attack you when you take it.

items.name: Sage's Cave
items.description: Cave in Western Altus Plateau, has Black Knife Assassin loot.

items.name: Sage's Cave
items.description: Site of grace, located inside Sage's Cave

items.name: Sainted Hero's Grave
items.description: The Sainted Hero's Grave is found in Altus Plateau, west of Rampartside Path.

items.name: Sainted Hero's Grave (Site of Grace)
items.description: Site of grace inside the Sainted Hero's Grave

items.name: Saintsbridge
items.description: Site of grace, located just at the tip of the bridge

items.name: Sanctified Whetblade
items.description: Found inside the fortified manor, you have to access by jumping through the roof and entering the building.

items.name: Sanctuary Stone
items.description: You can find one on top of the destroyed bridge.

items.name: Sanctuary Stone
items.description: Can be found on the stone bridge.

items.name: Sanctuary Stone
items.description: x3 are Found on a corpse among the ruins, guarded by several weak enemies and a shielded one.

items.name: Sanctuary Stone - 1x Castle Morne
items.description: Can be found at Castle Morne, dropped when defeating a Lesser Pumpkin Head.

items.name: Sanctuary Stone - 3x
items.description: Can fe found inside the Ruins.

items.name: Sanguine Noble
items.description: Invading NPC. Drops Sanguine Set

items.name: Sanguine Noble (Writheblood Ruins)
items.description: Boss found inside Writheblood Ruins

items.name: Sanguine Set
items.description: Full Sanguine Set dropped by Sanguine Noble NPC invasion. Includes Sanguine Noble Hood, Sanguine Noble Robe and Sanguine Noble Waistcloth.

items.name: Scaled Set
items.description: Armor Set. Dropped by Old Knight Istvan after successfully invading his world.

items.name: Scaly Misbegotten
items.description: Optional Boss, found within Mourne Tunnel. Drops Rusted Anchor

items.name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
items.description: Found in Mt. Gelmir , on a corpse near a Grafted Scion across a stone pillar-bridge northwest of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace. The corpse closest to the ladder has the blade.

items.name: Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace
items.description: Site of Grace found in a room at the top section of the large rotating lift.

items.name: Scouring Black Flame
items.description: Incantation, dropped by the Godskin Apostle fought at the Windmill Village.

items.name: Scythe
items.description: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs: toward the end of the dungeon, find a staircase to go up into a room with some Imps and a trap.

items.name: Sealed Tunnel
items.description: A massive tunnel system found along the southern end of the lake near the western gate of the Capital Outskirts. A series of Illusory Walls conceal the path to the Divine Tower far to the south.

items.name: Sealed Tunnel
items.description: Site of Grace found shortly after entering the tunne.

items.name: Seaside Ruins
items.description: Site of grace located in the wilderness.

items.name: Secluded Cell
items.description: Site of Grace in the northern section of the castle. Found next to a fog gate leading to Godrick the Grafted.

items.name: Second Church of Marika
items.description: One of the Four Churches of Marika.

items.name: Seedbed Curse - East Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description: Key Item. Found after you exit the room with East Capital Rampart grace, continue south past the Oracle Envoys and into the building. Inside, head down the stairs and face west to take the elevator. After the elevator continue west into the next building. Climb up the ladder to your right and go up the stairs. On the highest floor you will find the Seedbed Curse on a corpse sitting in a chair.

items.name: Seedbed Curse - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree A
items.description: Key Item. Found on a body sitting in a chair looking down the ballistae and the Putrid Avatar within Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

items.name: Seedbed Curse - Volcano Manor
items.description: Key Item. Found on a corpse at the bottom of a room locked behind an imp statue in Volcano Manor's dungeon.

items.name: Seedbed Curse - West Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description: Found on a body on the library area.

items.name: Seethewater Cave
items.description: A cave locked behind an imp statue. Requires a Stonesword Key to unlock.

items.name: Seethewater Cave
items.description: Site of Grace right by the entrance to Seethewater Cave.

items.name: Seethewater Terminus
items.description: Site of Grace

items.name: Sellia Backstreets
items.description: Site of Grace found behind a sealed door in northern Sellia. Requires lighting the brazier in the southeast of town to unlock.

items.name: Sellia Crystal Tunnel
items.description: A crystal mining operation in Caelid, overseen by greedy and aggressive insectoids.

items.name: Sellia Crystal Tunnel
items.description: Site of Grace found inside Sellia Crystal Tunnel.

items.name: Sellia Evergaol
items.description: Evergaol found in central Caelid. The boss Battlemage Hugues drops Battlemage Hugues Ashes

items.name: Sellia Gateway
items.description: Gateway leading to Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

items.name: Sellia Hideaway
items.description: Cave in Caelid, part of Selen's Quesline

items.name: Sellia Under-Stair
items.description: Site of Grace found west of town, at the bottom of a set of stairs.

items.name: Sellia, Town of Sorcery
items.description: A once-great town renowned for its study of the sorcerous arts. Now lying in ruin, the ghosts of its former scholars still roam the streets.

items.name: Seluvis
items.description: Quest NPC. Found on the ground floor of his tower after first speaking to his spectral form at Ranni's Rise.

items.name: Seluvis (Spectral)
items.description: Quest NPC. Appears in spectral form by the entrance after speaking to Ranni for the first time.

items.name: Seluvis' Secret Room
items.description: A hidden area hidden behind a few Illusionary walls. An unresponsive Soceress Sellen may be seen here.

items.name: Seluvis's Bell Bearing
items.description: Key Item. Found on a body in Seluvis's Rise after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

items.name: Seluvis's Introduction
items.description: A scroll given by Seluvis. It is addressed to Sorceress Sellen

items.name: Seluvis's Potion
items.description: Key Quest Item. Given by Seluvis after accepting his task.

items.name: Seluvis's Rise
items.description: One of three towers found in the Three Sisters sub-region. Three Sisters is accessible after completing Caria Manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta.

items.name: Sending Gate (Bestial Sanctum)
items.description: Teleporter to the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid. See D, Hunter of the Dead for details.

items.name: Sending Gate (Redmane Castle to Wailing Dunes)
items.description: A Sending Gate found on the shores in the north of Redmane Castle. Transports you to the Wailing Dunes in the north where you can fight Starscourge Radahn. This gate can be found by taking the side exit from the chapel and descending the lift onto the shores.

items.name: Serpent Arrow - 15x Stillwater Cave
items.description: Consumable Ammunition. Fifteen can be looted from a corpse inside Stillwater Cave, in the dark room with several bats.

items.name: Serpent Bow
items.description: Found by a pool of rot within Abandoned Cave

items.name: Serpent's Amnion
items.description: Found on the altar after defeating the Godskin Noble Boss in Volcano Manor.

items.name: Serpent-God's Curved Sword
items.description: Can be found at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, after the first singing bat go up two ladders then another one on the left and walk across to where the Land Octopus are

items.name: Serpent-Hunter
items.description: Great Spear. Held by a corpse on the left as you enter the boss chamber of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. This weapon has a special interaction when fighting Rykard in both his first phase as the God-Devouring Serpent and second phase as Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

items.name: Serpentbone Blade
items.description: Katana. Rewarded by Tanith after completing the second letter quest.

items.name: Sewing Needle
items.description: Key Quest Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat. Return it to Boc the Seamster in the Coastal Cave to further his storyline.

items.name: Shabriri
items.description: Npc that looks exactly like Bloody Finger Hunter Yura. He tells you about "a righteous path to ascension"

items.name: Shabriri Grape - Purified Ruins
items.description: Can be found in a hidden cellar. The path is blocked by debris and barrels that you can roll onto or attack to destroy. Once downstairs, you can find it on your left.

items.name: Shabriri Grape - Revenger's Shack
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by Edgar the Revenger upon defeat.

items.name: Shabriri Grape - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Key Item. Found next to a ghostly NPC in the underground section of Godrick's throne room.

items.name: Shabriri's Woe
items.description: Found on a body at the edge of the Frenzied Flame Village

items.name: Shack of the Lofty
items.description: A lone shack found at the base of some cliffs in the north of the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Shack of the Rotting
items.description: A worn down shack infested with Skeletons.

items.name: Shaded Castle Ramparts
items.description: Site of Grace found on top of one part of the Castle Ramparts

items.name: Shadow Bait
items.description: Can be found on a corpse at Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, after going through the pipe room to a room with the corpse sitting at the center, next to a not very well hidden Ogre ready to strike.

items.name: Shamshir
items.description: Found inside the Highroad Cave, on a platform after the waterfall section, being feasted on by Giant Bats.

items.name: Shard of Alexander
items.description: Drops from Iron Fist Alexander after completing his questline.

items.name: Shatter Earth
items.description: Sorcery. Found on a corpse in the second-to-last level of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel. Inside an opening in the north.

items.name: Shattering Crystal
items.description: Looted off a corpse on the second floor, west side, of the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy. The only way to reach this is going through the broken glass window of the church via the rooftops

items.name: Shatthershard Arrow (Fletched) - 6x Academy Gate Town
items.description: Consumable Ammo. Six can be looted from a corpse hanging off a ledge on a balcony overseeing the main stairs leading to the Academy proper.

items.name: Shield of the Guilty
items.description: In the cellar area of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins, before the main building with the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss. You will need to jump over a wall to access the stairs leading into the cellar.

items.name: Silver Mirrorshield
items.description: Shield found in the Apostate Derelict church.

items.name: Silver Scarab
items.description: Found in a chest in Hidden Path to the Haligtree. The chest is found past an illusory wall, behind a Grave Glovewort (9) inside the first alcove that you can access by jumping down onto the invisible walkways under the staircase in the main hall.

items.name: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot
items.description: One can be found at the northern side of the broken bridge that leads to Raya Lucaria Academy

items.name: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse surrounded by Eagles.

items.name: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot (B)
items.description: Further in the cemetery, past the Golden Rune (6),

items.name: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot - 1x Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Consumable Item. Looted from a corpse guarded by dogs and undead in the second graveyard of the area, after crossing a wooden hanging bridge.

items.name: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot - 5x Sage's Cave
items.description: Consumable. Found in a chest behind a illusory wall in Sage's Cave.

items.name: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot - War-Dead Catacombs
items.description: Consumable. Found inside the War-Dead Catacombs. In the main chamber with the 4 staircases, drop down into the lower level from the left and check the southeast corner to find a corpse with the item.

items.name: Siofra River Well
items.description: A cylindrical structure that takes players underground to the southern section of the Siofra River.

items.name: Skeletal Bandit Ashes
