items.description: Spirit Ash that drops from the Tibia Mariner

items.name: Skeletal Mask
items.description: Inside Sage's Cave, in a chest behind an illusory wall. Alongside Raptor's Black Feathers.

items.name: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes

The stone can be found on a corpse on one of these wooden beams.

items.name: Smithing Stone [4] - 8x Gael Tunnel
items.description:
Upgrade Material. A total of 8 can be found inside Gael Tunnel:
  1. From the Site of Grace, head into the next chamber and down one level on the wooden walkways. Head east to find the stone by the left wall of the tunnel entrance here.
  2. Continuing on from the previous stone, head into the eastern tunnel to find a water-logged cavern with several Land Octopi. Check the corner directly to the right as you enter for the second stone.
  3. Still in the same water-logged cavern, hug the wall on the right to find the third stone.
  4. Back in the first chamber, check under the wooden platform for another stone on the eastern wall.
  5. The fifth stone is found further along the same wall as the previous one.
  6. Turn towards the west and head through the tunnel to find a ladder leading downwards. The sixth stone is found at this bottom level, to the left just before the next tunnel.
  7. In the final cavern just before the boss door, check the wall directly opposite the boss door to find the seventh stone.
  8. In the same final cavern, unlock the smaller door in the west and check the back wall to the left of that room for the final stone.

items.name: Smithing Stone [5] - 5x Sealed Tunnel
items.description:
Upgrade Material. A total of 5 can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel:
  1. In the hidden chamber past the Site of Grace, drop off the ledge into the lower section and check the alcove in the back for the first stone.
  2. In the same chamber, head west to find a chest (Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (2)). Dispel the illusory wall behind the chest to reveal a lift but ride it. Instead, drop down the ledges on the left to find the second stone.
  3. At the bottom of the lift chamber, look to the south and dispel two illusory walls to reveal a large cavern with overgrown roots. Navigate the roots to reach the tunnel in the east and drop down an opening on the right to find the third stone in the back. Beware of the exploding Abnormal Stone Clusters.
  4. In the same chamber with the exploders, look for a set of wooden stairs. The fourth stone can be found on a wall next to these stairs.
  5. Still in the same chamber, check the wall opposite the stairs. Beware the exploder hidden behind crates and barrels. Hit the wall to reveal a deep pit with roots strewn across. Drop down to the second root and check the ledge in the corner for the final stone.

items.name: Smithing Stone [5] - 6x Altus Tunnel
items.description:
Upgrade Material. A total of 6 can be found inside the Altus Tunnel:
  1. In the first cavern past the Site of Grace, head through the door on the right to find the first stone in the far wall.
  2. Back in the main path, head east into the next cavern. The second stone can be found just past the entry point, to the right.
  3. In the same cavern, check under the wooden walkway for the third stone.
  4. Still in the same cavern, check next to the overgrown root in the southeast to find the fourth stone.
  5. The fifth stone is found in the cavern with the boss door, to the left just as you enter.
  6. The final stone is also in the cavern with the boss door, next to a root on the left, closer to the boss door.

items.name: Smithing Stone [5] - 6x Old Altus Tunnel
items.description:
Upgrade Material. A total of 6 can be found in the Old Altus Tunnel:
  1. The first is found by the wall to the right of the first storage shed you encounter.
  2. In the main chamber with the wooden walkways, head to the right and climb the ladder into a smaller cavern with a storage shed. Check the cavity in the wall concealed by explosive barrels to find the second one.
  3. Back on the wooden walkways, take the path to the left of the ladder to find the third stone by the wall.
  4. The fourth one is in the bottom of the main chamber, by a wall in the east side.
  5. In the same area, check the space between the southern shed and the wall for the fifth stone.
  6. In the same area, go behind the northern shed and follow the tunnel to a small cavern to find the sixth stone.

items.name: Smithing Stone [5] - 8x Sellia Crystal Tunnel
items.description:
Upgrade Material. A total of 8 can be found inside the Sellia Crystal Tunnel:
  1. The first one is found behind the storage shed on the bottom level of the main cavern.
  2. The second stone is found on the slope next to the storage shed at the bottom of the main cavern.
  3. The third stone is found on the same slope.
  4. Continue heading up the slope all the way to the top. The fourth stone is found in the deep indent on the western wall.
  5. Jump on top of the central shed in the main cavern and then onto the wooden platform in the east to hop over the barricade blocking a tunnel. Go through the tunnel and pick up the fifth stone on the left.
  6. Continuing on from the previous stone, head up the ladder in the next room and head north to find the sixth stone in the cavity in the wall.
  7. The seventh stone is found in the same wall cavity.
  8. In the same area, climb up the ladder on the side of the shed and continue along the tunnel ahead to find a cavern with a raised wooden platform. Head up to the platform and check the left wall for the final stone.

Lure it to the east end where a statue with a glowing crack can be found. Its attacks can destroy the statue, revealing a set of 3 of the stones.

After climbing the ladder, open the door in front of you. Climb the next set of stairs, head to one of the corners of the stairs you just climbed up to find it. - Found near the Omensmirk, on the ground. - Found on the big area, past the Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit - Found on a small building past the Fortified Manor, you have to jump around to get there. - Found to the south of the West Capital Rampart site of grace, on an edge, near some poison flowers.

items.name: Smithing Stone [6] C - Redmane Castle
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside the chapel to the north of the castle.

items.name: Smithing Stone [6] C - Volcano Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting amongst some tombstone in a tiny island in the lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

items.name: Smithing Stone [6] D - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse northeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace, in front of a large rotunda building in the rooftop gardens.

items.name: Smithing Stone [6] D - Volcano Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a rooftop.

items.name: Smithing Stone [6] E - Volcano Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the lava-filled cavern of the Volcano Manor.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7]
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in front of a gazebo connecting 3 bridges in Miquella's Haligtree. This area is guarded by two sorcerers.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - 3x Castle Sol
items.description: Upgrade Material. 3x found on a corpse inside a building full of Rats. This room is accessed by climbing the ladder behind the church and following the path along the outer walls. The building has an opening on the roof that you can jump to.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - 3x First Church of Marika
items.description: Upgrade Material. Three can be obtained from a corpse sitting on a chair atop the cliffs east overlooking the First Church of Marika.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - 3x Moonlight Altar
items.description: Upgrade Material. 3 more are found in the right-most gazebo by the cliffs in this area.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - 3x Moonlight Altar
items.description: Upgrade Material. 3 are found in the left-most gazebo by the cliffs in this area.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - 3x West Consecrated Snowfield
items.description: There's a breakable statue with Smithing Stone [7] x3 and Smithing Stone [8] inside. There's a bear uphill to the east that can be used to break it

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - 5x Sellia Crystal Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. 5 stones are acquired by defeating the Fallingstar Beast at the end of the Sellia Crystal Tunnel.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside a wine cellar/storage room.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in a large room with many braziers and two Cleanrot Knights.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - Guardians' Garrison
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the upper ramparts of Guardian's Garrison. A Flame Guardian is protecting it.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
items.description: Upgrade Material. One found in the Aqueducts section of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] - Volcano Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the back of the cave in Volcano Manor where you fight the Magma Wyrm

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] A - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a sarcophagus closest to the balcony in the next room after the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] B - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse behind a fallen pillar in the northern section past a narrow path laden with dragon statues.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] C - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on an upper cliff east of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple. From the lift, head east and down the stairs past a tree. Climb up the ledges to reach the top of the cliff and collect the stone.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] D - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the second large segment of the upper crumbled section west of the Dragon Temple. To get up here, you need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] E - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse near a Phantom Tree amongst several sets of pillar structures up on a hill in the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Beware the Warhawks guarding the area.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] x2
items.description: Found on a dead body over a rock near the cliff.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7] x3 - Freezing Lake
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found at the bottom of the western side of the freezing lake, inside a statue with a glowing crack on it. Lure one of the nearby Golems to destroy the statue and collect the item.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8]
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside a building in Miquella's Haligtree. Be careful of the Misbegotten just around the corner.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8]
items.description: Found on a dead body over a rock near the cliff.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - 3x Consecrated Snowfield
items.description: Upgrade Material. Looted from a statue close to the Cave of the Forlorn. Lure a Giant Crab or Giant Land Octopus from the area to help you destroy the statue and loot its contents.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - 3x Lunar Estate Ruins
items.description: Upgrade Material. Three can be found in a chest in an underground area concealed by an illusory floor on the eastern side of the ruins. Attack the floor to reveal the path.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - 3x Moonlight Altar
items.description: Upgrade Material. 3 are found in the central gazebo by the cliffs in this area.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - 4x Consecrated Snowfield
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse laying inside a gazebo connecting 3 bridges in Miquella's Haligtree. This area is guarded by two sorcerers. -Another one can be found on the river, south to the Minor Erdtree. On a statue. Need to be broken by an enemy.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - Consecrated Snowfields Central Area
items.description: Upgrade Material. Looted from a body behind the big tree where you get the map piece.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a balcony. You can reach this corpse by going into the building on the left and heading up the stairs.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse under a tree at the bottom level in the north of the city.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in between two ballistae in the north of the city.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - Miquella's Haligtree
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found in Miquella's Haligtree, looted from a corpse after two patrolling Oracle Envoy enemies.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
items.description: Upgrade Material. One found at a dead end tunnel that slopes downwards, inside the central Aqueduct section of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the Royal Capital.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - West Consecrated Snowfield
items.description: There's a breakable statue with Smithing Stone [7] x3 and Smithing Stone [8] inside. There's a bear uphill to the east that can be used to break it

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - Yelough Anix Ruins
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse resting against a pillar in the northern section of Yelough Anix Ruins.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] - Yelough Anix Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. Multiple found in the Yelough Anix Tunnel.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] A - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting at the end of the walkway that you begin on when first visiting the region.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] B - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse along the curved bridge/platform. Before reaching it, a Farum Azula Dragon will swoop in and attack.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] C - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse under a roofed section on the left as you reach the end of the curved platform. Directly opposite the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] D - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting at the edge of the broken bridge atop the arch ruins, guarded by a Lesser Wormface. This area can be reached by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the cliffs. There is a ladder that you can climb on the back side of the arch to get on top.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] E - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the eastern edge of the shallow pond infested by Lesser Wormfaces. You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the southern cliffs.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] F - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Found on a corpse at the edge of the large stone platform behind the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. To reach this platform, head into the terrace southwest of the building and take the lift to the cliffs below. Navigate the floating debris north of the lift. Beware as a Farum Azula Dragon will swoop in and ambush you from behind as you pick up the item.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] G - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. One found on a corpse in front of a sleeping dragon, far south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] H - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse at the edge of the cliffs southeast of the fountain plaza, past a gazebo and a tree. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] I - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off a ledge in the upper crumbled segment west of the Dragon Temple. To get up here, you will first need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section. You will need to traverse the massive floating chunks of debris, heading further west. Once you get to the second large chunk, look in the northwest section of it for a series of makeshift stone bridges that will lead you to a gazebo-like structure. Head slightly north from the gazebo to find a corpse holding a Somber Smithing Stone [8] and then drop off the edge onto a small floating platform below to pick up the Smithing Stone [8].

items.name: Smithing Stone [8] J - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a floating section of the plaza with the fallen dragon statue, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace.

items.name: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1]
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by the Crystalian (Ring Blade) Boss at the bottom-most level of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.

items.name: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2]
items.description: Bell Bearing. Found in a chest in the first hidden chamber of the Sealed Tunnel. Drop down into the lower section and look to the west to find the chest.

items.name: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3]
items.description: Key Item. Found in an underground area beneath the Zamor Ruins. The entrance is in the southwest section of the ruins.

items.name: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by the Godskin Duo upon defeat.

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly
items.description: Find by looting a dead body at the base of the cliff.

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly (B)
items.description: Found at the base of a Stonegrave.

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly - 2x Mt. Gelmir
items.description: Material. Found on a body lying near the edge of the lava pool in west Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly - 4x Mt. Gelmir Northwest
items.description: Material. Looted from a corpse sitting near some rocks in Mt. Gelmir, after the Fallingstar Beast

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly - 6x Gelmir Hero's Grave
items.description: Material. Found in Gelmir Hero's Grave looted from a corpse near a ledge below a room with a Chariot passing by

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly - 6x Guardians' Garrison
items.description: Crafting Material. 6 are found on a corpse by an active fire inside Guardian's Garrison.

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly - 8x at Fire Monk Camp
items.description: Crafting Material. There are 8 Smoldering Butterflies scattered among the corpses in the Fire Monk camp.

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly - Ravine-Veiled Village
items.description: Within Ravine-Veiled Village, near Site of Grace.

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Can be found at the Stormveil Castle courtyard, there are some corpses you can loot to find x1 Magic Grease, x1 Golden Rune (1), x2 Golden Rune (2), x1 Pike1, and x5 Smoldering Butterfly.

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Can be found Stormveil Castle in the Underground Crypt area on a dead body inside the Root Monster room.

items.name: Smoldering Church
items.description: The remains of an old church glowing with red embers. Houses a Site of Grace for weary travelers.

items.name: Smoldering Church
items.description: Site of Grace located at the far side of the Smoldering Church.

items.name: Smoldering Shield
items.description: Small Shield. Found on a corpse on the sitting by some tombstones on the same level as the lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

items.name: Smoldering Wall
items.description: Site of Grace directly south of the telescope.

items.name: Snow Witch Set
items.description: Armor Set. Found in a chest on the upper floor of Renna's Rise after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

items.name: Soft Cotton
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse sitting on a chair south of the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins.

items.name: Soft Cotton - 1x Morne Tunnel
items.description: One can be looted off a corpse in Morne Tunnel.

items.name: Soft Cotton - Divine Tower Bridge
items.description: Consumable. Can be found on the broken part of the bridge leading to the Divine Tower of Limgrave, past the teleporter waygate, by dropping down.

items.name: Soft Cotton - Woodfolk Ruins
items.description: Consumable. Found against a wall, surrounded by snails.

items.name: Soldier of Godrick
items.description: Optional Boss. Found within in the Stranded Graveyard if you jump down the pit into the Tutorial Area.

items.name: Soldjars of Fortune Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Grave Warden Duelist boss at the end of the Auriza Side Tomb.

items.name: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
items.description: Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater after her third invasion, in the Consecrated Snowfield on the frozen river southwest of Ordina, Liturgical Town.

items.name: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone - 1x Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Found in a chest hidden between columns near a roof with a corpse carrying an item, after the Prayer Room site of Grace in the Haligtree.

items.name: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found in a gazebo behind the stationary Farum Azula Dragon sitting at the back of the plaza southeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. The dragon is constantly raining red lightning around the area.

items.name: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the southern end of the ring walkway in the east.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1]
items.description: As a drop when defeating a Teardrop Scarab at the top of a ruined building.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1]
items.description: Found at the edge of the sea.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1]
items.description: Found on a dead body.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1] - 3x Morne Tunnel
items.description: You can find a few in Morne Tunnel.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1] - Artist's Shack (Limgrave)
items.description: Upgrade Material. Southwest of the Artist's Shack in Limgrave. In a bug that looks like a Scarab.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1] - Church of Dragon Communion
items.description: Upgrade Material. Obtained by defeating a Teardrop Scarab in the cliffs behind the church.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1] - Limgrave Tunnels
items.description: Players can find one at the Limgrave Tunnels. Before taking the second elevator, fall down the edge on the left, and keep falling on the surfaces against the wall. There is a Golden Rune (1) on a platform with a dead body, the next one has a Somber Smithing Stone [1].

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1] - Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. One can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1] - Stormveil Castle
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the Lion Guardian east of the castle courtyard.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1] A
items.description: Located on the field, on a dead body sitting on a chair.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2]
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse, fallen with its chair at the beach. Guarded by 4 Spirit Jellyfish.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2]
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab near the edge of the cliffs.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2] - 1x Blaidd Quest Reward
items.description: Upgrade Material. Obtained as a reward for completing Forlorn Hound Evergaol with Blaidd, then talking to him outside the Jail.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2] - 2x Eastern Liurnia of the Lakes Cliffs
items.description: Upgrade Material. Two can be found on a corpse sitting on a chair by the cliffs to the southeast of Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2] - 3x Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2] - Academy Gate Town
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the northern ruins of Academy Gate Town.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2] - Gael Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. One can be found inside Gael Tunnel. From the entrance, go to the left of the wooden platform and drop down on to the ledge below. Drop down onto the second ledge ahead and enter the small tunnel to find the stone.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2] - Liurnia Highway North
items.description: Upgrade Material. One can be looted from a teardrop scarab that explodes upon defeat.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2] - Teardrop Scarab Liurnia
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found on a small isle on the western side of the lake. This scarab previously dropped Ash of War: Thop's Barrier.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2] - Volcano Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off of a broken banister in Volcano Manor's dungeon.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3] - 4x Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. A total of 4 can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3] - Caria Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse at the end of a narrow path along the eastern walls.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3] - Caria Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. One can be looted from a corpse on the manor outer walls, above the entrance to the grounds. This area is only reachable by dropping down from the higher level walkway, right before reaching the lift to the Manor Upper Level site of grace.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3] - Carian Study Hall
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found off the road toward Carian Study Hall. It will be just north of the Study Hall Entrance Site of Grace.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3] - Western Liurnia of the Lakes
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting on a chair overlooking the cliffs. Beware of enemies that spawn behind you.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3] A - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Looted off a corpse behind the altar of the Church of the Cuckoo in the academy.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3] B
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting on a chair by the shore.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3] B - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Looted on the monolith. It can be found past the Graveyard section where you'll see a large rotating lift. It is protected by a Monolith Guardian in Raya Lucaria Academy.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3] F
items.description: Dropped by a Teadrop Scarab found within the woods.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4]
items.description: Found on a corpse, or as a drop from the Spider Hand������near the Road of Iniquity site of grace in������Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4]
items.description: Found on a dead body sitting on a chair.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] - 1x Caelid Scarab Drop
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] - 1x Southern Caelid
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the southern edges of Caelid.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] - 3x Sellia Crystal Tunnel
items.description:
Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Sellia Crystal Tunnel:
  1. In the main chamber, head up the slope until you are able to jump on the roof of the central storage shed. Jump onto the wooden platform in the east and hop over the barricade blocking the tunnel. Go through the tunnel until you end up in a room with a ladder and wooden walkways above. The stone is found on a body on one of the walkways.
  2. Continue to the cavern in the north and climb up the ladder on the side of the shed in front of you. Check the cavity in the wall to the right of the entrance to the next tunnel for the second stone.
  3. Continue into the tunnel and check the hollow on the left in the next cavern to find the final stone.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] - East of the Minor Erdtree (Caelid)
items.description: Found by the sea past the Minor Erdtree.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] - Gael Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. One can be found inside Gael Tunnel, in the back of the water-logged cavern crawling with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus hanging from the ceiling.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] - Old Altus Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found at the bottom of the main chamber, on a corpse inside the northern storage shed.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: Looted off a corpse that can be found in a small room with some small crabs. Located at the rooftops section of Raya Lucaria Academy.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] - Ruin-Strewn Precipice
items.description: Can be found in the caves that go through the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] - Sellia Hideaway
items.description: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway, in the middle of a small tunnel leading to the top

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] - West Caelid
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a dead body sitting on a chair.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4] A
items.description: Found on a body in the swamp next to a Cleanrot Knight

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5]
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5]
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off of a ledge in Volcano Manor's dungeon. After going up the cage lift, turn right to find it.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] - 3x Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description: On a side room, you can find this on a body.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] - Altus Plateau
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab surrounded by Wormface enemies in Altus Plateau

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] - Altus Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Altus Tunnel. In the second cavern, head up the wooden platform and look along the walls on the right to find the stone.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] - Deep Siofra Well Ravine
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a body lying against the cluster of crystals in the ravine south of the Deep Siofra Well. Also accessible by heading north from the Swamp of Aeonia.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] - Gaol Cave
items.description: Upgrade Material. 1x Found as a treasure inside a chest in a cell within Gaol Cave.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] - Old Altus Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found at the bottom of the main chamber. Head behind the northern storage shed and follow the tunnel to a small cavern where you can find the stone.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] - Redmane Castle
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse by the large monument surrounded by chairs in the north of the castle.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] - Sealed Tunnel
items.description:
Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel:
  • At the bottom of the chamber with the lift, dispel two illusory walls to the south to reveal a large cavern with overgrown roots and an Iron Virgin roaming the lower section. Make your way to the lower section of this cavern and check the northwest wall to find the stone.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] - The Shaded Castle
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a body by the dead tree on the western end of the outer courtyard, next to the western rampart.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] A - Volcano Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a teardrop scarab sitting on a small rooftop.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5] B - Volcano Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab rolling on cooled lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [6]
items.description: Found on a body sat on a chair overlooking the edge, there is a wolf sat next to them.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [6] - 1x Leyndel Royal Capital
items.description: Upgrade material. Found behind a statue in a ditch within Leyndell Royal Capital.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [6] - 2x Old Altus Tunnel
items.description:
Upgrade Material. Two are found inside the Old Altus Tunnel:
  1. When entering the main chamber with the wooden walkways, head to the right and climb up the ladder to a small cavern. Check to the left of the storage shed to find the stone. You may need to crouch/roll to get into the opening.
  2. The second stone is found in the bottom level of the main chamber, behind the southern shed.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [6] - Sellia Crystal Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. One is acquired by defeating the Fallingstar Beast at the end of the Sellia Crystal Tunnel.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [6] A - Volcano Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found in an underground room filled with Basiliks next to the large lava lake

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [6] B - Volcano Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse slouched over a fountain in the Volcano Manor dungeon surrounded by Burning Slugs.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [7] - 1x near Zamor Ruins
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab sitting by a tree near Zamor Ruins.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [7] - Consecrated Snowfield
items.description: Found with a visible Teardrop Scarab atop a rock around Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [7] - Flame Peak
items.description: Upgrade Material. Drops from a Lesser Spider Hand

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [7] - Forbidden Lands
items.description:
Upgrade Material.

Found in the Forbidden Lands on a corpse inside the giant skull on the hill before the encounter with Black Blade Kindred.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [7] - Volcano Manor
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging from the balcony.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [7] A - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a chunk of floating debris, on the eastern edge of the heavily-ruined section between the Tempest-Facing Balcony and the Dragon Temple.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [7] B - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse by the cliffs underneath a section of the Great Bridge, accessible by circling around the plaza southeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8]
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse draped over the balcony of a building in Miquella's Haligtree.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] (A)- Consecrated Snowfield
items.description: Found with a visible Teardrop Scarab atop a rock formation west of the Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield).

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] - 1x Moonfolk Ruins
items.description: Upgrade Material. One found in a chest inside an underground treasure room in the northest section of the ruins. The entrance is concealed by an illusory floor. Hit the floor to reveal the stairs.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] - Castle Sol
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse siting on a ledge outside Castle Sol.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] - Church of the Eclipse Castle Sol
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found in Castle Sol next to the Church of the Eclipse Grace. Going outside the church (to the south) around the church and up the wall till you reach the church roof. You will have to platform onto the broken wall and hug the wall of the church to reach it. It will be on a corpse hanging off the edge. Killing the crossbowmen makes this easier to do.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] - Consecrated Snowfield
items.description: Upgrade Material. Defeat a Teardrop Scarab to obtain it.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] - Consecrated Snowfield
items.description: Upgrade Material. From the top of Albinauric Rise jump south onto some rocks and further up until you are on top of the rocks. It is located next to a large gravestone.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] - Dragonbarrow West
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found sitting on a fallen tree in western Dragonbarrow. Warning: This scarab explodes upon death, dealing massive damage!

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] - East of the Church of Repose
items.description: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab found at the top of a small mountain. Will vanish if it spots you or you get too close.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] - Yelough Anix Tunnel
items.description: Somber Smithing Stones [8] are found throughout the tunnel as little shinny white stones on the wall or at the end of some cavities.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] A - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off a ledge in the upper crumbled segment west of the Dragon Temple. To get up here, you will first need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section. You will need to traverse the massive floating chunks of debris, heading further west. Once you get to the second large chunk, look in the northwest section of it for a series of makeshift stone bridges that will lead you to a gazebo-like structure. Head slightly north from the gazebo to find the corpse that holds the stone, hanging off the right edge.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] B
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found in the lower valley.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8] B - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a balcony south of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. To reach this balcony, you will need to head north from the Great Bridge, through the archway and exit to the balcony on the right.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9]
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside a small building in Miquella's Haligtree.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9]
items.description: Consecrated Snowfield: Found on a corpse sitting on a chair overlooking the edge east of the Apostate Derelict.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside a room at the northern end of the ring walkway in the east. Guarded by a Crystalian.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in a dark building in the northeast guarded by 3 Crystalians. This building is in the bottom level of the area.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] - Farum Greatbridge
items.description: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found to the west of Farum Greatbridge.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] - West Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield)
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found with a invisible Teardrop Scarab atop a rock formation west of the Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield).

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] - Western Consecrated Snowfield
items.description: Can be looted on top of a rock formation in Consecrated Snowfield North of the Hidden Path to the Haligtree

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] - Yelough Anix Tunnel
items.description: Upgrade Material. On the right, in a cavity where you find the Onyx Lord.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] A
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting in a chair on the bridge south of Stargazer's Ruins.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] A - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse under a tree by the cliffside south of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the building.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] B - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found under a leaning pillar in the heavily-ruined section just before jumping towards the Dragon Temple.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] C - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found in the southwest at the bottom level of the Dragon Temple accessed by turning around to face west from the Site of Grace and then jumping down the crumbled ledges below. From here, head into the central archway and then turn right to find a crypt with several sarcophagi. Go through the archway in the west to an outdoor area where you can find a corpse holding the stone between two pillars.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9] D - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on an upper level balcony in the northern section past the Dragon Temple. From the north end of the temple, navigate your way across the floating debris to a narrow path laden with dragon statues, at the end of which you will find a spiral staircase on the right side. Head up these stairs and continue west to a balcony with a sealed Imp Statue barrier and several fallen pillars. The corpse holding the stone can be found behind one of these pillars.

items.name: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [1]
items.description: Key Item. Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast at the end of the Sellia Crystal Tunnel upon defeat.

items.name: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [2]
items.description: Bell Bearing Key Item. Obtained by defeating the Crystalian Duo Bosses inside the Altus Tunnel.

items.name: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [3]
items.description: Bell Bearing Key Item. Found on a corpse just outside the First Church of Marika.

items.name: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]
items.description: Key Item. Found on a corpse at the edge of the cliffs by the Tempest-Facing Balcony.

items.name: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5]
items.description: Key Item. Found on a corpse sitting in front of an altar right at the entrance to the building with the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace.

items.name: Soporific Grease
items.description: Consumable Item. 3 are found under a fall structure.

items.name: Soporific Grease (B)
items.description: 2 Soporific Grease can be found on one of the bodies in the destroyed camp at the bottom of the cliff here across the stone pillar.

items.name: Soporific Grease (C)
items.description: Found lying in the middle of the ground. Beware enemies nearby.

items.name: Sorcerer Painting
items.description: Key Info Item. Found inside the central building of the courtyard. This can be accessed through the roof by walking along the top of the northwest walls and finding a walkway connecting to the building.

items.name: Sorcerer Rogier (First Location)
items.description: Sorcerer Rogier Location 1. Friendly NPC who sells Ashes of War . Initially met in the Chapel in the western section of the Castle. After you defeat Godrick, he moves to the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Sorcerer's Isle
items.description: Site of Grace found on the western edge of the isle.

items.name: Sorceress Sellen (First Location)
items.description: Considered a witch and exiled member of the Raya Lucaria Academy, Sorceress Sellen sells Sorceries.

items.name: Sorceress Sellen (Fourth Location)
items.description: Summon signs to either help or betray Sorceress Sellen at the end of her quest can be found right by the entrance to the Raya Lucaria Academy Library. She will also be here to provide your reward should you choose to side with her.

items.name: Sorceress Sellen (Second Location)
items.description: Sorceress Sellen alternative location.

items.name: Sorceress Sellen (Third Location)
items.description: Found standing behind two illusory walls in a room. But she doesn't respond.

items.name: South of the Lookout Tower
items.description: Site of Grace found directly south of the Forest Lookout Tower.

items.name: South Raya Lucaria Gate
items.description: Site of grace at the entrance of the Raya Academy.

items.name: Spear Talisman
items.description: Talisman found in a chest within Lakeside Crystal Cave

items.name: Speckled Hardtear
items.description: Flask Upgrade. Dropped by Wormface upon defeat.

items.name: Spelldrake Talisman
items.description: Talisman. Acquired by defeating the Runebear boss inside Earthbore Cave.

items.name: Spelldrake Talisman +1
items.description: Upgraded Talisman. Found in a chest in a small room the northwest section of town. Right below where the Staff of Loss is obtained. This room is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

items.name: Spelldrake Talisman +2
items.description: Upgraded Talisman. Found in the secret catacombs underneath the Hidden Path to the Haligtree by turning right just before the Stray Mimic Tear's boss door, following the corridor and taking the lift up. The talisman is found on a corpse in an alcove at the top.

items.name: Spellproof Dried Liver - 1x Black Knife Catacombs
items.description: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse in the room with the saw traps.-11

items.name: Spellproof Dried Liver - Caria Manor
items.description: Consumable Item. Can be found on the balcony located near Pida. Only accessible after defeating Royal Knight Loretta

items.name: Spellproof Dried Liver - Raya Lucaria Academy
items.description: One can be found in Liurnia of the Lakes area at the foot of a large tombstone.

items.name: Spiked Cracked Tear
items.description: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Found on an altar next to the Minor Erdtree in Mistwood.

items.name: Spiked Palisade Shield
items.description: On dead body under a Golem, west of Deep Siofra Well, Caelid

items.name: Spiked Spear
items.description: Chance for it to drop from a Marionette Soldier enemy just outside of Witchbane Ruins.

items.name: Spiralhorn Shield
items.description: Found a corpse near Mausoleum Compound. NW of Ruined Labyrinth Site of grace.

items.name: Spirit Calling Bell
items.description: Key Item. Given by Renna. Return to the church after getting your horse to find her sitting by the ruins.

items.name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
items.description: Obtained from Roderika form Stormhill Shack while pursuing her questline.

items.name: Spirit-Caller Snail
items.description: Optional Boss. Found at the end of the Road's End Catacombs. Drops the Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes upon defeat.

items.name: Spiritcaller Cave
items.description: Cave found on the western bank of the frozen lake. Requires two Stonesword Keys to unlock the barrier. Spirit Snails and a double boss await within.

items.name: Spiritcaller Cave
items.description: Site of Grace found within the Spiritcaller's Cave, near the entrance.

items.name: Spiritflame Arrow - 15x Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Ammunition. 15x found on a corpse sitting on a chair inside a building in the northeast. This building can be reached by following the eastern walkway all the way to the northeast and walking along a concrete beam connecting to the building.

items.name: Spiritspring: Behind Fringefolk Hero's Grave
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave, on the lower beaches behind Fringefolk Hero's Grave.

items.name: Spiritspring: Behind Mirage Rise
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Altus Plateau, behind Mirage Rise towards the cliffs.

items.name: Spiritspring: Bridge of Iniquity South
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Altus Plateau, Below the Bridge of Iniquity towards the south.

items.name: Spiritspring: Bridge of Sacrifice
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave, just north of the Bridge of Sacrifice. Follow the part north to reach this Spiritjump spot.

items.name: Spiritspring: Capital Outskirts West
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in the Capital Outskirts, northwest of the capital, below the main bridge at the moat surrounding the capital.

items.name: Spiritspring: Capital Rampart Cliffisde
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in the Capital Outskirts, eastern side of the Capital towards the cliffs where the Capital Rampart Site of Grace is.

items.name: Spiritspring: Castle Morne Rampart
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in the Weeping Peninsula, just east of the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

items.name: Spiritspring: Church of Repose
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in the Mountaintops of the Giants, behind the Church of Repose towards the south.

items.name: Spiritspring: Clifftop Altus Plateau
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Altus Plateau, Clifftops. Above the Mirage Rise towards the northwest.

items.name: Spiritspring: Consecrated Snowfield Waterfall
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in the Mountaintops of the Giants, south of the Shack of the Lofty by the waterfall.

items.name: Spiritspring: Demi-human Forest Ruins
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in the Weeping Peninsula, south Demi-human Forest Ruins.

items.name: Spiritspring: East Raya Lucaria Gate
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Liurnia, down the cliffs next to East Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace. Across the Bridge from main gate of Raya Lucaria Academy.

items.name: Spiritspring: East Summonwater Village Lower Cliff
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave, on the lower cliff east of Summonwater Village.

items.name: Spiritspring: East Summonwater Village Mid Cliff
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave, on the middle cliff east of Summonwater Village.

items.name: Spiritspring: East Summonwater Village Upper Cliff
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave, on the upper cliff east of Summonwater Village.

items.name: Spiritspring: Forlorn Hound Evergaol
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave, south Forlorn Hound Evergaol toward the cliffside by the water.

items.name: Spiritspring: Frenzy-Flaming Tower
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Liurnia, down the cliffs directly north of the Frenzy-Flaming Tower.

items.name: Spiritspring: Gate Town Bridge
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Liurnia, next to the Gate Town Bridge Site of Grace.

items.name: Spiritspring: Lenne's Rise
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Dragonbarrow, immediately south of a Lenni's Rise.

items.name: Spiritspring: Liurnia Highway Lookout Tower Cliff
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Liurnia, at the Liurnia Highway Lookout Tower Cliffside.

items.name: Spiritspring: Liurnia Highway South
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Liurnia, next to Liurnia Highway South

items.name: Spiritspring: Lord Contender's Evergaol
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in the Mountaintops of the Giants, at the cliffside directly east of Lord Contender's Evergaol.

items.name: Spiritspring: Minor Erdtree (Dragonbarrow)
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Dragonbarrow, immediately southwest of Minor Erdtree (Dragonbarrow).

items.name: Spiritspring: Minor Erdtree Weeping Peninsula
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in the Weeping Peninsula, east of the Minor Erdtree.

items.name: Spiritspring: Murkwater Coast
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave, next to the Murkwater Coast Site of Grace.

items.name: Spiritspring: Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Mt. Gelmir, Immediately west of Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace

items.name: Spiritspring: Perfumer's Grotto Entrace
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Altus Plateau, Perfumer's Grotto Entrance.

items.name: Spiritspring: Ringleader's Evergaol
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Liurnia, directly Southeast Ringleader's Evergaol.

items.name: Spiritspring: Road of Iniquity
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Altus Plateau, at the drop off south of the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace where the collapsed bridge is.

items.name: Spiritspring: Saintsbridge
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave. At the bridge, close to the Saintsbridge Site of Grace.

items.name: Spiritspring: Seaside Ruins
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave, just south of the Seaside Ruins Site of Grace. Can be used to jump down to the shore safely to get the Ash of War: Gravitas and Haligdrake Talisman.

items.name: Spiritspring: Sellia Streets
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Caelid, at the fork in the road between the Sellia Backstreets Site of Grace, Church of the Plague and Sellia Hideaway.

items.name: Spiritspring: South Liurnia Lake Shore
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Liurnia, next to Liurnia Highway South

items.name: Spiritspring: Waypoint Ruins Cliffside
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave, Waypoint Ruins east Cliffside.

items.name: Spiritspring: West Murkwater Catacombs
items.description: Spiritspring Jump for Torrent. Found in Limgrave, Stormhill. Murkwater Catacombs Cliffside, west of the Catacomb entrance.

items.name: Spread Out (Gesture)
items.description: Gesture. Unlocked by befriending Blackguard Boggart by purchasing a Boiled Prawn from his shop in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: St Trina's Torch
items.description: Special Torch. Looted from the treasure chest in the caravan wagon carted in the southern portion of Consecrated Ground in the northern lands.

items.name: Staff of Loss
items.description: Glintstone Staff. Found on a corpse leaning over a building's balcony. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

items.name: Stalwart Horn Charm
items.description: Can be found in Eastern Liurnia. Fast travel to Mausoleum Compound, head up the light incline to the left towards the cliff to the West. When you are at the cliff, look South for a hole in the wall. The talisman can be found on a corpse on a cliff through the hole.

items.name: Stalwart Horn Charm +1
items.description: Found to the east of Yelough Anix Tunnel

items.name: Stanching Boluses - 1x Morne Tunnel
items.description: One can be looted off a corpse in Morne Tunnel.

items.name: Stanching Boluses - Old Altus Tunnel
items.description: Consumable. Found on a corpse in Old Altus Tunnel, behind some boxes besides a shack.

items.name: Star Fist
items.description: In the left side of a castle situated atop the mountain near the West Capital Rampart grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital .

items.name: Stargazer Heirloom
items.description: Talisman. Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia.

items.name: Stargazer's Ruins
items.description: A set of ruins found in central Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Starlight Shards - 10x Cathedral of Manus Celes
items.description: Consumable Item. 9 can be found all around the Cathedral of Manus Celes. One more can be found outside the cathedral, in the north by the cliffs.

items.name: Starlight Shards - Beast Sanctum
items.description: Can be found in front of a stone chalice

items.name: Starlight Shards - Caelid
items.description: Can be found in front of a stone chalice monument.

items.name: Starlight Shards - Mountaintops of the Giants East
items.description: Found in front of a crescent bowl-shaped stone statue by the cliffs.

items.name: Starlight Shards - Southern Limgrave
items.description: Starlight Shards: Do a Spiritspring Jumping, and keep jumping until you reach the top.You will find the item over a cup-like monument, on the edge.

items.name: Starlight Shards - Southwest Caelid
items.description: Can be found at the southwestern area of Caelid, near the monument that looks like a broken cup.

items.name: Starlight Shards - Weeping Peninsula
items.description: Can be found on an altar, by the cliff.

items.name: Starlight Shards B
items.description: Starlight Shards: Found at the very west of Stormhill at the edge of the Cliff on a stone monument.

items.name: Starlight Shards C
items.description: Consumable Item. Found in front of a crescent bowl-shaped stone sundial at the edge of the cliffs behind the castle.

items.name: Starlight Shards D
items.description: Can be found at the edge in front of the stone statue.

items.name: Starlight Shards E
items.description: Can be found in front of the half bowl stone statue by the cliff, overlooking the fog covered Academy Gate Town and Gate Town Bridge,

items.name: Stars of Ruin
items.description: Given by Master Lusat when interacted with inside the Sellia Hideaway behind an arcane ward in the second pit. Requires the Sellian Sealbreaker to get through arcane ward (Acquired during Sorceress Sellen Questline).

items.name: Starscourge Heirloom
items.description: Looted from a chest in Fort Gael. It's outside the watchtower on the upper-section of the fort, under a canopy tent.

items.name: Starscourge Radahn
items.description: One of the Shardbearers. Drops Remembrance of the Starscourge, Radahn's Great Rune

items.name: Starscourge Radahn
items.description: Site of Grace unlocked after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

items.name: Steel-Wire Torch
items.description: Torch. Found on a corpse at the end of a narrow path at the top level of the castle. Guarded by two harpies.

items.name: Stillwater Cave
items.description: A dark and murky water, poisonous cave. Infested with Giant Bats and large Poison Flowers.

items.name: Stillwater Cave
items.description: Site of Grace inside Stillwater Cave close to the entrance.

items.name: Stimulating Boluses - Sellia Hideaway
items.description: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway, at the bottom of a pit.

items.name: Stonebarb Cracked Tear
items.description: Obtained by defeating the Putrid Avatar at the Minor Erdtree in Dragonbarrow.

items.name: Stonedigger Troll (Altus Plateau)
items.description: Optional Boss encountered in the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon. Drops the Great Club weapon upon defeat.

items.name: Stonedigger Troll (Limgrave)
items.description: Optional Boss. Found at the end of Limgrave Tunnels. Drops Roar Medallion

items.name: Stonesword Key  - Bridge of Sacrifice (Weeping Peninsula)
items.description: Stoneword Key Found on the ground by a wooden barricade at the southern end of the Bridge of Sacrifice.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Academy Crystal Cave
items.description: Found inside the Academy Crystal Cave. Head to the left to where the Sages are, and enter the next room. You will find it inside a cage.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Academy Gate Town
items.description: Found within a chest, in one of the small islands next to the Raya Lucaria Academy.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Altus Plateau (A)
items.description: Found on a corpse located on a camp northeast from the Grand Lift of Dectus.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Altus Plateau (B)
items.description: Held by a Noble's sitting corpse.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Auriza Hero's Grave
items.description: At Auriza Hero's Grave, one can be found while passing the third part of the giant chariots, on a small platform in the middle.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Auriza Hero's Grave
items.description:
Stonesword Key. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave:
  • In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps then turn right to reach a second Chariot hall where two chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them. As you exit into this hall, turn left to find the key on a corpse between two ramps.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Caria Manor Western Walls
items.description: Crafting Material. Three can be looted from a corpse on the Western Walls of Caria Manor. It is guarded by a Giant Crab.This area can only be reached by dropping down from Three Sisters after defeating the main boss, and finding the path from the south-west of the chapel's rooftop.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Castle Morne
items.description: Stonesword Key. Found on a corpse partially hanging from a wooden platform. The platform can be found by walking down west from the nearby Site of Grace and back onto a section of the castle. Look to the left edge.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Castle Sol
items.description: Stonesword Key held by a corpse located on the rooftop in the northern section.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Corpse-Stench Shack
items.description: Stonesword Key found on a corpse on a broken bridge near Corpse-Stench Shack.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Key Item. Found on a corpse in a semi-open area in the back of the temple to the east. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, head inside the temple and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right when you can and then another left into a long hallway. The said area is to the left at the end of this hallway and the corpse can be found in the crumbled edge past the pillars.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Deep Siofra Well Ravine
items.description: Stonesword Key. Found on a body in the ravine south of the Deep Siofra Well, near the cliff.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Divine Tower of Caelid (Caelid)
items.description: Stonesword Key. Found on a corpse on a ledge on the outside of the tower. Accessible via careful platforming.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Dragon-Burnt Ruins
items.description: Stoneword Key Found inside a small room, protected by a Rat.

items.name: Stonesword Key - East Liurnia of the Lakes
items.description: Key Item. Found on a body sitting on a chair, in the open field, north from Ainsel River Well.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Frenzied Flame Village
items.description: Key Item. Found atop the Frenzied Flame Village outer walls.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Fringefolk Hero's Grave
items.description: Held by a corpse within Fringefolk Hero's Grave. Look for the body on a platform above the chariot.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Gaol Cave
items.description: Found within the Gaol Cave, near Wakizashi.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Guardians' Garrison
items.description: Stonesword Key. Held by a corpse in front of the fort's entrance.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Leyndell, Royal Capital (A)
items.description: Found on a small shack past the Fortified Manor, west of the Lower Capital Chuch Site of Grace. You have to jump around in order to reach it. There is a Smithing Stone (6) on that same shack.

items.name: Stonesword Key - Leyndell, Royal Capital (B)
items.description: Found on a corpse below West Capital Rampart Site of Grace. Drop down, jump on petrified dragon foot onto barn, then into 2nd story wooden building.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Set
items.description:
Armor Set comprised of the Tree Sentinel Helm, Tree Sentinel Armor, Tree Sentinel Gauntlets and Tree Sentinel Greaves. Obtained inside the Auriza Hero's Grave by destroying three specific Chariots. Doing this involves a few steps:
  1. From this first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp.
  2. In the room below, head west and up the steps and then turn right in the next corridor. Follow the path and you will end up in a large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. These are the Chariots you need to destroy.
  3. Head down the hall all the way to the bottom where there is a large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you will find several wooden beams you can drop down onto.
  4. Navigate your way down onto the lowest beam you can drop down to and then head south towards an archway with a ladder in the back. Climb up the ladder to reach another Chariot Hall with a single Chariot.
  5. Wait for the Chariot to head downwards and then run up the ramp and enter the chamber on the right where you will find a flamethrower pillar. Hit the pillar to raise it which will activate the circular golden seal in the middle of the large double Chariot Hall, teleporting the Chariot from the third hall and causing it to collide with the double Chariots.
  6. From here, you will need to return to the large hall to witness the collision event and collect your items. The easiest way to do this is by killing yourself or using the Memory of Grace tool (if you don't care about your runes) to return to the Site of Grace. Alternatively, from the flamethrower pillar room, return to the third Chariot Hall, go all the way down the ramp and turn left into a corridor. Take another left to find a lift which will take you up to a chamber where the flamethrower pillar was raised. Wait for breaks between flame spews and head through the corridor in the north. There is an alcove on the right halfway through the corridor which you can use to safely wait for another break before heading towards the end. At the end of this corridor, you can turn left to return to the large Chariot Hall. After the Chariots crash into each other, you will receive the Armor Set along with the Ash of War: Holy Ground.

items.description: Boss roaming Mt. Gelmir. Drops Leaden Hardtear and Cerulean Hidden Tear
