items.description: Found at the bottom of a gutter. The entrance to the crypt is found near the Liftside Chamber site of grace within Stormveil Castle. Defeating it grants a Golden Seed.

items.name: Unalloyed Gold Needle
items.description: Key Quest Item. Required to progress Gowry's questline. Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.

items.name: Underground Roadside
items.description: Site of Grace found underground in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

items.name: Unendurable Frenzy
items.description: Incantation. Found in a chest in an underground treasure room in the central section of the Yelough Anix Ruins.

items.name: Unseen Blade
items.description: Found at the top of Mirage Rise. Can be found alongside Unseen Form

items.name: Unseen Form
items.description: Found at the top of Mirage Rise. Can be found alongside Unseen Blade

items.name: Unsightly Catacombs
items.description: A burial grounds crawling with Misbegotten creatures found deep beneath the Perfumer's Ruins. Despite its decrepit state, the catacombs give off a trace of fragrant aromas juxtaposed by the scent of the ancient dead.

items.name: Unsightly Catacombs
items.description: Site of Grace near the Unsightly Catacombs entrance.

items.name: Upper-Class Robe
items.description: Found at the end of tha passageway. Beware of the Bedouin on your left side.

items.name: Urumi
items.description: Whip. Found on a body on the south-east ramparts, reached by jumping from the higher ramparts leading to the elevator and the Manor Upper Level site of grace.

items.name: Valiant Gargoyle - Capital Outskirts
items.description: Optional Boss. Located around the Capital Outskirts

items.name: Valiant Gargoyle - Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.description: Optional Boss. Located around Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Valkyrie's Prosthesis
items.description: Key Item. Found by climbing up the ladder in the central-western section of the courtyard that leads up to the top of the inner walls. Follow the walls northwest to find a room with a chest surrounded by statues and guarded by a single Cleanrot Knight.

items.name: Vargram the Raging Wolf
items.description: Found close to the Fortified Manor, First Floor Site of Grace.

items.name: Venomous Fang
items.description: Claw Weapons. Climb on the Iron Maidens near the end of the Abandoned Cave to acquire them.

items.name: Veteran's Prosthesis
items.description: Fist Weapon. Dropped by Commander Niall upon defeat.

items.name: Village of the Albinaurics
items.description: An abandoned Village found within the cavernous depths of Liurnia's poison swamp.

items.name: Village of the Albinaurics (Site of Grace)
items.description: Site of Grace for the Village of Albinaurics

items.name: Village Windmill Pasture
items.description: A windmill with two stables, found near Dominula, Windmill Village. The windmill here is still functional but the area has been taken over by Misbegotten creatures.

items.name: Viridian Amber Medallion
items.description: Viridian Amber Medallion Raises maximum stamina. It is dropped by Miranda the Blighted Bloom, found inside the Tombsward Cave.

items.name: Viridian Amber Medallion +1
items.description: can be found in Altus Plauteau, south of the Outer Wall Battleground Site of Grace. You should hear Margit whisper, "I see you, Tarnished..."  to you before appearing on the road. Defeat him again and it will drop.

items.name: Viridian Amber Medallion +2
items.description: The closest site of grace is the Haligtree Town Plaza. Run to the roof with the Summoning Snail, jump to the building on the right (it's lower), immediately turn around and jump inside the building. There will be a chest with the medallion and some mushroom people

items.name: Visage Shield
items.description: Greatshield. Found in a chest in a small room behind the Mad Pumpkin Head duo bosses. Accessible after defeating them.

items.name: Volcano Cave
items.description: A cave found at the top of a mountain.

items.name: Volcano Cave
items.description: Site of Grace located by the entrance to Volcano Cave.

items.name: Volcano Manor
items.description: The manor of a lord looking to rebel against the Erdtree.

items.name: Volcano Manor (Site of Grace)
items.description: Site of grace located just inside the Volcano Manor.

items.name: Volcano Manor Waygate
items.description: Waygate. Found on a balcony at the top of the stairs of a temple in Volcano Manor's dungeon. Teleports you to the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy boss fight.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Ashes
items.description:
Spirit Ashes found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave:
  • In the large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them, head all the way down to the large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you can find several wooden beams you can drop down onto. Navigate your way across the beams, heading north to find a hidden area on the right with a statue. Head into the corridor behind the statue and to the right to access a small room where a corpse holding the ashes can be found.

items.name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
items.description: Dragon Cult Incantation. Received after defeating Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable at Lord Contender's Evergaol.

items.name: Vyke's War Spear
items.description: Can be dropped from Festering Fingerprint Vyke

items.name: Wakizashi
items.description: Dagger. Found within Gaol Cave

items.name: Walking Mausoleum (Consecrated Snowfield)
items.description: A Walking Mausoleum found near the Apostate Derelict. This one fires magical artillery into the air, raining havoc down in the surrounding areas. Subdue it to stop the bombardment.

items.name: Walking Mausoleum (Liurnia of the Lakes Central)
items.description: Use the spirit spring west from the mausoleum (hidden on the lower area of the cliffs of Bellum Church) and jump onto the mausoleum when it's close to the northern cliffside of the lake.

items.name: Walking Mausoleum (Liurnia of the Lakes East)
items.description: Attack the legs to bring down the mausoleum and go inside it.

items.name: Walking Mausoleum (Liurnia of the Lakes)
items.description: Attack the legs to bring down the mausoleum and go inside it.

items.name: Walking Mausoleum (Mountaintops of the Giants)
items.description: Attack the white spots on the legs to get it to come down and access the mausoleum.

items.name: Walking Mausoleum (Weeping Peninsula)
items.description: Attack the white spots on the legs to get it to come down and access the mausoleum.

items.name: Wandering Merchant Caelid Highway North
items.description: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire east of the Astray from Caelid Highway North Site of Grace.

items.name: Wandering Noble Ashes
items.description: Located on a corpse that is resting against a stone coffin in the Stormfoot Catacombs in Limgrave. Proceed through the catacombs as normal until reaching a ladder that is going up, once you've reached the top continue forward past some Jade Goblins until reaching a dead end room that is being guarded by two Jade Goblins, the corpse resting against the stone coffin will hold the ashes

items.name: War Counselor Iji
items.description: Blacksmith - sells Upgrade Materials such as Somber Smithing Stone [1] through [4].

items.name: War-Dead Catacombs
items.description: Catacombs found within Starscourge Radahn's boss arena

items.name: Warhawk Ashes
items.description: Rewarded upon finding the location Prophecy Painting depicts. The location is north of the Church of Pilgrimage.

items.name: Warmaster's Shack
items.description: Small shack in a remote place of Stormhill.

items.name: Warmaster's Shack
items.description: Site of grace in Warmaster's Shack.

items.name: Warming Stone
items.description: Consumable Item. 2 can be found on a corpse atop the eastern-most tower of the Castle Morne Ramparts. This area can be reached by using Torrent to jump from the Spiritspring located just east of the Site of Grace nearby.

items.name: Warming Stone (Church of Irith Graveyard)
items.description: Consumable. 3x Warming Stone on a graveyard protected by several undead.

items.name: Warming Stone - 4x
items.description: Found on a body laying over a dead tree.

items.name: Warming Stone - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
items.description: Consumable. 2 are found on a corpse sitting by a desk inside a building in the northeast. This building can be reached by following the eastern walkway all the way to the northeast and walking along a concrete beam connecting to the building.

items.name: Warming Stone - Flame Peak
items.description: Consumable. 2 Warming Stones found on a body in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Warming Stone - Fort Gael
items.description: Consumable. Looted off a corpse that's hanging on a narrow beam. Bacony/Upper-section of Fort Gael.

items.name: Warming Stone - Stormhill
items.description: Consumable. From Stormveil Castle, on the bridge linking to Divine Tower of Limgrave. Can be found near the edge of the cratered portion of the bridge that leads to the tower, same area as the golem fight.

items.name: Warpick
items.description: Looted from one of the many Undead Soldiers.

items.name: Watchdog's Staff
items.description: Located in Road's End Catacombs, behind an illusory wall near the stairs at the beginning of the dungeon.

items.name: Waygate (Consecrated Snowfield)
items.description: Waygate. Teleports you across the ravine to the northern side of the river.

items.name: Waygate to Liurnia West (from Liurnia East)
items.description: Waygate teleports players to the western side of Liurnia of the Lakes, by the Northern Liurnia Lakeshore Site of Grace

items.name: Waygate to Miquella's Haligtree
items.description: Waygate accessible only after completing the Evergaol Puzzle at Ordina, Liturgical Town

items.name: Waygate to Mohgwyn Palace
items.description: Waygate. Teleports players to the underground area beneath Caelid, called Mohgwyn Palace

items.name: Waygate to Underground Area
items.description: A Teleporter Waygate at The Four Belfries that transports you to section of Nokron, Eternal City/ Siofra River(Underground area that is inaccessable without a waygate to access). Requires an Imbued Sword Key.

items.name: Waypoint Ruins
items.description: Waypoint Ruins consists of a group of broken buildings and abandoned campsites, now overrun with poisonous flowers and their crazed caretaker.

items.name: Waypoint Ruins Cellar
items.description: Site of grace in the cellar of the Waypoint Ruins.

items.name: Weeping Evergaol
items.description: Evergaol imprisoning the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss. Requires a Stonesword Key to unlock the portal mechanism.

items.name: West Capital Rampart
items.description: Site of grace

items.name: Whetstone Knife
items.description: Key Item. Found in the southeastern area of Gatefront Ruins. There is a set of stairs that leads to a small room with a treasure chest. This item is found alongside the Ash of War: Storm Stomp upgrade.

items.name: Whip
items.description: Whip. Found on a corpse inside the building known as the Rampart Gaol. This building is first accessed by walking atop the western wall of the castle. Look to the left for a building with a blue roof. Jump onto this roof and then jump down to the cliffs below. Follow the cliffs southeast until you return to a section of the castle with a big square opening. Descend into the opening by landing on the wooden beams. There is a corpse with a Smithing Stone [2] on one of the beams and there are several Rats and a Harpy at the ground level. The corpse with the whip is sitting against a wall.

items.name: Whirl, O Flame!
items.description: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab on the road between Rotview Balcony and Caelem Ruins next to the wagon.

items.name: White Reed Set
items.description: White Reed Armor Set excluding the Helm. Found on a corpse inside the Spiritcaller's Cave, in a long cavern filled with spirit wolves.

items.name: White-Faced Varre (First Location)
items.description: White-Faced Varre, Location 1. Found right next to The First Step Site of Grace. Provides Lore info. You will encounter this NPC multiple times in different locations.

items.name: White-Mask Varre (Second Location)
items.description: White-Faced Varre, Location 2. Found standing outside of the Rose Church. Gives you the Festering Bloody Finger after exhausting his dialogue.

items.name: Whiteridge Road
items.description: Site of Grace found near the Guardians Garrison.

items.name: Windmill Heights
items.description: Site of Grace

items.name: Windmill Village
items.description: Site of Grace in the Windmill Village

items.name: Windy Crystal Tear
items.description: The item can be found in Caelid in a pit southeast of the Nomadic Merchant Caelid South. One of the birds watches over it, facing south.

items.name: Winged Crystal Tear
items.description: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Found on an altar surrounded by Skull enemies.

items.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
items.description: Spirit Ash. Found on a corpse in a pit inside the Unsightly Catacombs.

items.name: Winged Scythe
items.description: Located In the center of Tombsward Ruins, there is a set of stairs leading underground into a dark hall with a door to a small room at the end. The scythe is inside a chest in the small room.

items.name: Winged Sword Insignia
items.description: Talisman. Dropped by the Cleanrot Knight boss inside the Stillwater Cave.

items.name: Witch's Glintstone Crown
items.description: Dropped by Sorceress Sellen, by completing her questline and after defeating her.

items.name: Witch-Hunter Jerren (First Location)
items.description: Witch-Hunter Jerren is first spoken to in Castle Redmane just north of the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace. He is found here after the defeat of Starscourge Radahn. If he is not found in this location, he is likey already at his second location in Witchbane Ruins.

items.name: Witch-Hunter Jerren (Second Location)
items.description: Witch-Hunter Jerren appears here while progressing through the Sorceress Sellen questline. He may be first encountered in Castle Redmane after the defeat of Starscourge Radahn.

items.name: Witch-Hunter Jerren (Third Location)
items.description: Witch-Hunter Jerren can be found here at the Raya Lucaria Academy Library after progressing towards the end of the Sorceress Sellen questline. Choose to side with Sellen to face him in combat in this location, or choose to side with Jerren to face Sellen instead. He will also be here provide your reward should you choose to side with him.

items.name: Witchbane Ruins
items.description: Ruins found south of the Fourth Church of Marika. Teeming with hostiles.

items.name: Wooden Greatshield
items.description: Greatshield. Found in a guardhouse near the northern section of the castle courtyard.

items.name: Woodfolk Ruins
items.description: East of the Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau

items.name: Wormface
items.description: Boss located at the base of the Minor Erdtree. Drops Speckled Hardtear and Crimsonspill Crystal Tear

items.name: Wormface - Crumbling Farum Azula
items.description: Boss. Located in Crumbling Farum Azula

items.name: Wormface - Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir)
items.description: Boss. Wormface Bosses are usually located within the vicinity of the Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir)

items.name: Wraith Calling Bell
items.description: Offensive Consumable Item. Found in a chest in a small room of an underground aea in the northwestern section of the Laskyar Ruins. Find a set of steps leading downwards to locate the area.

items.name: Wrath of Gold
items.description: Found at Woodfolk Ruins. Among the enemies, there is a staircase that goes down and leads to a chest that contains this Incantation

items.name: Writheblood Ruins
items.description: A set of ruins overlooking a forest where the Altus Plateau's Minor Erdtree can be found.

items.name: Wyndham Catacombs
items.description: Mini Dungeon. The entrance is found at the top of Wyndham Ruins.

items.name: Wyndham Catacombs
items.description: Site of Grace found right by the catacombs' entrance.

items.name: Wyndham Ruins
items.description: A large set of ruins south west of the Old Altus Tunnel.

items.name: Yellow Ember
items.description: Can be found near to Callu Baptismal Church on a dead body in front of the tent.

items.name: Yellow Ember - 1x Bellum Highway East
items.description: Crafting Material. Looted off a corpse on the slopes leading to Frenzy-Flaming Tower in eastern Bellum Highway.

items.name: Yelough Anix Ruins
items.description: A set of ruins found west of the Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Yelough Anix Tunnel
items.description: Tunnels in Western Consecrated Snowfield, rich in very rare smithing materials.

items.name: Yelough Anix Tunnel Site of Grace
items.description: Located inside Yelough Anix Tunnel

items.name: Zamor Curved Sword
items.description: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave upon defeat.

items.name: Zamor Ice Storm (Spell)
items.description: Snow Witch Sorcery. Found on a corpse in the southern section of the Zamor Ruins, by a stone archway.

items.name: Zamor Ruins
items.description: Once you reach Mountaintops of the Giants, past Shabriri.

items.name: Zamor Ruins
items.description: Site of Grace found near the path towards Zamor Ruins.

items.name: Zamor Set
items.description: Armor Set comprised of Zamor Mask, Zamor Armor, Zamor Bracelets and Zamor Legwraps. Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor Boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave upon defeat.
